# Perfect Design (@perfect-design/ui)

> Universal Vue 3 + Tailwind 4 + reka-ui component library and design system. Semantic tokens (shadcn-compatible), CVA variants, `class` prop always wins, `as`/`asChild`, `data-slot` hooks. Icons are FontAwesome IconDefinitions.

## Rules
- Import from `@perfect-design/ui`; use semantic tokens only (bg-background, text-foreground, bg-primary, border-border…); never raw colours.
- Override styling only through the `class` prop; reuse `xVariants()` helpers for non-component elements.
- Wrap form controls in `Field`; give icon-only buttons an aria-label; Dialogs need a DialogTitle.
- Avoid the LLM tells in LLMSlop.md: no gradients, glass, glows, tracked all-caps eyebrows, hover lift, buzzwords, stock labels ("Get started", "Learn more"), emoji or invented people, quotes and numbers. Follow DESIGN.md.

## Start here
- [Getting started](/guides/getting-started): install, CSS wiring, first component
- [Customisation contract](/guides/customisation): class, variant, size, as, data-slot

- [Style packs](/foundations/styles): workbench, tactile, editorial, raw, contrast and terminal looks via data-style
- [Every component in detail](/llms-full.txt): props, slots, events, rules and examples for all components in one file
- [Component manifest](/components.manifest.json): the same data as JSON

## primitives
- [Button](/components/primitives/button): Triggers an action or navigation. The single button used everywhere in the system. (Buttons)
- [IconButton](/components/primitives/icon-button): Square icon-only Button with a required accessible label and tooltip title. (Buttons)
- [Chip](/components/primitives/chip): Compact tag that can be removable and/or selectable (toggle). (Chips)
- [ShowMore](/components/primitives/show-more): Collapses long content to a number of lines or a height and shows a Show more toggle only when it overflows. (Disclosure)
- [Avatar](/components/primitives/avatar): Shows a user or entity as an image with an initials fallback and an optional status dot. (Display)
- [AvatarGroup](/components/primitives/avatar-group): Overlapping stack of avatars with a +N overflow bubble. (Display)
- [Icon](/components/primitives/icon): Inline SVG renderer for FontAwesome-shaped icon data, decorative by default. (Display)
- [Kbd](/components/primitives/kbd): Keyboard key chip (`<kbd>`) and a group that joins keys with a separator. (Display)
- [Separator](/components/primitives/separator): Thin horizontal or vertical divider line, solid, dashed or dotted, optionally with a label ("or", "Today") on the line. (Display)
- [Skeleton](/components/primitives/skeleton): Placeholder block shown while content loads: text, circle, avatar, pill, rounded, rect and paragraph shapes with a pulse or no animation. (Display)
- [Spinner](/components/primitives/spinner): Small rotating SVG that shows work in progress, with an accessible label or as a purely visual mark. (Display)
- [AspectRatio](/components/primitives/aspect-ratio): Keeps its content at a fixed width-to-height ratio (images, video, maps, placeholders). (Layout helpers)
- [ScrollArea](/components/primitives/scroll-area): Scrollable region with consistent, themed scrollbars across browsers. (Layout helpers)
- [VisuallyHidden](/components/primitives/visually-hidden): Hides content visually while keeping it available to screen readers. (Layout helpers)
- [Link](/components/primitives/link): Inline text link with variants, safe external handling and RouterLink support. (Links)
- [Badge](/components/primitives/badge): Small non-interactive label for status, counts and categories. (Status)
- [CountBadge](/components/primitives/count-badge): Numeric count pill or small dot for unread items and pending work, with a required accessible label. (Status)
- [Progress](/components/primitives/progress): Horizontal progress bar with determinate and indeterminate modes, tones, sizes, a pulse animation, inside/top labels and segments. (Status)
- [ProgressRing](/components/primitives/progress-ring): Circular SVG meter that fills clockwise from the top, with a centre label. (Status)
- [StatusBadge](/components/primitives/status-badge): Badge that maps a raw status string (active, pending, failed...) to a tone, with a leading dot. (Status)
- [StatusDot](/components/primitives/status-dot): Small coloured dot that signals a state (online, failing, pending), optionally pulsing. (Status)
- [Toggle](/components/primitives/toggle): Two-state button that stays pressed (bold, mute, pin). Controlled or uncontrolled. (Toggles)
- [ToggleGroup](/components/primitives/toggle-group): Joined set of toggle buttons (default, outline or segmented look) with single or multiple selection and roving keyboard focus. (Toggles)

## typography
- [Markdown](/components/typography/markdown): Renders Markdown text (CommonMark plus GFM tables, task lists and strikethrough) as styled, accessible elements without v-html. (Prose)
- [Prose](/components/typography/prose): Wrapper that styles raw HTML content (headings, lists, links, code, tables, images) with design tokens. (Prose)
- [Blockquote](/components/typography/blockquote): Quoted passage in five variants (left border, tinted, card, pull-quote) with a citation footer or an author row (avatar, name, role). (Text)
- [Eyebrow](/components/typography/eyebrow): Small plain label placed above a heading. (Text)
- [FormattedNumber](/components/typography/formatted-number): A locale-aware number, percentage, currency amount, unit or compact figure rendered with Intl.NumberFormat, with tabular figures and bidi isolation. (Text)
- [Heading](/components/typography/heading): Semantic h1-h6 heading with independent visual size, underline/divider decoration and optional eyebrow and description. (Text)
- [InlineCode](/components/typography/inline-code): Inline <code> snippet with a muted background and monospace font. (Text)
- [Lead](/components/typography/lead): Large muted intro paragraph that follows a page or section title. (Text)
- [Price](/components/typography/price): A locale-aware price with an optional period, a struck-through previous price and a label for free or missing amounts. (Text)
- [RelativeTime](/components/typography/relative-time): A `<time>` element that writes a moment as relative text ("3 minutes ago", "in 2 days") with the absolute date in the tooltip, optionally kept fresh by one shared timer. (Text)
- [Text](/components/typography/text): Body text with variant presets, size, tone, weight, leading, transform, wrapping, alignment and truncation or line clamping. (Text)

## layout
- [ConfigProvider](/components/layout/config-provider): Sets text direction, locale, time zone, motion override, default size and density, and translated built-in strings for everything inside it. (Configuration)
- [Container](/components/layout/container): Constrains content to a max width, centres it and adds responsive horizontal padding. (Containers)
- [Section](/components/layout/section): Page section with vertical padding presets, optional tinted background and borders. (Containers)
- [AppShell](/components/layout/app-shell): Application frame with header, collapsible sidebar (drawer on mobile), main content and footer slots. (Page structure)
- [CenteredLayout](/components/layout/centered-layout): Full-height page that centres a narrow column, for sign-in, empty and error pages. (Page structure)
- [PageHeader](/components/layout/page-header): Page title block with description, breadcrumb, back link, tabs, actions, centered / compact / hero variants and optional sticky mode. (Page structure)
- [ResizablePanels](/components/layout/resizable-panels): Two or more panels separated by draggable, keyboard-accessible handles; sizes are percentages that always add up to 100. (Page structure)
- [SplitLayout](/components/layout/split-layout): Two-pane layout (start / end) with ratio presets, fixed-width pane and responsive stacking. (Page structure)
- [Affix](/components/layout/affix): Pins content with `position: sticky` and reports whether it is currently stuck. (Scrolling)
- [InfiniteScroll](/components/layout/infinite-scroll): Fires `load` when the end of a list scrolls into view; handles loading, end-of-list and error-with-retry states. (Scrolling)
- [Grid](/components/layout/grid): CSS grid with 1-12 columns, per-breakpoint column counts and a gap scale. (Stacks & grids)
- [Spacer](/components/layout/spacer): Flexible (flex-1) or fixed-size empty space for use inside flex layouts. (Stacks & grids)
- [Stack](/components/layout/stack): Flex container that lays children out in a row or column with consistent gaps. (Stacks & grids)
- [StyleScope](/components/layout/style-scope): Applies one style pack (density, corners, depth, type) to everything inside it. (Style packs)

## forms
- [FormActions](/components/forms/form-actions): Aligned row of form actions (submit and cancel) with an optional sticky bottom bar and stacking on small screens. (Actions)
- [Checkbox](/components/forms/checkbox): Boolean (or indeterminate) checkbox with optional label and description, sizes, tones, shapes, invalid state and Field wiring. (Choice)
- [CheckboxCard](/components/forms/checkbox-card): Selectable card tile backed by a native checkbox, with title, description, icon slots, variants, tones, a stacked layout and a group for multi-select lists. (Choice)
- [MultiSelect](/components/forms/multi-select): Dropdown checkbox list with chips summary, search filter, select all / clear, max selections and full keyboard support. (Choice)
- [PlanPicker](/components/forms/plan-picker): One column of selectable plans with the price at the end, for checkout, upgrade and settings screens. (Choice)
- [RadioCard](/components/forms/radio-card): Selectable card tile backed by a native radio input, used inside RadioCardGroup for single-choice options with tones, a stacked layout and roving arrow-key navigation. (Choice)
- [RadioGroup](/components/forms/radio-group): Single-choice group of radio items with roving keyboard focus, labels, descriptions, sizes, tones and Field wiring. (Choice)
- [SegmentedControl](/components/forms/segmented-control): Compact single choice (view switcher, range picker) built on a radiogroup, in pill, underline, outline or filled looks, horizontal or vertical. (Choice)
- [Switch](/components/forms/switch): On/off toggle for settings that take effect immediately, with optional label and description, sizes, tones and on/off icons. (Choice)
- [ColorPicker](/components/forms/color-picker): Swatch palette plus validated hex input; emits normalised lowercase hex colours. (Choice inputs)
- [Rating](/components/forms/rating): Rating input from 0 to N icons (star, heart, circle) with half or quarter steps, tones, keyboard support and slider semantics. (Choice inputs)
- [Calendar](/components/forms/calendar): Accessible month grid with single, range or multiple day selection, min/max/disabled dates, locale names and full keyboard navigation. (Date & time)
- [DatePicker](/components/forms/date-picker): Input-like button that opens a dropdown Calendar to pick a single date, formatted with Intl. (Date & time)
- [DateRangePicker](/components/forms/date-range-picker): Input-like button that opens a dropdown Calendar to pick a start and end date, with an optional two-month view. (Date & time)
- [TimeInput](/components/forms/time-input): Segmented HH:mm time field with arrow-key stepping, digit typing, optional 12h AM/PM, min/max, minute step, variants, shapes and status. (Date & time)
- [TimeRangePicker](/components/forms/time-range-picker): Pick a time window from presets (last 15 minutes to 30 days, today, yesterday) or a custom from and to, as a popover, an inline panel or a segmented row, in an explicit time zone. (Date & time)
- [Field](/components/forms/field): Form-field wrapper: label, control, hint and error with automatic id, aria-describedby and aria-invalid wiring. (Field wrappers)
- [Label](/components/forms/label): Accessible form label with optional required indicator and disabled style. (Field wrappers)
- [FilterBar](/components/forms/filter-bar): A row of applied filters as removable chips with an "Add filter" popover, "Clear all", a polite live region and URL-query helpers. (Filtering)
- [FieldGroup](/components/forms/field-group): Layout wrapper that stacks or grids several Fields with a consistent gap. (Layout)
- [Fieldset](/components/forms/fieldset): Native fieldset with legend and description that groups related controls and can disable them all at once. (Layout)
- [FormSection](/components/forms/form-section): Titled form section landmark with description, optional aside actions, divider and a responsive 1-4 column fields grid. (Layout)
- [Combobox](/components/forms/combobox): Type-to-filter single select over an options array with clear button, empty state and Field wiring. (Selection)
- [ModelPicker](/components/forms/model-picker): Searchable, grouped single choice over plain option data with a description and text badges per option. (Selection)
- [NativeSelect](/components/forms/native-select): Styled native <select> with chevron, options array or slot content, placeholder, variants, sizes, shapes, status and Field wiring. (Selection)
- [Select](/components/forms/select): Custom single-select dropdown with groups, labels, keyboard typeahead and Field wiring. (Selection)
- [Slider](/components/forms/slider): Pick a number or a numeric range by dragging a thumb or using the keyboard. (Selection)
- [UsageEstimator](/components/forms/usage-estimator): Usage-based cost calculator: a slider and number field per metered dimension, a live cost per line and an estimated total. (Selection)
- [CopyField](/components/forms/copy-field): Read-only value (API key, URL, token) with a joined copy-to-clipboard button, copied feedback, variants, sizes, shapes and status. (Text fields)
- [DateInput](/components/forms/date-input): Styled native date, time, datetime-local or month input with min/max validation messaging, variants, sizes, shapes and status. (Text fields)
- [Editable](/components/forms/editable): Inline editable text: click to edit, Enter saves, Escape cancels, blur saves (configurable). (Text fields)
- [Input](/components/forms/input): Single-line text field with v-model, variants (outline, filled, underline, ghost), sizes, shapes, status, prefix and suffix slots and automatic Field wiring. (Text fields)
- [InputGroup](/components/forms/input-group): Puts a prefix, a suffix or joined buttons around an Input, Textarea or NativeSelect so they share one field surface. (Text fields)
- [NumberInput](/components/forms/number-input): Numeric text field with -/+ steppers, clamping, keyboard stepping, float-safe arithmetic, variants, sizes, shapes and status. (Text fields)
- [PasswordInput](/components/forms/password-input): Password field with an accessible show/hide toggle, variants, sizes, shapes and status. (Text fields)
- [PinInput](/components/forms/pin-input): Segmented one-character-per-cell input for verification codes and PINs. (Text fields)
- [PromptInput](/components/forms/prompt-input): Auto-growing message box for chat style interfaces: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line, a Stop button replaces Send while a reply is running. (Text fields)
- [SearchInput](/components/forms/search-input): Text field with a search icon, a clear button, Esc-to-clear and an optional debounced `search` event. (Text fields)
- [TagsInput](/components/forms/tags-input): Free-form list of short strings entered as removable chips. (Text fields)
- [Textarea](/components/forms/textarea): Multi-line text field with v-model, variants, sizes, shapes, status, optional autosize and character counter. (Text fields)
- [FileDropzone](/components/forms/file-dropzone): Drag-and-drop or click-to-browse file picker with type, size and count validation. Selection only, no upload. (Upload)

## feedback
- [ConfirmDialog](/components/feedback/confirm-dialog): Confirm / cancel dialog with destructive styling and async-aware confirm, plus a promise-based useConfirm() host. (Confirmation)
- [PageLoadingBar](/components/feedback/page-loading-bar): A thin bar fixed to the top of the viewport that shows a route change or page load, with a delay so fast navigations never flash. (Loading)
- [Alert](/components/feedback/alert): Inline, in-flow status message with optional icon, title, description and dismiss button. (Messages)
- [Banner](/components/feedback/banner): Full-width, page-level notice with optional sticky position, action slot and remembered dismissal. (Messages)
- [Callout](/components/feedback/callout): Documentation-style note, tip, important, warning, caution, danger, success, quote or example block with a tinted surface and a status icon. (Messages)
- [InlineMessage](/components/feedback/inline-message): One-line, field-level message with a tone-coloured icon. (Messages)
- [NotificationList](/components/feedback/notification-list): Inbox-style list of notifications with unread dots, relative times, mark-as-read, grouping and a collapsible tail. (Notifications)
- [AsyncBoundary](/components/feedback/async-boundary): Shows the right state for async content: loading, error with retry, empty or the content itself. (States)
- [EmptyState](/components/feedback/empty-state): Centred placeholder for lists, tables and views that have no content yet. (States)
- [ErrorState](/components/feedback/error-state): Failed-load placeholder with a message, retry button and collapsible technical details. (States)
- [LoadingState](/components/feedback/loading-state): Loading placeholder: spinner with label, or text / card / table / list / avatar-text / kpi-grid / form skeletons; optional full-page layout. (States)
- [OfflineIndicator](/components/feedback/offline-indicator): Shows a warning message while the browser is offline; renders nothing visible when online. (States)
- [StaleNotice](/components/feedback/stale-notice): Shows when data was last updated, turns into a warning once it is stale, with optional refresh button. (States)
- [TypingIndicator](/components/feedback/typing-indicator): Three softly pulsing dots in a compact bubble that show someone or something is writing, with the label announced once. (States)
- [Toaster](/components/feedback/toaster): Fixed-position, screen-reader-announced stack that renders the global toast store. (Toasts)
- [ToastItem](/components/feedback/toast-item): Presentational toast card: icon, title, description, optional action and dismiss button. (Toasts)

## overlays
- [HoverCard](/components/overlays/hover-card): Rich preview card that appears when hovering or focusing a link or element. (Floating)
- [Popover](/components/overlays/popover): Non-modal floating panel anchored to a trigger. Compound component built on reka-ui. (Floating)
- [Tooltip](/components/overlays/tooltip): Short text hint shown on hover or keyboard focus. Compound component plus a one-line `SimpleTooltip`. (Floating)
- [Tour](/components/overlays/tour): Step-by-step coach marks that spotlight page elements and explain them in a positioned card. (Guided tours)
- [Command](/components/overlays/command): Searchable command palette: an input that filters a keyboard-navigable list of items. Inline or inside a modal `CommandDialog`. (Menus)
- [ContextMenu](/components/overlays/context-menu): Right-click (long-press on touch) menu with items, checkboxes, radios, groups and nested sub menus. (Menus)
- [DropdownMenu](/components/overlays/dropdown-menu): Menu of actions opened from a button, with items, checkboxes, radios, groups and nested sub menus. (Menus)
- [AlertDialog](/components/overlays/alert-dialog): Modal confirmation that interrupts the user and requires an explicit Cancel or Action choice. (Modals)
- [Dialog](/components/overlays/dialog): Modal window that blocks the page until dismissed. Compound component built on reka-ui. (Modals)
- [Sheet](/components/overlays/sheet): Modal panel that slides in from the top, right, bottom or left edge. Compound component built on reka-ui Dialog. (Modals)
- [ShortcutsDialog](/components/overlays/shortcuts-dialog): Help dialog that lists the keyboard shortcuts of a page, grouped, with keys drawn as Kbd chips. Opens with `?` by default. (Modals)

## navigation
- [BackToTop](/components/navigation/back-to-top): Floating button that appears after scrolling down and scrolls the window back to the top. (Accessibility)
- [SkipLink](/components/navigation/skip-link): Visually hidden "Skip to main content" link that appears on keyboard focus. (Accessibility)
- [AppHeader](/components/navigation/app-header): Top bar with brand, navigation and action slots, an optional sticky mode and a built-in mobile menu. (App shell)
- [MobileNav](/components/navigation/mobile-nav): Small-screen navigation panel: slides down under a header or opens as a side sheet. Esc closes and focus is managed. (App shell)
- [SidebarNav](/components/navigation/sidebar-nav): Grouped application sidebar navigation with icons, badges, nested items and an icon-only collapsed mode. (App shell)
- [DocsSidebar](/components/navigation/docs-sidebar): Documentation-style grouped link list with section titles and an active page indicator. (Docs)
- [TableOfContents](/components/navigation/table-of-contents): In-page "On this page" list that highlights the section being read and scrolls to a section on click. (Docs)
- [NavLink](/components/navigation/nav-link): Navigation link with an active state (aria-current), optional icon and badge. Router-agnostic. (Links)
- [Menubar](/components/navigation/menubar): Desktop-style horizontal menu bar (File, Edit, View) whose menus open from triggers with full keyboard roving. (Menus)
- [NavigationMenu](/components/navigation/navigation-menu): Site navigation bar with hover/click mega-menu panels, an optional shared viewport and an optional indicator. (Menus)
- [Toolbar](/components/navigation/toolbar): A row or column of related controls that is one tab stop and moves focus with the arrow keys (WAI-ARIA toolbar). (Menus)
- [Pagination](/components/navigation/pagination): Page navigation with first/prev/next/last, sibling window and ellipses. Compact "Page X of Y" on small screens. (Paging)
- [Stepper](/components/navigation/stepper): Shows progress through a multi-step flow, horizontal or vertical, optionally clickable. (Progress)
- [Accordion](/components/navigation/accordion): Vertically stacked sections that expand and collapse. Single or multiple open items. Built on reka-ui. (Tabs & disclosure)
- [Collapsible](/components/navigation/collapsible): A single show/hide region with an animated reveal. Built on reka-ui. (Tabs & disclosure)
- [Tabs](/components/navigation/tabs): Switch between related panels of content without leaving the page. Compound component built on reka-ui. (Tabs & disclosure)
- [AccentPicker](/components/navigation/accent-picker): Radio group of colour swatches that switches the accent preset (`data-theme`). (Theme)
- [CodeThemePicker](/components/navigation/code-theme-picker): Radio group that switches the colours of code viewers and code blocks (`data-code-theme`). (Theme)
- [FontPicker](/components/navigation/font-picker): Radio group that switches the font family (`data-font`) of the whole page. (Theme)
- [PalettePicker](/components/navigation/palette-picker): Radio group that switches the whole-interface palette (`data-palette`) of the page. (Theme)
- [StylePicker](/components/navigation/style-picker): Radio group that switches the style pack (`data-style`) of the whole page. (Theme)
- [ThemeToggle](/components/navigation/theme-toggle): Button that cycles the colour mode light → dark → system and shows the matching icon. (Theme)
- [Breadcrumb](/components/navigation/breadcrumb): Shows the path to the current page. Items-array API or compound parts, with middle-item truncation. (Wayfinding)

## data-display
- [BoardCard](/components/data-display/board-card): Draggable card for a BoardColumn, with a keyboard alternative (Alt + arrow keys) to dragging. (Boards)
- [BoardColumn](/components/data-display/board-column): Kanban-style column that accepts dragged BoardCards and reports where they were dropped. (Boards)
- [BarChart](/components/data-display/bar-chart): Dependency-free SVG bar chart: grouped or stacked, vertical or horizontal, rounded or square bars, optional value labels and grid styles, with axis, legend and per-bar tooltips. (Charts)
- [BulletChart](/components/data-display/bullet-chart): Bullet chart: one thin measure bar against a target marker and qualitative range bands, for one or several stacked measures. (Charts)
- [CalendarHeatmap](/components/data-display/calendar-heatmap): Contribution-style calendar: one cell per day, weeks as columns and weekdays as rows, with month labels, a legend and a month table for assistive technology. (Charts)
- [DonutChart](/components/data-display/donut-chart): Dependency-free SVG donut or half donut showing parts of a whole, with a centre total and a legend of values and percentages that sits beside or under the ring. (Charts)
- [FunnelChart](/components/data-display/funnel-chart): Dependency-free SVG funnel chart with funnel, pyramid, bars and steps variants, vertical or horizontal layout, conversion rates, labels inside or beside the shapes and non-monotone data. (Charts)
- [Heatmap](/components/data-display/heatmap): Accessible grid heatmap (commit calendar, activity by hour) with intensity levels, labels, legend and cell tooltips. (Charts)
- [LineChart](/components/data-display/line-chart): Dependency-free SVG line chart with multiple series, nice y ticks, linear, smooth or step curves, optional area fill and markers, grid styles, gaps for missing values and tooltips on dots. (Charts)
- [NetworkGraph](/components/data-display/network-graph): Dependency-free node-link diagram with four deterministic layouts, group colours with marker shapes, arrowheads, hulls and a text alternative. (Charts)
- [RadarChart](/components/data-display/radar-chart): Dependency-free SVG radar (spider) chart with three or more axes, several series, line, area or dots variants, polygon or circular rings, 3 to 6 levels and a configurable scale. (Charts)
- [Sankey](/components/data-display/sankey): Flow diagram: nodes in layers joined by ribbons whose width is the amount that flows, with a table of flows as the text alternative. (Charts)
- [ScatterChart](/components/data-display/scatter-chart): Dependency-free SVG scatter, bubble and connected-scatter chart with several series, marker shapes per series, nice numeric axes, grid styles, axis titles and an optional linear trend line. (Charts)
- [Sparkline](/components/data-display/sparkline): Tiny inline trend (pure SVG) as a line, area, bar or win/loss strip, for tables, KPI tiles and lists. (Charts)
- [Treemap](/components/data-display/treemap): Hierarchical tile chart: area follows value, tiles are squarified, groups can be shown as nested containers, and every tile is keyboard reachable. (Charts)
- [WaterfallChart](/components/data-display/waterfall-chart): Dependency-free SVG waterfall chart: a start value, increases and decreases, subtotals and a total, as bars, steps or lollipops, vertical or horizontal, with connectors and a pattern or marker for decreases. (Charts)
- [ChatMessage](/components/data-display/chat-message): One chat message with a role, a bubble, plain or card surface, an avatar, a header, a status written as text and hover or focus actions. (Chat)
- [ChatThread](/components/data-display/chat-thread): Scrolling conversation log that follows the latest message, with day separators, a typing indicator, a jump button, older-message loading and one polite announcement region. (Chat)
- [CodeBlock](/components/data-display/code-block): Monospace code panel with copy button, line numbers, titled header and terminal frames, filename header and tabs, diff marks and line highlighting. (Code)
- [CodeViewer](/components/data-display/code-viewer): Read-only code viewer with built-in tokenizers for JSON, YAML, Go, TOML and shell, foldable regions, line numbers, line highlighting and a copy button. (Code)
- [DiffViewer](/components/data-display/diff-viewer): Read-only diff of two texts or a unified diff string, in unified, split or inline layout, with word highlights, folded unchanged lines and change-to-change navigation. (Code)
- [GoViewer](/components/data-display/go-viewer): Read-only Go viewer: show Go source with highlighting and folds, or render a JS value as a Go composite literal. (Code)
- [LogViewer](/components/data-display/log-viewer): Searchable, filterable log pane with level badges, ANSI colours, line selection, copy and a tail mode. (Code)
- [YamlViewer](/components/data-display/yaml-viewer): Read-only YAML viewer: show raw YAML text or serialise a JS value to YAML, with highlighting, indentation folds, line numbers and copy. (Code)
- [JsonViewer](/components/data-display/json-viewer): Collapsible, keyboard-navigable tree for inspecting any JS/JSON value with type-coloured leaves and copy-path. (Code and data)
- [Card](/components/data-display/card): Surface that groups related content, with header, content and footer parts. (Containers)
- [FlowCanvas](/components/data-display/flow-canvas): Interactive node and edge canvas: drag nodes, connect ports with the pointer or the keyboard, pan, zoom, undo, auto layout and a text alternative, drawn as one SVG with no extra dependency. (Diagrams)
- [MermaidDiagram](/components/data-display/mermaid-diagram): Draws Mermaid text (flowchart, sequence, pie, state, entity relationship, class, gantt, mindmap, timeline, journey) as an accessible SVG, with its own parser and layout and no extra dependency. (Diagrams)
- [Tree](/components/data-display/tree): Keyboard-navigable expandable tree with single selection, sizes, compact density, checkboxes, connector lines and a boxed variant. (Hierarchy)
- [ActivityFeed](/components/data-display/activity-feed): Chronological list of who did what to which thing and when, with relative times, day groups, expandable details and a load more button. (Lists)
- [DescriptionList](/components/data-display/description-list): Semantic term/definition pairs (`dl`) for showing record details, with optional copy buttons. (Lists)
- [List](/components/data-display/list): Vertical list of rows with leading/trailing slots, dividers and optional interactivity. (Lists)

# Button
group: primitives / Buttons
Triggers an action or navigation. The single button used everywhere in the system.

Use `Button` for any clickable action. Variations:

- `variant`: emphasis. `default` is the primary action (at most one per view); `secondary` and `outline` for supporting actions; `soft` is a low-emphasis tinted primary (toolbars, inline "Add" actions, cards); `ghost` for dense toolbars; `link` for inline text actions; `destructive` / `success` for irreversible / confirming actions.
- `size`: density (`xs` ... `lg`); `icon*` sizes are square for icon-only buttons (ALWAYS set `aria-label`).
- `rounded`: `default` (rounded-md), `full` (pill, or a circle with `icon*` sizes), `none`.
- `block`: full-width button for forms, cards and mobile layouts.
- `iconStart` / `iconEnd` (or the `icon-start` / `icon-end` slots): icon placement around the label; while `loading` the spinner replaces the start icon.

To make a link look like a button use `as="a"` or `as-child` with a RouterLink.

import { Button } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- variant: 'default' | 'secondary' | 'outline' | 'ghost' | 'link' | 'destructive' | 'success' | 'soft' = 'default' - Visual emphasis. `soft` is a tinted low-emphasis primary. Unknown values fall back to default.
- size: 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'icon' | 'icon-xs' | 'icon-sm' | 'icon-lg' = 'md' - Height/padding. `icon*` sizes are square. Unknown values fall back to md.
- rounded: 'default' | 'full' | 'none' = 'default' - Corner radius: rounded-md, rounded-full (pill / circle for icon sizes) or none. Unknown values fall back to default.
- block: boolean = false - Adds `w-full` so the button fills its container.
- iconStart: IconDefinition - Icon before the label (decorative, aria-hidden). Replaced by the spinner while `loading`. Ignored with `asChild`.
- iconEnd: IconDefinition - Icon after the label (decorative, aria-hidden). Ignored with `asChild`.
- as: string | Component = 'button' - Element to render. Non-button elements get aria-disabled instead of disabled.
- asChild: boolean = false - Render the single slot child instead of a wrapper (reka-ui).
- type: 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset' = 'button' - Native button type. Defaults to button so it never submits forms by accident.
- disabled: boolean = false - Disables interaction.
- loadingIndicator: 'ring' | 'dots' | 'bars' | 'pulse' | 'orbit' = 'ring' - Spinner shape shown while `loading` (see `Spinner` `variant`). The spinner stays decorative; the label stays the accessible name. Unknown values fall back to `ring`.
- loading: boolean = false - Shows a decorative spinner, sets aria-busy, blocks clicks, keeps width. The label stays in the accessible name.
- class: string | object | array - Merged last with tailwind-merge; wins over internal classes.

Slots:
- default - Label and/or icons.
- icon-start - Custom content before the label; overrides `iconStart`. Hidden while `loading`.
- icon-end - Custom content after the label; overrides `iconEnd`.

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when a Button with `size` `icon`, `icon-xs`, `icon-sm` or `icon-lg` has no accessible name (no visible text, `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`). Use IconButton for icon-only actions.

Rules:
- One `default` variant button per view; use `soft` for secondary tinted actions.
- Use `rounded="full"` for pills and circular icon buttons; use `block` instead of `class="w-full"`.
- Use `iconStart` / `iconEnd` for icons next to a label instead of putting an <Icon> in the default slot; icon-only buttons still need `aria-label`.
- Never nest interactive elements inside a Button.
- Use `as-child` with RouterLink for navigation, not onClick + router.push.

Accessibility:
- Native <button> semantics; Space/Enter activate.
- Icon-only buttons need aria-label.
- Icons from `iconStart` / `iconEnd` are decorative (aria-hidden); the label carries the meaning.
- loading sets aria-busy and shows an indeterminate progressbar named "Loading" (so the accessible name becomes "Loading Save"); non-button elements use aria-disabled.
- Target size: `xs` and `icon-xs` are 24px, `sm` 32px, `md` 36px, `lg` 44px; on coarse pointers `sm`, `md` and the icon sizes grow to 40px or 44px.
- Focus uses the shared ring (`focus-visible:ring-3`) plus a transparent outline, so it is visible in forced-colors mode. Labels are `whitespace-nowrap`: keep them short or wrap the button group (`flex-wrap`) so it reflows at 320px.

Example: Variants
```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
  <Button>Default</Button>
  <Button variant="secondary">Secondary</Button>
  <Button variant="outline">Outline</Button>
  <Button variant="ghost">Ghost</Button>
  <Button variant="link">Link</Button>
  <Button variant="destructive">Delete</Button>
  <Button variant="success">Approve</Button>
  <Button variant="soft">Soft</Button>
</div>
```

Example: Soft variant
```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
  <Button variant="soft">Add item</Button>
  <Button variant="soft" size="sm" :icon-start="faPlus">Add another item</Button>
  <Button variant="soft" disabled>Disabled</Button>
</div>
```

Example: Sizes and icons
```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
  <Button size="xs">XS</Button>
  <Button size="sm">SM</Button>
  <Button>MD</Button>
  <Button size="lg">LG</Button>
  <Button size="icon" aria-label="Add"><Icon :icon="faPlus" /></Button>
</div>
```

Example: Rounded (pill)
```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
  <Button rounded="default">Default</Button>
  <Button rounded="full">Pill</Button>
  <Button rounded="full" variant="outline">Pill outline</Button>
  <Button rounded="none" variant="secondary">Square</Button>
  <Button rounded="full" size="icon" aria-label="Add"><Icon :icon="faPlus" /></Button>
</div>
```

Example: Block (full width)
```vue
<div class="flex w-full max-w-64 flex-col gap-2">
  <Button block>Continue</Button>
  <Button block variant="outline">Cancel</Button>
</div>
```

Example: Icon placement
```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
  <Button :icon-start="faPlus">New item</Button>
  <Button variant="outline" :icon-end="faArrowRight">Next</Button>
  <Button variant="secondary" :icon-start="faDownload" :icon-end="faArrowRight">Both</Button>
  <Button variant="soft">
    <template #icon-start><Icon :icon="faPlus" size="sm" /></template>
    Slot icon
  </Button>
</div>
```

Example: Loading indicator
```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
  <Button loading loading-indicator="dots">Saving</Button>
  <Button loading loading-indicator="bars" variant="outline">Exporting</Button>
  <Button loading loading-indicator="orbit" variant="secondary">Syncing</Button>
</div>
```

Example: Loading
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const saving = ref(false)
function save() { saving.value = true; setTimeout(() => (saving.value = false), 1500) }
</script>

<Button :loading="saving" :icon-start="faPlus" @click="save">Save changes</Button>
```

# IconButton
group: primitives / Buttons
Square icon-only Button with a required accessible label and tooltip title.

Use `IconButton` for toolbar and row actions that show only an icon. `label` is REQUIRED: it becomes `aria-label` and the native `title` tooltip. It composes `Button`, so `variant`, `loading`, `disabled`, `as` and `type` behave identically. Size names `xs|sm|md|lg|xl` are mapped to the square `icon-*` sizes. Defaults to the `ghost` variant.

**Sizes** (`size`): `xs` 24px, `sm` 32px, `md` 36px (44px on coarse pointers), `lg` 44px and `xl` 48px. `xs` is the smallest allowed target (24px); prefer `sm` or larger for the main action of a row. **Shape** (`shape`): `rounded` (default, rounded-md), `circle` (fully round, for floating and avatar-like actions) and `square` (no rounding, for dense toolbars). The button is always square, so a pill shape would be a circle. Unknown `size` and `shape` values fall back to `icon` (md) and `rounded`. `iconButtonVariants` returns the same classes for a plain `a` or `button`.

import { IconButton } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- label*: string - Accessible name: used for aria-label and title.
- icon: IconDefinition - FontAwesome icon. Omit when using the default slot.
- variant: 'default' | 'secondary' | 'outline' | 'ghost' | 'link' | 'destructive' | 'success' | 'soft' = 'ghost' - Button variant. Unknown values fall back to default (the Button rule).
- size: 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' | 'icon' | 'icon-xs' | 'icon-sm' | 'icon-lg' = 'icon' - Square size: xs 24px, sm 32px, md 36px (44px on coarse pointers), lg 44px, xl 48px; icon, icon-xs, icon-sm and icon-lg are the Button sizes. Unknown values fall back to icon.
- shape: 'rounded' | 'circle' | 'square' = 'rounded' - Corner shape: rounded-md, fully round or square corners. Unknown values fall back to rounded.
- as: string | Component = 'button' - Element to render.
- type: 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset' = 'button' - Native button type.
- disabled: boolean = false - Disables interaction.
- loadingIndicator: 'ring' | 'dots' | 'bars' | 'pulse' | 'orbit' = 'ring' - Spinner shape shown while `loading` (see `Spinner` `variant`). Unknown values fall back to `ring`.
- loading: boolean = false - Replaces the icon with a spinner, sets aria-busy, blocks clicks.
- class: string | object | array - Merged last with tailwind-merge; wins over internal classes.

Slots:
- default - Custom icon content replacing `icon`. Hidden while loading.

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when `label` is missing or blank.
- Throws a ContractError when there is neither an `icon` nor default slot content.

Rules:
- ALWAYS provide `label`; it is required.
- Use IconButton instead of Button size="icon" + manual aria-label.
- Use `shape="circle"` for round actions; there is no pill shape because the button is square. Use `size="xl"` for large touch actions.
- Prefer `icon` prop with a FontAwesome IconDefinition over inline SVG.

Accessibility:
- `label` provides both aria-label and a visible tooltip (title) for pointer users.
- Every size and shape keeps the required `label` (aria-label and title) and a target of at least 24px; `md` grows to 44px on coarse pointers and `lg` and `xl` are already 44px or more. Shape changes only the corner radius, so the focus ring and the hit area are the same.
- Inherits Button semantics: Space/Enter, aria-busy while loading, disabled blocks clicks.

Example: Variants and sizes
```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
  <IconButton label="Add" :icon="faPlus" />
  <IconButton label="Settings" :icon="faGear" variant="outline" />
  <IconButton label="Add" :icon="faPlus" variant="default" size="sm" />
  <IconButton label="Delete" :icon="faTrash" variant="destructive" size="lg" />
  <IconButton label="Unavailable" :icon="faGear" disabled />
</div>
```

Example: Loading indicator
```vue
<div class="flex gap-2">
  <IconButton label="Save" :icon="faPlus" variant="outline" loading loading-indicator="dots" />
  <IconButton label="Refresh" :icon="faPlus" variant="outline" loading loading-indicator="orbit" />
</div>
```

Example: Loading
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const busy = ref(false)
function run() { busy.value = true; setTimeout(() => (busy.value = false), 1500) }
</script>

<IconButton label="Save" :icon="faPlus" variant="outline" :loading="busy" @click="run" />
```

Example: Sizes
```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
  <IconButton label="Extra small" :icon="faPlus" variant="outline" size="xs" />
  <IconButton label="Small" :icon="faPlus" variant="outline" size="sm" />
  <IconButton label="Medium" :icon="faPlus" variant="outline" size="md" />
  <IconButton label="Large" :icon="faPlus" variant="outline" size="lg" />
  <IconButton label="Extra large" :icon="faPlus" variant="outline" size="xl" />
</div>
```

Example: Shapes
```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
  <IconButton label="Rounded" :icon="faGear" variant="outline" shape="rounded" />
  <IconButton label="Circle" :icon="faGear" variant="outline" shape="circle" />
  <IconButton label="Square" :icon="faGear" variant="outline" shape="square" />
  <IconButton label="Rounded, filled" :icon="faPlus" variant="default" shape="rounded" />
  <IconButton label="Circle, filled" :icon="faPlus" variant="default" shape="circle" size="lg" />
  <IconButton label="Square, soft" :icon="faTrash" variant="soft" shape="square" size="sm" />
</div>
```

# Chip
group: primitives / Chips
Compact tag that can be removable and/or selectable (toggle).

Use `Chip` for tags, filters and selected values. `removable` adds a remove button (and Backspace/Delete on the focused chip) that emits `remove` - you remove the item from your data. `selectable` turns the label into a toggle button bound with `v-model:selected`. Do not use it for status labels with no interaction (use `Badge`).

Variations: `variant` (fixed-colour looks plus tone-aware `soft`, `solid`, `outline`), `tone` (`neutral | primary | success | warning | danger | info`, used by `soft` / `solid` / `outline`), `size` (`sm | md | lg`), `rounded` (`full` pill default, `md`, `none`), and the `selected` state for filter chips.

import { Chip } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- variant: 'default' | 'secondary' | 'outline' | 'primary' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'destructive' | 'info' | 'soft' | 'solid' = 'default' - Look. `soft`, `solid` and `outline` are tone-aware. Unknown values fall back to default.
- tone: 'neutral' | 'primary' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger' | 'info' - Semantic colour for `soft` / `solid` / `outline`. Unset = neutral (soft, solid) or plain outline. Ignored by other variants and when unknown.
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = 'md' - Padding and text size. Unknown values fall back to md.
- rounded: 'full' | 'md' | 'none' = 'full' - Corner radius: pill (rounded-full), rounded-md or none. Unknown values fall back to full.
- label: string - Chip text (default slot overrides it); also names the remove button.
- icon: IconDefinition - Leading FontAwesome icon. Use the `leading` slot for other content.
- removable: boolean = false - Show remove button and enable Backspace/Delete.
- selectable: boolean = false - Render the label as a toggle button with aria-pressed.
- selected: boolean = false - Toggle state, use `v-model:selected`. Works controlled and uncontrolled.
- disabled: boolean = false - Blocks selection, removal and keyboard shortcuts.
- as: string | Component = 'span' - Element to render.
- class: string | object | array - Merged last with tailwind-merge; wins over internal classes.

Slots:
- default - Chip content; defaults to `label`.
- leading - Content before the label (icon, avatar, dot). Defaults to the `icon` prop.

Events:
- remove [] - Remove button clicked or Backspace/Delete pressed on a removable chip.
- update:selected [value: boolean] - Selection toggled (v-model:selected).

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when a `removable` Chip has no non-empty `label` (it names the remove button).
- Throws a ContractError when a `selectable` Chip has no text (`label` or default slot).

Rules:
- Always set `label` on removable chips so the remove button is named.
- Handle `@remove` by deleting the item from your data; the chip does not hide itself.
- Use `v-model:selected`, not `modelValue`.
- Use `variant="soft"` + `tone` for tags, `outline` for filter chips, `solid` for strong emphasis; `tone` is ignored by the fixed-colour variants.

Accessibility:
- Selectable chips render a native button with aria-pressed (Tab to focus, Space/Enter to toggle).
- A removable, non-selectable chip is a focusable `group` named by `label`: Backspace or Delete removes it (`aria-keyshortcuts`). The remove button has aria-label "Remove <label>" and stays out of the tab order, but screen-reader and touch users can still activate it.
- The remove button is at least 24x24px (WCAG 2.5.8) even on the small chip: it extends past the chip with negative margins instead of growing it.
- A selected chip adds a primary ring; the ring is also drawn in forced-colors mode through the focus outline, and `aria-pressed` carries the state so colour is not the only signal.
- Disabled chips set `data-disabled` and disable inner buttons (a role-less span takes no aria-disabled).

Example: Variants
```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
  <Chip label="Default" />
  <Chip label="Secondary" variant="secondary" />
  <Chip label="Outline" variant="outline" />
  <Chip label="Primary" variant="primary" />
  <Chip label="Success" variant="success" />
  <Chip label="Warning" variant="warning" />
  <Chip label="Destructive" variant="destructive" />
  <Chip label="Info" variant="info" :icon="faStar" />
</div>
```

Example: Soft tones
```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
  <Chip label="Neutral" variant="soft" />
  <Chip label="Primary" variant="soft" tone="primary" />
  <Chip label="Success" variant="soft" tone="success" />
  <Chip label="Warning" variant="soft" tone="warning" />
  <Chip label="Danger" variant="soft" tone="danger" />
  <Chip label="Info" variant="soft" tone="info" />
</div>
```

Example: Solid tones
```vue

  <Chip label="Neutral" variant="solid" />
  <Chip label="Primary" variant="solid" tone="primary" />
  <Chip label="Success" variant="solid" tone="success" />
  <Chip label="Warning" variant="solid" tone="warning" />
  <Chip label="Danger" variant="solid" tone="danger" />
  <Chip label="Info" variant="solid" tone="info" />
```


Example: Removable tags
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const tags = ref(['Vue', 'Tailwind', 'Vite'])
function remove(t) { tags.value = tags.value.filter((x) => x !== t) }
</script>

<div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
  <Chip v-for="t in tags" :key="t" :label="t" removable @remove="remove(t)" />
</div>
```

# ShowMore
group: primitives / Disclosure
Collapses long content to a number of lines or a height and shows a Show more toggle only when it overflows.

Use `ShowMore` for descriptions, notes and comment bodies that can be long: show the first lines and let the reader expand the rest in place. It measures the content with a `ResizeObserver` after mount and on every resize, so the toggle appears only when something is actually clipped. Short content renders without a toggle. There is no fade or gradient. For a titled section that always has a trigger use `Collapsible` or `Accordion`; to truncate a single line with no way to expand use `Text` with `truncate`.

Variations:

- `lines` (1 to 6) clamps by line count; `maxHeight` (`xs` 64px, `sm` 96px, `md` 128px, `lg` 192px, `xl` 256px) clamps by height and wins over `lines`.
- `layout`: toggle `below` the content (default) or `inline`, beside it at the last line.
- `align`: `start`, `center` or `end` for the `below` layout (logical, so right-to-left flips it).
- `appearance`: `link` (default), `button`, `outline`. `size`: `sm`, `md`, `lg`.
- `moreLabel` and `lessLabel`, or the `more` and `less` slots, change the toggle text. `icon` hides the chevron.

State: `v-model:expanded` works controlled and uncontrolled. The `overflow` event reports when the collapsed content starts or stops overflowing.

The server render and the first client render are the collapsed content without a toggle; the toggle appears after mount, once the content has been measured. Nothing animates by default.

import { ShowMore } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- lines: number = 3 - Lines shown while collapsed, 1 to 6. Fractions are truncated; not a number or below 1 falls back to 3; above 6 is 6.
- maxHeight: 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' - Clamp to a height preset (64px, 96px, 128px, 192px, 256px at the default spacing) instead of lines. Wins over `lines`. Unknown values are ignored.
- layout: 'below' | 'inline' = 'below' - Toggle below the content, or beside it at its last line. Unknown values fall back to below.
- align: 'start' | 'center' | 'end' = 'start' - Toggle position in the `below` layout. Unknown values fall back to start. No effect with `layout="inline"`.
- appearance: 'link' | 'button' | 'outline' = 'link' - Toggle look. Unknown values fall back to link.
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = 'md' - Toggle size (24px, 32px, 40px minimum height; 44px on coarse pointers). Unknown values fall back to md.
- moreLabel: string = 'Show more' - Toggle text while collapsed. A blank value throws a ContractError unless the `more` slot is used.
- lessLabel: string = 'Show less' - Toggle text while expanded. A blank value throws a ContractError unless the `less` slot is used.
- icon: boolean = true - Show a chevron that turns over when expanded.
- expanded: boolean = false - Expanded state, bound with `v-model:expanded`. Uncontrolled when not passed.
- as: string | Component = 'div' - Element to render as the root.
- class: string | object | array - Merged last with tailwind-merge; wins over internal classes.

Slots:
- default - The content to collapse.
- more - Toggle text while collapsed. Replaces `moreLabel`.
- less - Toggle text while expanded. Replaces `lessLabel`.

Events:
- update:expanded [expanded: boolean] - The toggle was used. Drives `v-model:expanded`.
- overflow [overflowing: boolean] - The collapsed content started (true) or stopped (false) overflowing, after a measurement.

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when `moreLabel` or `lessLabel` is blank (and the matching `more` or `less` slot is not used), because the toggle needs visible text.

Rules:
- Wrap only the content to collapse; do not add your own toggle button or `v-if` on overflow, `ShowMore` measures and renders the toggle itself.
- Use `lines` for text and `maxHeight` for mixed content. Never set clamp classes yourself; the values are lookups of literal classes.
- Keep `moreLabel` and `lessLabel` non-blank and specific when several `ShowMore` are on one page ("Show full note").
- Use `v-model:expanded` for controlled state; listen to `overflow` only when something else depends on whether the content is clipped.
- Do not put interactive elements, headings or landmarks in the part that can be clipped.
- Expect no toggle on the server and on first paint: it appears after mount. Do not test for it before the component is mounted.

Accessibility:
- The toggle is a native `button` with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` pointing at the content element, and its visible text (`Show more` / `Show less`) is its accessible name. Enter and Space activate it.
- The toggle is only rendered when the content overflows, so there is never a control that does nothing. Content that already fits has no extra tab stop.
- Collapsed content is clipped, not removed: text stays in the accessibility tree, so screen readers read all of it. Links or buttons inside the clipped part stay focusable; keep interactive elements out of the part that can be hidden.
- The toggle is at least 24px tall (the style packs keep this floor) and 44px on coarse pointers; focus uses the shared ring, which also shows in forced-colors mode.
- No gradient fade and no height animation by default. The chevron turns only with `motion-safe:`, so reduced-motion users see it change instantly.
- Logical properties only: the toggle aligns to the start or end side and flips in right-to-left text. Long words wrap (`break-words`), so the content reflows at 320px without horizontal scroll.
- Focus is not moved on toggle; when the toggle disappears because the content now fits, focus returns to the page body. Keep expanded state in `v-model:expanded` if the content can change length.

# Avatar
group: primitives / Display
Shows a user or entity as an image with an initials fallback and an optional status dot.

Use `Avatar` wherever a person, team or workspace is identified visually. Pass `src` and `name`: if the image is missing or fails to load, initials derived from `name` are shown instead. Variations: `shape` (`circle`, `rounded`, `square`), `size` (`xs` to `2xl`), `status` presence dot with `statusPosition` (any of the four corners) and a decorative `ring` (e.g. the current user or a story). To stack several avatars use `AvatarGroup`. Do not use it for arbitrary thumbnails (use a plain `<img>`).

import { Avatar } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- src: string - Image URL. Load failure falls back to initials; changing `src` retries.
- alt: string - Alternative text. Defaults to `name`. Required unless `name` is set; `alt=""` marks the avatar decorative (the person is named in text beside it).
- name: string - Full name. First letter of the first and last word become the initials, and it labels the avatar.
- fallback: string - Text shown instead of derived initials (e.g. `+3`).
- size: 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' | '2xl' = 'md' (or the AvatarGroup size) - size-6 / 8 / 10 / 12 / 16 / 24. Unknown values fall back to md.
- shape: 'circle' | 'rounded' | 'square' = 'circle' (or the AvatarGroup shape) - rounded-full, rounded-xl or rounded-md. Unknown values fall back to circle.
- ring: 'none' | 'border' | 'primary' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger' | 'info' | boolean = 'none' - Decorative 2px ring with an offset gap. `true` = primary. Unknown values draw no ring. Inside an AvatarGroup the group ring styling takes precedence visually; set `ring` on standalone avatars.
- status: 'neutral' | 'primary' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger' | 'info' - Draws a small status dot (bottom-right by default). Unknown values draw nothing.
- statusPosition: 'bottom-right' | 'bottom-left' | 'top-right' | 'top-left' = 'bottom-right' - Corner of the status dot. Unknown values fall back to bottom-right.
- statusLabel: string - Accessible label of the dot; defaults to the status name.
- as: string | Component = 'span' - Element to render.
- blurred: boolean - Privacy blur for screen sharing, demos and sensitive uploads. Blurs the image and the initials (they identify the person too); the status dot stays sharp. Wins over `ConfigProvider blurMedia` and over an AvatarGroup, true or false. Undefined (default) inherits, then falls back to false. There is no reveal control: the avatar is too small.
- class: string | object | array - Merged last with tailwind-merge; wins over internal classes.

Slots:
- default - Custom fallback content (icon, text) shown when there is no image. Replaces initials.

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when an Avatar has neither `name` nor `alt` (`alt=""` marks it decorative and is accepted).

Rules:
- Use `blurred` (or `ConfigProvider blurMedia`) for privacy, never as decoration. It blurs the initials as well as the image.
- Always pass `name` (even with `src`) so the fallback and label work.
- Do not hard-code size via width/height classes; use the `size` prop.
- Use `statusPosition` and `ring` instead of absolutely positioning your own dots or ring classes.
- Do not nest Avatars manually for stacks; use AvatarGroup.

Accessibility:
- Blur is visual only: the `alt`, the accessible name and the status text are unchanged, and the root gets `data-blurred` as a styling and test hook. Do not rely on it to hide a name from assistive technology; pass `alt=""` or omit `name` where the person must not be named.
- With an image: renders `<img alt>` (alt falls back to name).
- Without an image the root gets role="img" with aria-label = alt or name; the initials are aria-hidden so they are not read as letters.
- The status dot is decorative (aria-hidden). Because role="img" hides its children from assistive tech, the status text is folded into the avatar's own name ("Author One, online"; override the text with `statusLabel`), so colour is never the only signal.
- The avatar is not interactive. Wrap it in a Button or Link (with its own name) when it should be clickable; do not rely on the avatar for the control name.

Example: Image, initials and sizes
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const portrait = samplePortrait()
</script>

<div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
  <Avatar :src="portrait" name="Author One" size="xs" />
  <Avatar name="Author Two" size="sm" />
  <Avatar name="Author Five" />
  <Avatar :src="portrait" name="Author Three" size="lg" />
  <Avatar name="Author Four" size="xl" shape="square" />
  <Avatar src="data:," name="Broken Image" />
</div>
```

Example: Shapes
```vue

  <Avatar name="Author One" shape="circle" />
  <Avatar name="Author Two" shape="rounded" />
  <Avatar name="Author Five" shape="square" />
</div>
```

Example: All sizes
```vue

  <Avatar name="Author One" size="xs" />

  <Avatar name="Author One" size="md" />
```

# AvatarGroup
group: primitives / Display
Overlapping stack of avatars with a +N overflow bubble.

Use `AvatarGroup` to show participants, assignees or members compactly. Provide data with `items`, or compose `Avatar` children in the default slot (both can be combined; items come first). `max` limits how many avatars are shown; the rest collapse into a `+N` bubble. `size` and `shape` apply to every avatar that does not set its own.

**Layout** (`layout`): `stacked` (default) overlaps the avatars and separates them with a background-coloured ring; `spaced` puts them side by side with a gap and wraps to a new line, so it suits narrow containers and avatars that carry a status dot or their own `ring`. **Density** (`density`): `compact`, `default` or `loose`. In a stacked group it sets how far the avatars overlap (the steps follow `size`); in a spaced group it sets the gap (4px, 8px, 12px). Unknown values fall back to `stacked` and `default`.

import { AvatarGroup } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- items: AvatarGroupItem[] = [] - Avatars as data: `{ src?, name?, alt?, fallback?, status? }`.
- max: number - Maximum avatars shown, counting items and slot children. Omit (or negative/NaN) for no limit; fractions are floored; 0 shows only the bubble.
- size: 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' | '2xl' = 'md' - Size for every avatar and the overlap spacing. Unknown values fall back to md.
- shape: 'circle' | 'rounded' | 'square' = 'circle' - Shape inherited by avatars and the overflow bubble. Unknown values fall back to circle.
- layout: 'stacked' | 'spaced' = 'stacked' - stacked overlaps the avatars with a background ring between them; spaced places them side by side with a gap and wraps. Unknown values fall back to stacked.
- density: 'compact' | 'default' | 'loose' = 'default' - Stacked: overlap amount (compact overlaps more, loose less). Spaced: gap of 4px, 8px or 12px. Unknown values fall back to default.
- as: string | Component = 'div' - Element to render.
- blurred: boolean - Privacy blur on every avatar (image and initials). The `+N` count is not blurred. Wins over `ConfigProvider blurMedia`; an Avatar with its own `blurred` keeps it, true or false.
- class: string | object | array - Merged last with tailwind-merge; wins over internal classes.

Slots:
- default - `Avatar` children. Fragments from v-for are flattened and v-if=false nodes ignored when counting for `max`.

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when an item (or a slotted Avatar) has neither `name` nor `alt`, because every avatar must say who it is.

Rules:
- Use `blurred` for privacy (screen sharing, demos). The `+N` bubble stays readable.
- Prefer `items` for data-driven lists, slot children when avatars need extra props.
- Set `max` so long lists do not overflow the layout.
- Give the group an aria-label.
- Use layout="spaced" when avatars carry status dots or rings, or in narrow containers; keep the default stacked layout for compact "who is here" rows.

Accessibility:
- Blur is visual only: names, alt text and the `+N` label are unchanged; the root gets `data-blurred`.
- Root has role="group"; add `aria-label` (e.g. "Project members").
- The overflow bubble is role="img" with aria-label "N more".
- `layout` and `density` change spacing only; the group role, names and the +N bubble stay the same. `spaced` uses `flex-wrap`, so the group reflows at 320px instead of overflowing, and it draws no overlap ring.
- The `stacked` ring is a box shadow, which forced-colors mode removes, so each avatar also gets a 2px `CanvasText` outline there (`forced-colors:[&>*]:outline-2`) and overlapping avatars stay distinct. `layout="spaced"` needs neither.

Example: Items with overflow
```vue
<AvatarGroup
  :max="3"
  :items="[
    { name: 'Author One' },
    { name: 'Author Two' },
    { name: 'Author Five' },
    { name: 'Author Three' },
    { name: 'Author Four' },
  ]"
/>
```

Example: Slot children, size and shape
```vue
<div class="flex flex-col gap-4">
  <AvatarGroup size="sm" :max="2">
    <Avatar name="Author One" status="success" />
    <Avatar name="Author Two" />
    <Avatar name="Author Five" />
  </AvatarGroup>
  <AvatarGroup size="lg" shape="square">
    <Avatar name="Author One" />
    <Avatar name="Author Two" />
  </AvatarGroup>
</div>
```

Example: Rounded shape and 2xl size
```vue
<div class="flex flex-col gap-4">
  <AvatarGroup shape="rounded" :max="3" :items="[{ name: 'Author One' }, { name: 'Author Two' }, { name: 'Author Five' }, { name: 'Author Three' }]" />
  <AvatarGroup size="2xl" :items="[{ name: 'Author One' }, { name: 'Author Two' }]" />
</div>
```

Example: Spaced layout
```vue
<div class="flex flex-col gap-4">
  <AvatarGroup layout="spaced" aria-label="Spaced members" :items="[{ name: 'Author One', status: 'success' }, { name: 'Author Two' }, { name: 'Author Five', status: 'warning' }]" />
  <AvatarGroup layout="spaced" shape="rounded" :max="3" aria-label="Spaced members, limited" :items="[{ name: 'Author One' }, { name: 'Author Two' }, { name: 'Author Five' }, { name: 'Author Three' }, { name: 'Author Four' }]" />
</div>
```

Example: Density
```vue
<div class="flex flex-col gap-4">
  <AvatarGroup density="compact" aria-label="Compact stack" :items="[{ name: 'Author One' }, { name: 'Author Two' }, { name: 'Author Five' }]" />
  <AvatarGroup density="default" aria-label="Default stack" :items="[{ name: 'Author One' }, { name: 'Author Two' }, { name: 'Author Five' }]" />
  <AvatarGroup density="loose" aria-label="Loose stack" :items="[{ name: 'Author One' }, { name: 'Author Two' }, { name: 'Author Five' }]" />
  <AvatarGroup layout="spaced" density="compact" aria-label="Compact gap" :items="[{ name: 'Author One' }, { name: 'Author Two' }, { name: 'Author Five' }]" />
  <AvatarGroup layout="spaced" density="loose" size="sm" aria-label="Loose gap" :items="[{ name: 'Author One' }, { name: 'Author Two' }, { name: 'Author Five' }]" />
</div>
```

Example: Privacy blur
```vue
<div class="flex flex-col gap-4">
  <AvatarGroup blurred :max="3" aria-label="Meeting participants, blurred" :items="[{ name: 'Author One' }, { name: 'Author Two' }, { name: 'Author Five' }, { name: 'Author Three' }, { name: 'Author Four' }]" />
  <AvatarGroup blurred layout="spaced" aria-label="Presenter stays visible">
    <Avatar name="Author One" :blurred="false" />
    <Avatar name="Author Two" />
    <Avatar name="Author Five" />
  </AvatarGroup>
</div>
```

# Icon
group: primitives / Display
Inline SVG renderer for FontAwesome-shaped icon data, decorative by default.

Use `Icon` to draw any `IconDefinition` (`{ icon: [width, height, , , path] }`) as inline SVG. No FontAwesome runtime is loaded. Library code imports icons from `lib/icons`; an app can pass icons from `@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons`. The icon takes the text colour (`fill-current`) and a size from the scale.

An icon is decorative unless it has a `label`. Put meaning in visible text; use `label` only for an icon that stands alone. For a clickable icon use `IconButton`, not an `Icon` with a handler.

import { Icon } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- icon: IconDefinition - Required. FontAwesome-shaped icon data. An invalid definition renders nothing and raises a ContractError in strict mode.
- size: 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' = 'md' - Size: 12, 14, 16, 20 or 24px. Unknown values fall back to md.
- spin: boolean = false - Rotate continuously. Slows to a pulse under reduced motion.
- label: string - Accessible name. When set the SVG is `role="img"` with this `aria-label`; without it the SVG is `aria-hidden`.
- class: string | object | array - Merged last with tailwind-merge; wins over internal classes.

Rules:
- Import icon data and pass it as `:icon`; never inline SVG paths in a template.
- Leave `label` off when text sits next to the icon. Set it only when the icon is the whole message.
- Use `IconButton` with a `label` for an icon you can click.

Accessibility:
- Without `label` the SVG is `aria-hidden="true"` and `focusable="false"`: it is invisible to assistive tech, so the text next to it must carry the meaning.
- With `label` the SVG is `role="img"` with `aria-label`.
- Never rely on an icon alone to show state: pair it with text.
- `spin` respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.

Example: Sizes and colour
```vue
<div class="flex items-center gap-4 text-foreground">
  <Icon :icon="faGear" size="xs" />
  <Icon :icon="faGear" size="sm" />
  <Icon :icon="faGear" />
  <Icon :icon="faGear" size="lg" class="text-primary" />
  <Icon :icon="faGear" size="xl" class="text-muted-foreground" />
</div>
```

Example: Decorative and labelled
```vue
<div class="flex flex-col gap-3 text-sm">
  <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-2"><Icon :icon="faCircleCheck" class="text-success" /> Backup finished</span>
  <Icon :icon="faBell" label="Notifications are on" />
</div>
```

Example: Spinning
```vue
<Icon :icon="faGear" spin size="lg" class="text-muted-foreground" />
```

# Kbd
group: primitives / Display
Keyboard key chip (`<kbd>`) and a group that joins keys with a separator.

Use `Kbd` to show a single key and `KbdGroup` for shortcuts made of several keys. `KbdGroup` takes either a `keys` array or `Kbd` children and can draw a `separator` (`+`, `then`) between them.

Variations:

- `variant`: `default` (muted fill with border), `outline` (border only, for use on tinted surfaces), `ghost` (no border or fill, for dense menus) and `solid` (inverted: foreground fill, background text, for tooltips and hints that need to stand out).
- `size`: `xs` (16px), `sm` (20px), `md` (24px, default), `lg` (28px). Pick the size that matches the surrounding text: `xs` or `sm` beside 12px text, `lg` beside headings.
- `KbdGroup` also takes `variant` and `size` for the chips it generates from `keys` (slotted `Kbd` children keep their own props) and `gap` (`none`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`) for the space between chips.

Keys are not interactive, so the 24px target size does not apply.

import { Kbd, KbdGroup } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- variant: 'default' | 'outline' | 'ghost' | 'solid' = 'default' - Surface: muted fill with border, border only, no border or fill, or inverted (foreground fill). Unknown values fall back to default.
- size: 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = 'md' - Chip height: h-4, h-5, h-6 or h-7. Unknown values fall back to md.
- as: string | Component = 'kbd' - Element to render.
- class: string | object | array - Merged last with tailwind-merge; wins over internal classes.

Parts:
- KbdGroup - Inline container that renders keys (from `keys` and/or slot) joined by an aria-hidden separator.
    - keys: string[] = [] - Keys rendered as `Kbd` chips before any slot children.
    - separator: string = '' - Text between keys; empty = none.
    - size: 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = 'md' - Size of chips generated from `keys` and of the separator text. Unknown values fall back to md.
    - variant: 'default' | 'outline' | 'ghost' | 'solid' = 'default' - Surface of chips generated from `keys`. Unknown values fall back to default.
    - gap: 'none' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = 'md' - Space between chips and separators: 0, 2px, 4px, 8px. Unknown values fall back to md.
    - as: string | Component = 'span' - Element to render.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last.

Slots:
- default - The key label (text, symbol or icon).

Rules:
- Match `size` to the surrounding text; use `variant="solid"` only where a key hint must stand out.
- Use KbdGroup with `keys` for multi-key shortcuts instead of several loose Kbd.
- Write modifier names consistently (Ctrl, Shift, Alt, Cmd).

Accessibility:
- Rendered as a native `<kbd>` element, which assistive tech exposes as keyboard input.
- Separators are aria-hidden so screen readers read the keys in sequence.
- Spell modifier keys as words (Cmd, Ctrl) rather than symbols so they are announced reliably.
- Keys are inline text: they wrap with the surrounding paragraph at 320px.
- Every variant keeps the key text readable: `default`, `outline` and `ghost` use muted-foreground, `solid` uses background on foreground (both are tested token pairs). The `xs` size is 11px text, so use it only beside equally small text.
- `ghost` and `solid` rely on a fill that forced-colors mode removes, so they keep a `forced-colors:border-current` border.

Example: Single keys
```vue
<p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Press <Kbd>Esc</Kbd> to close or <Kbd size="sm">?</Kbd> for help.</p>
```

Example: Shortcut groups
```vue
<div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
  <KbdGroup :keys="['Ctrl', 'K']" separator="+" />
  <KbdGroup separator="then"><Kbd>G</Kbd><Kbd>D</Kbd></KbdGroup>
  <KbdGroup :keys="['Cmd', 'Shift', 'P']" />
</div>
```

Example: Variants
```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
  <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5"><Kbd>Esc</Kbd> default</span>
  <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5"><Kbd variant="outline">Esc</Kbd> outline</span>
  <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5"><Kbd variant="ghost">Esc</Kbd> ghost</span>
  <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5"><Kbd variant="solid">Esc</Kbd> solid</span>
</div>
```

Example: Sizes
```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
  <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5"><Kbd size="xs">K</Kbd> xs</span>
  <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5"><Kbd size="sm">K</Kbd> sm</span>
  <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5"><Kbd size="md">K</Kbd> md</span>
  <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5"><Kbd size="lg">K</Kbd> lg</span>
</div>
```

Example: Group variations
```vue
<div class="flex flex-col items-start gap-2">
  <KbdGroup :keys="['Ctrl', 'K']" separator="+" variant="outline" />
  <KbdGroup :keys="['Ctrl', 'Shift', 'P']" separator="+" variant="solid" size="sm" />
  <KbdGroup :keys="['G', 'D']" separator="then" variant="ghost" size="lg" gap="lg" />
  <KbdGroup :keys="['Alt', 'Enter']" size="xs" gap="none" />
</div>
```
