# SegmentedControl
group: forms / Choice
Compact single choice (view switcher, range picker) built on a radiogroup, in pill, underline, outline or filled looks, horizontal or vertical.

Use `SegmentedControl` to switch between 2-5 mutually exclusive, short options that change how content is shown (List / Grid, Day / Week / Month). It looks like tabs but is a form control: it holds a value and does not own panels. Use `Tabs` for content navigation, `RadioGroup` for form answers that need descriptions, `Select` for long lists. Options come from the `options` array; override item content with the `option` slot. Works controlled (`v-model`) and uncontrolled (`default-value`).

import { SegmentedControl } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- options: Array<{ value: string; label: string; disabled?: boolean; icon?: IconDefinition }> = [] - Segments. `value` must be a non-empty string; `icon` is a FontAwesome IconDefinition shown before the label.
- modelValue: string - v-model: the selected option value. Uncontrolled when omitted.
- defaultValue: string - Initial value when uncontrolled.
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = 'md' - Segment height. Unknown values fall back to `md`.
- variant: 'pill' | 'underline' | 'outline' | 'filled' = 'pill' - `pill`: muted tray with a raised selected chip. `underline`: a rule with a marker under (or, vertical, beside) the selected segment. `outline`: bordered tray with a bordered selection. `filled`: muted tray with a solid selection. Unknown values fall back to `pill`.
- tone: 'default' | 'primary' | 'success' | 'danger' | 'neutral' | 'info' = 'default' - Colour of the selected segment. `default` keeps the neutral look of the variant (raised chip, or foreground ink). In `pill` and `filled` a tone fills the selected segment with that colour; in `underline` and `outline` it colours the marker or border. `neutral` is foreground on background. Unknown values fall back to `default`.
- orientation: 'horizontal' | 'vertical' = 'horizontal' - `vertical` stacks the segments in a column, left-aligned, and switches the arrow keys to Up and Down. Sets `aria-orientation`. Unknown values fall back to horizontal.
- fullWidth: boolean = false - Stretch to the container width. Horizontal segments share the width equally; vertical segments keep their height.
- disabled: boolean = false - Disables every segment. Also inherited from a surrounding Field.
- invalid: boolean = false - Sets `aria-invalid="true"` on the group. Also set by a Field with an error.
- name: string - Form field name; hidden inputs are rendered when inside a `<form>`.
- class: string | object | array - Merged last on the root; wins over internal classes.

Slots:
- option ({ option: SegmentedControlOption }) - Replaces the content (icon + label) of each segment.

Events:
- update:modelValue [value: string] - Emitted when the user selects a segment.

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when the control has no accessible name: no `Field` label, `Fieldset` legend, `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`.
- Throws a ContractError when an option has no text `label` (an icon alone does not count; with the `option` slot the slot must supply text).
- Throws a ContractError when an option `value` is missing, empty or used twice.

Rules:
- Use for 2-5 short options that change presentation; use Tabs when each option owns a content panel.
- Always label the control (`aria-label` or Field). Every option needs a text `label`.
- Pass `options` as data and bind with `v-model`; never nest your own radio markup.
- Pick `variant` for the look (pill, underline, outline, filled), `tone` for the selected colour (default is neutral) and `orientation="vertical"` for a column; use `segmentedControlVariants` / `segmentedControlItemVariants` to style custom elements the same way.

Accessibility:
- Root is `role="radiogroup"` with `role="radio"` segments and `aria-checked`. Name it with `aria-label`, or put it in a Field: the Field label then names it through `aria-labelledby`.
- Keyboard: roving tabindex, so Tab enters once; the arrow keys of the control axis move focus and select (Left and Right when horizontal, Up and Down when `orientation="vertical"`, which is also announced as `aria-orientation`); Home and End move focus to the ends; disabled segments are skipped.
- Icon-only segments still need a `label` (it is the accessible name); icons are decorative (`aria-hidden`).
- The selected segment is also marked in forced-colors mode (system colours); invalid draws a dashed border. Segments are 24px or taller (36px on touch pointers).
- Roles, names and keyboard behaviour are the same in every `variant` and `tone`: the selected segment carries `aria-checked` and `data-state="checked"`, and each variant marks it with a fill, border or underline, not colour alone. In forced-colors mode every variant uses the system highlight for the selected segment.
- Responsive: the control wraps onto more rows instead of overflowing at 320px.

Example: Basic
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const range = ref('week')
const options = [{ value: 'day', label: 'Day' }, { value: 'week', label: 'Week' }, { value: 'month', label: 'Month' }]
</script>

<div class="grid gap-2">
  <SegmentedControl v-model="range" :options="options" aria-label="Range" />
  <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Showing: {{ range }}</p>
</div>
```

Example: With icons, full width and a disabled option
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const view = ref('list')
const views = [{ value: 'list', label: 'List', icon: faList }, { value: 'grid', label: 'Grid', icon: faTableCells }, { value: 'map', label: 'Map', disabled: true }]
</script>

<SegmentedControl v-model="view" :options="views" full-width aria-label="View" class="max-w-md" />
```

Example: Sizes
```vue
<div class="grid justify-items-start gap-3">
  <SegmentedControl size="sm" default-value="a" aria-label="Small" :options="[{ value: 'a', label: 'One' }, { value: 'b', label: 'Two' }]" />
  <SegmentedControl default-value="a" aria-label="Medium" :options="[{ value: 'a', label: 'One' }, { value: 'b', label: 'Two' }]" />
  <SegmentedControl size="lg" default-value="a" aria-label="Large" :options="[{ value: 'a', label: 'One' }, { value: 'b', label: 'Two' }]" />
</div>
```

Example: Variants
```vue
<div class="grid justify-items-start gap-3">
  <SegmentedControl variant="pill" default-value="week" aria-label="Pill range" :options="[{ value: 'day', label: 'Day' }, { value: 'week', label: 'Week' }, { value: 'month', label: 'Month' }]" />
  <SegmentedControl variant="underline" default-value="week" aria-label="Underline range" :options="[{ value: 'day', label: 'Day' }, { value: 'week', label: 'Week' }, { value: 'month', label: 'Month' }]" />
  <SegmentedControl variant="outline" default-value="week" aria-label="Outline range" :options="[{ value: 'day', label: 'Day' }, { value: 'week', label: 'Week' }, { value: 'month', label: 'Month' }]" />
  <SegmentedControl variant="filled" default-value="week" aria-label="Filled range" :options="[{ value: 'day', label: 'Day' }, { value: 'week', label: 'Week' }, { value: 'month', label: 'Month' }]" />
</div>
```

Example: Tones
```vue
<div class="grid justify-items-start gap-3">
  <SegmentedControl tone="primary" default-value="b" aria-label="Primary tone" :options="[{ value: 'a', label: 'Off' }, { value: 'b', label: 'On' }]" />
  <SegmentedControl tone="success" default-value="b" aria-label="Success tone" :options="[{ value: 'a', label: 'Off' }, { value: 'b', label: 'On' }]" />
  <SegmentedControl tone="danger" default-value="b" aria-label="Danger tone" :options="[{ value: 'a', label: 'Off' }, { value: 'b', label: 'On' }]" />
  <SegmentedControl tone="neutral" default-value="b" aria-label="Neutral tone" :options="[{ value: 'a', label: 'Off' }, { value: 'b', label: 'On' }]" />
  <SegmentedControl tone="info" default-value="b" aria-label="Info tone" :options="[{ value: 'a', label: 'Off' }, { value: 'b', label: 'On' }]" />
  <SegmentedControl variant="underline" tone="success" default-value="b" aria-label="Underline success" :options="[{ value: 'a', label: 'Off' }, { value: 'b', label: 'On' }]" />
</div>
```

Example: Vertical orientation
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const section = ref('profile')
const sections = [{ value: 'profile', label: 'Profile' }, { value: 'billing', label: 'Billing' }, { value: 'team', label: 'Team' }]
</script>

<div class="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-6">
  <SegmentedControl v-model="section" orientation="vertical" :options="sections" aria-label="Settings section" />
  <SegmentedControl v-model="section" orientation="vertical" variant="underline" :options="sections" aria-label="Settings section, underline" />
  <SegmentedControl v-model="section" orientation="vertical" variant="outline" full-width :options="sections" aria-label="Settings section, full width" class="w-48" />
</div>
```

# Switch
group: forms / Choice
On/off toggle for settings that take effect immediately, with optional label and description, sizes, tones and on/off icons.

Use `Switch` for binary settings that apply right away (notifications, dark mode, feature flags). Use `Checkbox` when the choice is submitted later with a form or when several can be selected from a list. Give it a name with the `label` prop (or slot), which renders a `<label>` beside the switch, or place it in a `Field` (`orientation="horizontal"` is the idiomatic row layout), or set `aria-label`. `description` adds helper text under the label, `labelPosition="start"` moves the label before the switch, `tone` recolours the on state and `showIcons` draws a check or cross on the thumb. Works controlled (`v-model`) and uncontrolled (`default-value`).

import { Switch } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- modelValue: boolean | null - v-model value. Uncontrolled when omitted; `null` renders as off.
- defaultValue: boolean - Initial state when uncontrolled.
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = 'md' - Track and thumb size (28x16 / 36x20 / 44x24 px); the hit area is always at least 24px tall. Unknown values fall back to `md`.
- tone: 'primary' | 'success' | 'danger' | 'neutral' | 'info' = 'primary' - Colour of the on track. The off track is the same for every tone and the thumb always moves, so the state never rests on colour. Unknown values fall back to `primary`.
- showIcons: boolean = false - Draws a check on the thumb when on and a cross when off. The glyphs are decorative (`aria-hidden`); the name and `aria-checked` carry the state for assistive technology.
- onLabel: string - Short text inside the track while on (for example "On"). Decorative and `aria-hidden`: the accessible name stays the label and the state stays `aria-checked`. The track widens to hold it (56px at `md`, 64px at `lg`) and the off track becomes muted with an input border, so the text uses the tested tone-foreground and muted-foreground pairs. `sm` ignores it. About three characters fit; longer text is clipped.
- offLabel: string - Short text inside the track while off (for example "Off"). Same rules as `onLabel`. Either one can be used alone; the track still widens.
- label: string - Text rendered in a `<label for>` beside the switch. Use the `label` slot for rich content. Without a label the switch renders as the bare control, as before.
- description: string - Helper text under the label, referenced from the switch through `aria-describedby` (merged with Field hint and error ids). Shown only together with a label. Use the `description` slot for rich content.
- labelPosition: 'end' | 'start' = 'end' - Side of the label in reading order. `start` puts it before the switch and flips in right-to-left layouts. Only has an effect when a label is shown.
- disabled: boolean = false - Disables the switch. Also inherited from a surrounding Field.
- required: boolean = false - Sets `aria-required`. Also inherited from a surrounding Field.
- invalid: boolean = false - Sets `aria-invalid="true"`. Also set by a Field with an error.
- name: string - Form field name; a hidden input is rendered when inside a `<form>`.
- value: string - Value submitted with the form when on.
- id: string - Control id. Falls back to the surrounding Field id, then (with a label) a generated one. The label `for` always matches.
- class: string | object | array - Merged last on the track (`data-slot="switch"`); wins over internal classes.

Slots:
- label - Rich label content; replaces the `label` prop text.
- description - Rich helper text under the label; replaces the `description` prop. Needs a label to be shown.

Events:
- update:modelValue [value: boolean] - Emitted when the user toggles the switch.

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when the switch has no accessible name: no `label` (prop or slot), `Field` label, wrapping or `for` label, `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`.

Rules:
- Always label a Switch: pass `label`, or wrap in `Field` (prefer `orientation="horizontal"`), or pass `aria-label`.
- Use `description` for helper text (it needs a label) and `label-position="start"` to put the label first.
- Use `tone` (primary, success, danger, neutral, info) for the on colour and `show-icons` when the state must not rely on position and colour alone; do not recolour with classes.
- Use `v-model` with a boolean. Use Switch for immediate effects, Checkbox for deferred form values.
- Do not put text inside the Switch; it renders only the track and thumb (and an optional icon).

Accessibility:
- Button with `role="switch"` and `aria-checked`; Space and Enter toggle it, Tab moves on.
- The switch itself has no text: name it with `label` (a `<label for>` beside it), a Field label (`for`/`id` wiring) or `aria-label`. The state is the on or off value, not colour: the thumb also moves, and `showIcons` adds a check or cross.
- `description` is a `<p>` whose id is added to `aria-describedby` after any Field hint and error ids and an explicit `aria-describedby`; it is rendered only with a label. `labelPosition` changes visual order only; the switch stays first in the DOM, so reading and tab order are unchanged.
- `onLabel` / `offLabel` text is `aria-hidden`, so it never changes the accessible name; the state is still `aria-checked` and the thumb position. In forced-colors mode the text takes the system text colour on the system track. The thumb and text mirror in right-to-left layouts (the checked thumb moves towards the end side).
- Tones change colour only. Role, name and keyboard are identical for every variation; in forced-colors mode the track, thumb, border and glyphs use system colours and the thumb still moves.
- Inside a Field it receives `aria-describedby`, `aria-invalid` and disabled state automatically.
- Hit area is at least 24px tall through an invisible ::after (about 44px on touch pointers). Forced-colors mode uses system colours for the track, thumb and border; motion is removed under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

Example: Basic
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const on = ref(true)
</script>

<div class="flex items-center gap-3">
  <Switch v-model="on" aria-label="Notifications" />
  <span class="text-sm">Notifications are {{ on ? 'on' : 'off' }}</span>
</div>
```

Example: Tones
```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
  <Switch tone="primary" default-value aria-label="Primary" />
  <Switch tone="success" default-value aria-label="Success" />
  <Switch tone="danger" default-value aria-label="Danger" />
  <Switch tone="neutral" default-value aria-label="Neutral" />
  <Switch tone="info" default-value aria-label="Info" />
</div>
```

Example: On and off icons
```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
  <Switch show-icons size="sm" default-value aria-label="Small with icons" />
  <Switch show-icons default-value aria-label="Medium with icons" />
  <Switch show-icons size="lg" tone="success" default-value aria-label="Large success with icons" />
  <Switch show-icons tone="danger" aria-label="Danger with icons, off" />
  <Switch show-icons tone="neutral" default-value aria-label="Neutral with icons" />
</div>
```

Example: On and off text
```vue
<div class="flex flex-col gap-3">
  <Switch label="Sample notifications" on-label="On" off-label="Off" default-value />
  <Switch size="lg" tone="success" label="Sample sync" on-label="On" off-label="Off" />
  <Switch label="Sample alerts" on-label="Yes" />
</div>
```

Example: Right to left
```vue
<div dir="rtl" lang="ar" class="flex flex-col gap-3">
  <Switch label="الإشعارات" on-label="نعم" off-label="لا" default-value />
  <Switch label="المزامنة" show-icons />
</div>
```

Example: Label, description and label position
```vue

  <Switch label="Sample setting A" description="Sample description text under the label." default-value />
  <Switch label="Sample setting B" description="Sample description, with the label shown first." label-position="start" tone="info" show-icons />
</div>
```

Example: Settings rows in a Field
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">

const sms = ref(false)
</script>

    <Switch v-model="email" />
  </Field>
  <Field label="SMS alerts" hint="Standard rates apply." orientation="horizontal">
    <Switch v-model="sms" />
  </Field>
</div>
```

Example: Sizes and states
```vue

  <Switch default-value aria-label="Medium" />
  <Switch size="lg" default-value aria-label="Large" />
  <Switch disabled default-value aria-label="Disabled" />
  <Switch invalid aria-label="Invalid" />

```

# ColorPicker
group: forms / Choice inputs
Swatch palette plus validated hex input; emits normalised lowercase hex colours.

Use `ColorPicker` to choose a brand, label or tag colour from a configurable palette, with a hex field for custom values. It has no canvas or hue slider. The model is a lowercase `#rrggbb` or `#rrggbbaa` string (or `null`). Typed values accept `#rgb`, `#rgba`, `#rrggbb` and `#rrggbbaa` with or without `#`, in any case, and are normalised before emitting. An unparsable hex marks the input `aria-invalid`, shows a message and is NOT emitted; blur reverts the text to the last valid value. Clearing the input emits `null`. For a native OS picker use `<input type="color">`.

import { ColorPicker } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- modelValue: string | null - Hex colour. Normalised for display; invalid strings render as none. Uncontrolled when omitted.
- swatches: string[] = 12-colour default palette - Palette of hex colours. Entries are normalised; invalid ones are dropped and duplicates collapsed. Pass `[]` for hex input only.
- showInput: boolean = true - Show the preview chip and hex text field.
- disabled: boolean = false - Disables swatches and input. Also inherited from a Field.
- readonly: boolean = false - Shows the value but blocks every change; the input snaps back.
- required: boolean = false - Native required on the hex input. Also inherited from a Field.
- invalid: boolean = false - Sets `aria-invalid` on the hex input. Typing an unparsable hex sets it temporarily as well.
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = 'md' - Swatch and input size (24 / 32 / 40 px swatches). Unknown values fall back to `md`.
- shape: 'rounded' | 'square' | 'circle' = 'rounded' - Outline of every swatch and of the preview chip. The checked ring and the forced-colors outline follow the shape. Unknown values fall back to `rounded`.
- layout: 'stacked' | 'inline' | 'compact' = 'stacked' - `stacked` puts the hex field under the swatches. `inline` puts both on one wrapping row (up to `max-w-lg`). `compact` is the same row with a tighter swatch gap, a fixed narrow field and `max-w-md`. The DOM and tab order never change. Unknown values fall back to `stacked`.
- name: string - Form field name. The committed value is submitted through a hidden input, never the half-typed text.
- placeholder: string = '#000000' - Hex input placeholder.
- swatchesLabel: string = 'Colour swatches' - Accessible name of the swatch radiogroup.
- inputLabel: string = 'Hex colour' - Accessible name of the hex input. Dropped when a surrounding Field label names the input, so the visible label stays the name.
- class: string | object | array - Merged last with tailwind-merge; wins over internal classes.

Events:
- update:modelValue [value: string | null] - Normalised lowercase hex (`#rrggbb` / `#rrggbbaa`) on swatch pick or valid input; `null` when the input is emptied. Never emitted for invalid text or unchanged values.

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when the hex input has no name (`inputLabel` blank and no `Field` label) or the swatch group has none (`swatchesLabel` blank).

Rules:
- Model is a lowercase hex string or null; never pass colour names or rgb().
- Pass `swatches` as hex strings; use `[]` to offer only the text input.
- Use `shape` ("circle" for tags and avatars, "square" for brand tiles) and `layout` ("inline" or "compact" in toolbars and table cells); they never change behaviour.
- Do not rely on an event for invalid text: invalid hex is intentionally not emitted.

Accessibility:
- Swatches are `role="radio"` buttons inside a `role="radiogroup"` named by `swatchesLabel`; each is labelled with its hex value. The checked (or first) swatch is the only tab stop.
- Keyboard: ArrowRight/ArrowDown select the next swatch, ArrowLeft/ArrowUp the previous one (wrapping, flipped in right-to-left layouts), Home/End the first and last. Space selects the focused swatch. Focus and selection move together, as in a native radio group.
- `readonly` sets `aria-readonly` on the radiogroup (the only role of the pair that allows it) and `disabled` sets `disabled` on each swatch.
- The hex input is named by `inputLabel`, or by the Field label when inside a `Field`. While the text cannot be parsed it sets `aria-invalid` and a polite `role="status"` message linked with `aria-describedby`. The preview chip is decorative.
- Selection is never conveyed by colour alone: the checked swatch gets a ring, `aria-checked`, and an outline in forced-colors mode (swatch colours are kept with `forced-color-adjust: none`). Keyboard focus on the checked swatch widens its ring from 2px to 4px, so focus stays visible on the one tab stop.
- Shape and layout are presentation only: the swatches stay `role="radio"` buttons named by their hex value, the DOM order (swatches, preview, input) does not change, and the checked swatch keeps its ring and forced-colors outline in every shape.
- Responsive: swatches wrap, grow to 44px on coarse pointers, and the hex input uses 16px text on mobile with a 44px minimum height on touch. The picker is `max-w-xs` and `w-full`, so it fits 320px.

Example: Basic
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const color = ref('#3b82f6')
</script>

<div class="grid gap-2">
  <ColorPicker v-model="color" />
  <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Value: {{ color ?? 'none' }}</p>
</div>
```

Example: Custom swatches
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const tag = ref('#0ea5e9')
</script>

<ColorPicker v-model="tag" :swatches="['#0ea5e9', '#10b981', '#f59e0b', '#ef4444', '#a855f7']" />
```

Example: Hex input only, with alpha
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const color = ref('#ff000080')
</script>

<div class="grid gap-2">
  <ColorPicker v-model="color" :swatches="[]" />
  <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Value: {{ color ?? 'none' }}</p>
</div>
```

Example: Sizes
```vue
<div class="grid gap-4">
  <ColorPicker size="sm" model-value="#22c55e" :swatches="['#22c55e', '#ef4444']" />
  <ColorPicker size="md" model-value="#22c55e" :swatches="['#22c55e', '#ef4444']" />
  <ColorPicker size="lg" model-value="#22c55e" :swatches="['#22c55e', '#ef4444']" />
</div>
```

Example: Shapes
```vue

  <ColorPicker shape="rounded" model-value="#14b8a6" :swatches="['#14b8a6', '#f59e0b', '#6366f1', '#ef4444']" />
  <ColorPicker shape="square" model-value="#f59e0b" :swatches="['#14b8a6', '#f59e0b', '#6366f1', '#ef4444']" />
  <ColorPicker shape="circle" model-value="#6366f1" :swatches="['#14b8a6', '#f59e0b', '#6366f1', '#ef4444']" />
</div>
```

Example: Layouts
```vue

  <ColorPicker layout="stacked" model-value="#14b8a6" :swatches="['#14b8a6', '#f59e0b', '#6366f1']" />
  <ColorPicker layout="inline" model-value="#14b8a6" :swatches="['#14b8a6', '#f59e0b', '#6366f1']" />
  <ColorPicker layout="compact" shape="circle" size="sm" model-value="#14b8a6" :swatches="['#14b8a6', '#f59e0b', '#6366f1']" />
</div>
```

Example: Disabled, readonly and invalid
```vue
<div class="grid gap-4">
  <ColorPicker disabled model-value="#8b5cf6" :swatches="['#8b5cf6', '#ec4899']" />
  <ColorPicker readonly model-value="#8b5cf6" :swatches="['#8b5cf6', '#ec4899']" />
  <ColorPicker invalid model-value="#8b5cf6" :swatches="['#8b5cf6', '#ec4899']" />
</div>
```

Example: In a Field
```vue

</script>
```

# Rating
group: forms / Choice inputs
Rating input from 0 to N icons (star, heart, circle) with half or quarter steps, tones, keyboard support and slider semantics.

Use `Rating` to collect or display a score such as product reviews or quality marks. The value is a number from `0` to `max`; `0` means "no rating". Enable `allowHalf` for 0.5 steps (the left half of a star selects the half value), `clearable` to let a second click on the current value reset it, and `readonly` to display a score. Stars are inline SVG drawn with design tokens: empty stars are outlines, filled stars are solid with an ink outline, so the value does not depend on colour. For a small fixed set of labelled options prefer `SegmentedControl` or `RadioGroup`; for continuous values use `Slider`. Out-of-range, NaN or fractional values are clamped/snapped rather than rejected.

import { Rating } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- modelValue: number | null - v-model rating. `0`/`null` = none. Clamped to `0..max`, snapped to whole (or half) steps; NaN becomes 0. Uncontrolled when omitted.
- max: number = 5 - Number of stars. Floored; values below 1 or non-finite fall back to 5; capped at 100.
- allowHalf: boolean = false - Allow 0.5 steps (pointer position on the star and keyboard). Shorthand for `precision` 0.5; `precision` wins when both are set.
- precision: 1 | 0.5 | 0.25 = 1 - Smallest selectable step. Arrow keys move by it, the pointer position inside an icon snaps to it (the first quarter is 0.25, the first half 0.5), and incoming values are snapped to it. Page keys always move by one whole icon. Other numbers fall back to `allowHalf`.
- icon: 'star' | 'heart' | 'circle' | IconDefinition = 'star' - Glyph that is repeated `max` times. A name selects a built-in shape; an icon definition (`{ icon: [width, height, , , path] }`) draws that icon, outlined when empty and solid when filled. Unknown names and malformed definitions fall back to the star. Icons are decorative.
- tone: 'warning' | 'primary' | 'success' | 'danger' | 'neutral' | 'info' = 'warning' - Fill colour of the active part. Empty icons stay outlines and the filled ones keep an ink outline, so the value never relies on colour. Unknown values fall back to `warning`.
- clearable: boolean = false - Clicking the star (or half) that already holds the value resets to 0.
- readonly: boolean = false - Displays the value; no hover, click or key changes. Stays focusable and sets `aria-readonly`.
- disabled: boolean = false - Blocks interaction, removes from tab order, dims. Also inherited from a surrounding Field.
- invalid: boolean = false - Sets `aria-invalid="true"` and the destructive ring. Also set by a Field with an error.
- required: boolean = false - Inherited from a surrounding Field. `aria-required` is not valid on `role="slider"`, so it is not rendered; mark the requirement in the Field label.
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = 'md' - Icon size (16 / 20 / 28 px glyph, plus 4px padding per side so every star is at least 24px; 44px on coarse pointers).
- name: string - Renders a hidden input with the numeric value for native form posts.
- class: string | object | array - Merged last with tailwind-merge; wins over internal classes.

Events:
- update:modelValue [value: number] - Emitted when the rating changes (click, or Arrow, Page and Home/End keys). Not emitted when the value stays the same.

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when the slider has no accessible name beyond the fallback "Rating": no `Field` label, `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`.

Rules:
- Give Rating an `aria-label` or wrap it in Field with a label; without either it throws a ContractError.
- Use `v-model` with a number; 0 means no rating. Use `readonly` to display averages (with `allow-half` for x.5).
- Do not import star icons; Rating draws its own SVG glyphs from tokens. Use `icon="heart"` or `icon="circle"`, or pass an icon definition for another shape.
- Use `precision` (1, 0.5, 0.25) for fractional input and `allow-half` only as shorthand; use `tone` for colour and keep `readonly` for averages.
- Keep `max` small (<= 10); it is capped at 100.

Accessibility:
- Root has `role="slider"` with `aria-valuemin=0`, `aria-valuemax=max`, `aria-valuenow` and `aria-valuetext` ("3 out of 5"). Stars are `aria-hidden`.
- Keyboard: ArrowRight/ArrowUp add one `precision` step (1, 0.5 or 0.25), ArrowLeft/ArrowDown remove one, PageUp/PageDown +/-1, Home = 0, End = max. Left and Right swap in right-to-left layouts. The announced value text is the number ("2.25 out of 5") at every precision.
- The name comes from the surrounding Field label (wired with `aria-labelledby`, because `label for` cannot name a slider), or from your own `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby`. With none of these it throws a ContractError: the fallback name "Rating" does not say what is rated.
- `readonly` keeps focus and announces `aria-readonly`; `disabled` sets `aria-disabled` and leaves the tab order. `aria-required` is not rendered because `slider` does not support it.
- Targets: every star is at least 24px square and 44px on coarse pointers. The group wraps instead of overflowing at 320px.
- Filled and empty icons differ by shape (outline versus solid) for every `icon` and `tone`, so the value survives forced-colors mode and colour-blindness. The icons are `aria-hidden`; the single slider carries the name and value.

Example: Basic
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const score = ref(3)
</script>

<div class="grid gap-2">
  <Rating v-model="score" aria-label="Product rating" />
  <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">{{ score }} out of 5</p>
</div>
```

Example: Half stars, clearable
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const score = ref(2.5)
</script>

<div class="grid gap-2">
  <Rating v-model="score" allow-half clearable aria-label="Half star rating" />
  <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">Value: {{ score }}</p>
</div>
```

Example: Sizes
```vue
<div class="grid gap-2">
  <Rating size="sm" :model-value="2" aria-label="Small size" />
  <Rating size="md" :model-value="3" aria-label="Medium size" />
  <Rating size="lg" :model-value="4" aria-label="Large size" />
</div>
```

Example: Quarter precision
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const score = ref(3.25)
</script>

<div class="grid gap-2">
  <Rating v-model="score" :precision="0.25" clearable aria-label="Quarter step rating" />
  <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">Value: {{ score }}</p>
</div>
```

Example: Icons
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const love = ref(3)
</script>

<div class="grid gap-2">
  <Rating v-model="love" icon="heart" tone="danger" aria-label="Heart rating" />
  <Rating :model-value="2" icon="circle" tone="info" aria-label="Circle rating" />
  <Rating :model-value="4" icon="star" aria-label="Star rating" />
</div>
```

Example: Tones
```vue
<div class="grid gap-2">
  <Rating :model-value="3" tone="warning" aria-label="Warning tone" />
  <Rating :model-value="3" tone="primary" aria-label="Primary tone" />
  <Rating :model-value="3" tone="success" aria-label="Success tone" />
  <Rating :model-value="3" tone="danger" aria-label="Danger tone" />
  <Rating :model-value="3" tone="neutral" aria-label="Neutral tone" />
  <Rating :model-value="3" tone="info" aria-label="Info tone" />
</div>
```

Example: Custom max
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">

</script>

<Rating v-model="level" :max="10" aria-label="Difficulty" />
```

Example: Readonly, disabled and invalid
```vue
<div class="grid gap-2">
  <Rating :model-value="3.5" allow-half readonly aria-label="Display only rating" />
  <Rating :model-value="2" disabled aria-label="Disabled rating" />
  <Rating :model-value="0" invalid aria-label="Invalid rating" />
</div>
```

Example: In a Field with validation
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const score = ref(0)
</script>

<Field class="max-w-sm" label="Your rating" hint="Select a star." :error="score === 0 ? 'Choose a rating' : ''" required>
  <Rating v-model="score" />
</Field>
```

# Calendar
group: forms / Date & time
Accessible month grid with single, range or multiple day selection, min/max/disabled dates, locale names and full keyboard navigation.

Use `Calendar` to show a month (or two) inline and let people pick days. It is the engine behind `DatePicker` and `DateRangePicker`; use those when the calendar should live in a dropdown attached to a field, and `DateInput` when a native date field is enough. The value depends on `mode`: `Date | null` for `single`, `{ start, end } | null` for `range` (a reversed range is normalised so `start <= end`), `Date[]` for `multiple` (sorted, de-duplicated). Emitted dates are at local midnight. Wrong shapes and invalid dates are treated as "nothing selected". In `range` mode the first click only sets an anchor (shown highlighted, with hover preview); `update:modelValue` fires when the second click completes the range. All date maths is native `Date`/`Intl` and DST/leap-year safe (it works on calendar days, never on 24h offsets).

import { Calendar } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- modelValue: Date | { start: Date; end: Date } | Date[] | null - v-model. Shape follows `mode`. Uncontrolled when omitted.
- mode: 'single' | 'range' | 'multiple' = 'single' - Selection model. Unknown values behave as `single`.
- month: Date - Visible (first) month; any day inside it. Pair with `@update:month` to control navigation. Invalid dates are ignored.
- min: Date - Earliest selectable day (inclusive). Swapped with `max` if reversed.
- max: Date - Latest selectable day (inclusive).
- isDateDisabled: (date: Date) => boolean - Predicate; return true to disable a day (weekends, holidays, booked days). Receives a Date at local midnight.
- weekStart: number - First weekday, 0 = Sunday .. 6 = Saturday. Default comes from the locale (Intl.Locale week info), else Sunday. Invalid values use the default.
- locale: string - BCP 47 tag used for month, weekday and day names/numerals. Default: the ConfigProvider locale, else `en`. Unknown tags fall back to the runtime default.
- numberOfMonths: 1 | 2 | 3 = 1 - Months shown at once (side by side, or stacked with `orientation="vertical"`). Any value other than 2 or 3 renders one month.
- orientation: 'horizontal' | 'vertical' = 'horizontal' - Layout of several months: `horizontal` wraps them side by side, `vertical` stacks them. Unknown values fall back to `horizontal`.
- shape: 'rounded' | 'pill' | 'square' = 'rounded' - Corner shape of the day buttons. Range ends keep a flat inner edge. Unknown values fall back to `rounded`.
- weekNumbers: boolean = false - Adds a leading column with the ISO 8601 week number of each row (taken from the middle day of the row).
- weekLabel: string = 'Week' - Accessible name of the week-number column header and, followed by the number, of each row header ("Week 9"). Translate it.
- weekShort: string = 'Wk' - Visible text of the week-number column header. Translate it.
- showHeading: boolean = true - Show the month/year title above each month (the grid keeps its aria-label either way).
- disabled: boolean = false - Disables every day and the month navigation.
- readonly: boolean = false - Days stay focusable and emit `select` but never change the value; month navigation still works.
- variant: 'default' | 'ghost' | 'outline' = 'default' - `default` is a bordered card surface; `outline` keeps the border and padding on a transparent background; `ghost` has no border/background/padding (for use inside another surface). Unknown values fall back to `default`.
- size: 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = 'md' - Cell size and text size (sets `--calendar-cell`): `xs` 24px, `sm` 28px, `md` 36px, `lg` 44px (36px below the `sm` breakpoint). Unknown values fall back to `md`.
- prevLabel: string = 'Previous month' - aria-label of the previous-month button (translate it).
- nextLabel: string = 'Next month' - aria-label of the next-month button (translate it).
- rangeBlockedMessage: string = 'The range cannot include unavailable dates. Choose another end date.' - Announced in a polite live region when the second click of a range is refused because a day in between is disabled or outside `min`/`max`. The anchor stays. Overridable with the `calendar.rangeBlocked` ConfigProvider label (translate it).
- rangeStartMessage: string = 'Range start {date}. Choose the end date.' - Announced in a polite live region after the first click of a range. `{date}` is replaced with the full date (translate it).
- class: string | object | array - Merged last with tailwind-merge; wins over internal classes.

Events:
- update:modelValue [value: Date | { start: Date; end: Date } | Date[] | null] - The selection changed. In range mode only when the range is complete.
- update:month [value: Date] - The user moved the visible window (buttons, PageUp/PageDown, arrows across a month edge). Payload is the 1st of the first visible month.
- select [date: Date] - An enabled day was activated, even if the value did not change (re-click, readonly, first click of a range).

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when the previous or next month button has no name, that is when `prevLabel` or `nextLabel` is blank.

Rules:
- Use `mode="range"` with `v-model="{start,end}|null"`; `mode="multiple"` with a `Date[]`; default `single` with `Date | null`.
- Never mutate the model in place; replace it (or use v-model).
- Use `min`/`max`/`isDateDisabled` for restrictions, not CSS.
- Put a Calendar in a dropdown with `DatePicker`/`DateRangePicker`, not by hand.
- Dates are local calendar days; do not compare with `===`, compare `toDateString()` or use the exported `calendarIsSameDay`.

Accessibility:
- Each month is a `role="grid"` named by its visible month heading (`aria-labelledby`, or `aria-label` when `showHeading` is off). Weekday headers are `columnheader`s with the full weekday name as label. Days are buttons inside `gridcell`s that carry `aria-selected`; each day has a full-date `aria-label` (it contains the visible day number) and `aria-current="date"` marks today.
- Roving tabindex: exactly one day is tabbable (selected day, else today); Tab leaves the grid. Previous and next month buttons come first in the tab order.
- Keyboard: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight move one day (mirrored on a right-to-left page), ArrowUp/ArrowDown one week, Home/End the start/end of the week, PageUp/PageDown one month, Shift+PageUp/PageDown one year, Enter or Space select, Escape cancels an in-progress range. Moving past a month edge scrolls the view and keeps focus on the same day.
- One persistent visually hidden `role="status"` region announces the new month(s) after every navigation and the range start prompt after the first range click. The month heading is not a live region because it is re-created on navigation.
- Disabled days use `aria-disabled` (not `disabled`) so keyboard users can still move across them. `readonly` sets `aria-readonly` on the grid.
- Selected days, range ends and in-between days get a border in forced-colors mode; today is bold and underlined, so no state relies on colour alone. Cells are 24, 28, 36 or 44px (`size`), always at least 24px; `lg` drops to 36px below the `sm` breakpoint so one month fits 320px. Several months wrap onto separate rows when there is no room, or stack with `orientation="vertical"`. Week numbers are `rowheader` cells named "Week N" (translate `weekLabel`); they are not focusable and not part of the roving tabindex.
- Translate `prevLabel`, `nextLabel` and `rangeStartMessage`, and pass `locale` so names are localised.

Example: Single date
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const date = ref(null)
</script>

<div class="grid gap-2">
  <Calendar v-model="date" />
  <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Selected: {{ date ? date.toDateString() : 'none' }}</p>
</div>
```

```vue
    {{ range ? range.start.toDateString() + ' to ' + range.end.toDateString() : 'Pick a start and an end' }}
  </p>
</div>
```

Example: Multiple dates

```vue
</script>
```

# DatePicker
group: forms / Date & time
Input-like button that opens a dropdown Calendar to pick a single date, formatted with Intl.

Use `DatePicker` for one date in a form (birthday, due date, start date) when a polished, localised calendar is wanted. Use `DateRangePicker` for a start/end pair, `Calendar` for an always-visible calendar, and `DateInput` for a plain native date field. v-model is `Date | null` (local midnight). The trigger shows the value formatted with `Intl.DateTimeFormat` (`locale` + `format`) or the placeholder. The dropdown is absolutely positioned under the trigger (no portal): it closes on outside pointer-down, Escape (focus returns to the trigger), focus leaving, and after a day is picked. Clearing is opt-in with `clearable`. Inside a `Field` the trigger receives the label id, description and invalid state automatically. `class` and extra attributes go to the trigger button.

import { DatePicker } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- modelValue: Date | null - v-model. Invalid dates and non-Date values count as empty. Uncontrolled when omitted.
- placeholder: string = 'Pick a date' - Text shown while empty.
- locale: string - BCP 47 locale for calendar names and the displayed value. Unknown tags fall back to the runtime default.
- format: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions = { dateStyle: 'medium' } - How the value is displayed. Invalid option combinations fall back to a default format.
- name: string - Form field name. Adds a hidden input that submits the day as an ISO date (`2024-05-01`) with a native form. A required, empty picker blocks the submit.
- min: Date - Earliest selectable day.
- max: Date - Latest selectable day.
- isDateDisabled: (date: Date) => boolean - Return true to disable a day.
- weekStart: number - First weekday 0 (Sunday) - 6 (Saturday). Default from the locale.
- clearable: boolean = false - Show a clear button while a value is set (hidden when disabled/readonly).
- disabled: boolean = false - Disables the trigger. Also inherited from a surrounding Field. Closes an open dropdown.
- readonly: boolean = false - Shows the value; the dropdown cannot be opened and the value cannot be cleared.
- required: boolean = false - Adds a visually hidden `requiredLabel` to the trigger description (`aria-required` is not allowed on a button). Also inherited from a surrounding Field.
- invalid: boolean = false - Sets `aria-invalid="true"` and destructive styling. Also set by a Field with an error.
- size: 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = 'md' - Trigger height (and calendar size): `xs` 28px, `sm` 32px, `md` 36px, `lg` 44px. Unknown values fall back to `md`.
- variant: 'outline' | 'filled' | 'underline' | 'ghost' = 'outline' - Trigger surface. `filled` fills with the muted token, `underline` keeps only a bottom border (thicker on focus), `ghost` hides the border until hover or focus. Unknown values fall back to `outline`.
- shape: 'rounded' | 'pill' | 'square' = 'rounded' - Trigger corners. `underline` is always square. Unknown values fall back to `rounded`.
- status: 'default' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error' = 'default' - Status colour on the border plus an icon; `success` and `warning` add visually hidden text linked through `aria-describedby`, `error` also sets `aria-invalid="true"`. Unknown values fall back to `default`.
- statusLabel: string - Hidden text of the success and warning icons. Defaults to the English text (translate it).
- open: boolean - v-model:open. Controls the dropdown; uncontrolled when omitted.
- align: 'start' | 'end' = 'start' - Which trigger edge the dropdown aligns to. Use `end` for pickers near the right edge.
- clearLabel: string = 'Clear date' - aria-label of the clear button.
- requiredLabel: string = 'Required' - Visually hidden description announced with the trigger while `required` (translate it).
- dialogLabel: string = 'Choose date' - aria-label of the dropdown dialog.
- class: string | object | array - Merged last on the trigger button with tailwind-merge.

Events:
- update:modelValue [value: Date | null] - A different day was picked, or the value was cleared (null).
- update:open [open: boolean] - The dropdown asked to open or close.

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when the trigger has no label source: no `Field` label, wrapping or `for` label, `aria-label`, or `aria-labelledby` pointing at text (the value or placeholder shown in the trigger does not count).
- Throws a ContractError when `dialogLabel` is blank, or `clearLabel` is blank while `clearable` is set.

Rules:
- Use `v-model` with `Date | null`; never mutate the Date in place.
- Wrap in `Field` with a label; add `clearable` for optional dates.
- Restrict dates with `min`/`max`/`isDateDisabled`, not by validating after the fact.
- Use `locale` and `format` for display; do not format the Date yourself for the trigger text.
- Use `DateRangePicker` for start/end pairs instead of two DatePickers.

Accessibility:
- The trigger is a button with `aria-haspopup="dialog"`, `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` (set while open). Its name is built with `aria-labelledby`: the label source (`Field` label, your `aria-label`, or your own `aria-labelledby`) followed by the visible value, so the visible text is always part of the accessible name.
- Always give the trigger a label through `Field`, `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`.
- `required` is exposed as a visually hidden description (`requiredLabel`) because `aria-required` is not allowed on a button. `invalid` sets `aria-invalid`, and a `Field` error is linked through `aria-describedby`.
- Enter, Space or a click toggles the dropdown; ArrowDown opens it. Focus moves to the selected (or today) day. Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger; Tab out of the picker closes it; picking a day closes it and returns focus to the trigger.
- The dropdown is a `role="dialog"` containing the Calendar, so all Calendar keyboard behaviour (arrows, PageUp/PageDown, Home/End) and its month-change live region apply.
- The clear button is a real button named by `clearLabel`, 24px square, with the shared focus ring.
- `status` never relies on colour: an icon sits at the inline end, `success` and `warning` add visually hidden text referenced by `aria-describedby`, and `error` sets `aria-invalid`. `underline` and `ghost` keep a visible focus indicator (a thicker bottom border, or the border and ring) and draw a border in forced-colors mode.
- Responsive: the trigger text is 16px below `md` (no iOS zoom) and 14px from `md`, with a 44px minimum height on touch pointers. Below `sm` the dropdown is as wide as the trigger (at least 276px); from `sm` it is as wide as its content. Use `align="end"` near the right edge.

Example: Basic
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const date = ref(null)
</script>

<div class="grid min-h-96 max-w-xs content-start gap-2">
  <DatePicker v-model="date" aria-label="Date" />
  <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{{ date ? date.toDateString() : 'No date chosen' }}</p>
</div>
```

Example: In a Field, clearable, with limits
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">

const weekend = (d) => d.getDay() === 0 || d.getDay() === 6
const due = ref(null)
</script>

<Field class="min-h-96 max-w-xs content-start" label="Due date" hint="Weekdays only." :error="due ? '' : 'Choose a due date'" required>
  <DatePicker v-model="due" clearable :min="today" :is-date-disabled="weekend" />
</Field>
```

Example: Format and locale
```vue

</script>

<div class="grid max-w-xs gap-2">
  <DatePicker v-model="date" locale="de-DE" :format="{ dateStyle: 'full' }" :week-start="1" aria-label="Datum" />
  <DatePicker v-model="date" locale="en-US" :format="{ year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit' }" aria-label="Date" />
</div>
```

Example: Sizes and states
```vue
<div class="grid max-w-xs gap-2">
  <DatePicker size="xs" aria-label="Extra small" />
  <DatePicker size="sm" aria-label="Small" />
  <DatePicker aria-label="Medium" />
  <DatePicker size="lg" aria-label="Large" />
  <DatePicker disabled aria-label="Disabled" :model-value="new Date(2024, 4, 1)" />
  <DatePicker readonly aria-label="Read only" :model-value="new Date(2024, 4, 1)" />
  <DatePicker invalid aria-label="Invalid" />
</div>
```

Example: Variants, shapes and status
```vue

  <DatePicker variant="outline" aria-label="Outline" />
  <DatePicker variant="filled" aria-label="Filled" />
  <DatePicker variant="underline" aria-label="Underline" />
  <DatePicker variant="ghost" aria-label="Ghost" />
  <DatePicker shape="pill" aria-label="Pill" />
  <DatePicker shape="square" aria-label="Square" />
  <DatePicker status="success" aria-label="Success" :model-value="new Date(2024, 4, 1)" />
  <DatePicker status="warning" aria-label="Warning" :model-value="new Date(2024, 4, 1)" />
  <DatePicker status="error" aria-label="Error" clearable :model-value="new Date(2024, 4, 1)" />
</div>
```

# DateRangePicker
group: forms / Date & time
Input-like button that opens a dropdown Calendar to pick a start and end date, with an optional two-month view.

Use `DateRangePicker` for a start/end pair (stay dates, report period, booking window). Use `DatePicker` for a single date and `Calendar mode="range"` for an inline calendar. v-model is `{ start, end } | null` with `start <= end`: the first click anchors the range, hovering previews it, and the second click completes it, emits `update:modelValue` and closes the dropdown. Clicking an earlier day second swaps the ends; a reversed incoming value is normalised for display. A one-day range displays as a single date. Behaviour matches `DatePicker`: absolutely positioned dropdown (no portal) that closes on outside pointer-down, Escape (the first Escape cancels a half-made range, the next closes and returns focus to the trigger) and focus leaving. `class` and extra attributes go to the trigger button.

import { DateRangePicker } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- modelValue: { start: Date; end: Date } | null - v-model. Wrong shapes and invalid dates count as empty. Uncontrolled when omitted.
- placeholder: string = 'Pick a date range' - Text shown while empty.
- locale: string - BCP 47 locale for calendar names and the displayed value. Default: the ConfigProvider locale, else `en`.
- format: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions = { dateStyle: 'medium' } - How each end is displayed. Invalid option combinations fall back to a default format.
- name: string - Form field name. Adds hidden inputs `name[from]` and `name[to]` that submit ISO dates (`2024-05-01`) with a native form. A required, empty picker blocks the submit.
- min: Date - Earliest selectable day.
- max: Date - Latest selectable day.
- isDateDisabled: (date: Date) => boolean - Return true to disable a day.
- weekStart: number - First weekday 0 (Sunday) - 6 (Saturday). Default from the locale.
- numberOfMonths: 1 | 2 | 3 = 1 - Months shown side by side in the dropdown (they wrap on narrow screens).
- presets: { label: string; range: { start: Date; end: Date } }[] - Shortcut ranges shown as a button list beside the calendar (above it on narrow screens). Choosing one sets the range and closes the dropdown. A preset outside `min`/`max` is disabled; the one that matches the value has `aria-pressed="true"`.
- presetsLabel: string = 'Presets' - Accessible name of the presets group (translate it).
- clearable: boolean = false - Show a clear button while a range is set (hidden when disabled/readonly).
- disabled: boolean = false - Disables the trigger. Also inherited from a surrounding Field. Closes an open dropdown.
- readonly: boolean = false - Shows the range; the dropdown cannot be opened and the value cannot be cleared.
- required: boolean = false - Adds a visually hidden `requiredLabel` to the trigger description (`aria-required` is not allowed on a button). Also inherited from a surrounding Field.
- invalid: boolean = false - Sets `aria-invalid="true"` and destructive styling. Also set by a Field with an error.
- size: 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = 'md' - Trigger height (and calendar size): `xs` 28px, `sm` 32px, `md` 36px, `lg` 44px. Unknown values fall back to `md`.
- variant: 'outline' | 'filled' | 'underline' | 'ghost' = 'outline' - Trigger surface. `filled` fills with the muted token, `underline` keeps only a bottom border (thicker on focus), `ghost` hides the border until hover or focus. Unknown values fall back to `outline`.
- shape: 'rounded' | 'pill' | 'square' = 'rounded' - Trigger corners. `underline` is always square. Unknown values fall back to `rounded`.
- status: 'default' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error' = 'default' - Status colour on the border plus an icon; `success` and `warning` add visually hidden text linked through `aria-describedby`, `error` also sets `aria-invalid="true"`. Unknown values fall back to `default`.
- statusLabel: string - Hidden text of the success and warning icons. Defaults to the English text (translate it).
- open: boolean - v-model:open. Controls the dropdown; uncontrolled when omitted.
- align: 'start' | 'end' = 'start' - Which trigger edge the dropdown aligns to.
- clearLabel: string = 'Clear date range' - aria-label of the clear button.
- requiredLabel: string = 'Required' - Visually hidden description announced with the trigger while `required` (translate it).
- dialogLabel: string = 'Choose date range' - aria-label of the dropdown dialog.
- class: string | object | array - Merged last on the trigger button with tailwind-merge.

Events:
- update:modelValue [value: { start: Date; end: Date } | null] - A complete, normalised range was picked, or the value was cleared (null). Not emitted after only the first click.
- update:open [open: boolean] - The dropdown asked to open or close.

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when the trigger has no label source: no `Field` label, wrapping or `for` label, `aria-label`, or `aria-labelledby` pointing at text (the range or placeholder shown in the trigger does not count).
- Throws a ContractError when `dialogLabel` is blank, or `clearLabel` is blank while `clearable` is set.
- Throws a ContractError when an entry of `presets` has a blank `label` or a `range` without two valid dates.

Rules:
- Use `v-model` with `{ start: Date, end: Date } | null`; the emitted range is always normalised (start <= end).
- Wrap in `Field` with a label; add `clearable` for optional ranges and `:number-of-months="2"` on wide layouts.
- The model only changes when both ends are picked; do not expect events after the first click.
- Restrict with `min`/`max`/`isDateDisabled`.
- Use `DatePicker` for a single date.

Accessibility:
- The trigger is a button with `aria-haspopup="dialog"`, `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` (set while open). Its name is built with `aria-labelledby`: the label source (`Field` label, your `aria-label`, or your own `aria-labelledby`) followed by the visible range text, so the visible text is always part of the accessible name.
- Always give the trigger a label through `Field`, `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`.
- `required` is exposed as a visually hidden description (`requiredLabel`) because `aria-required` is not allowed on a button. `invalid` sets `aria-invalid`, and a `Field` error is linked through `aria-describedby`.
- Enter, Space or a click toggles the dropdown; ArrowDown opens it with focus on the first selected (or today) day. The first Escape cancels a half-made range, the next closes and returns focus to the trigger; Tab out closes it. Completing the range closes the dropdown and returns focus to the trigger.
- The dropdown is a `role="dialog"` hosting the Calendar grid(s): arrows, PageUp/PageDown, Home/End and Enter/Space work as documented on Calendar. A polite live region announces the new month and the range start prompt. Range ends and in-between days are exposed via `data-range-start`, `data-range-end` and `data-in-range`, and get a border in forced-colors mode.
- The clear button is a real button named by `clearLabel`, 24px square, with the shared focus ring.
- Presets form a `role="group"` named by `presetsLabel`; each is a real button (at least 32px, 44px on touch) with `aria-pressed` for the current range and `disabled` when it lies outside `min`/`max`. Pressed also gets heavier text and a forced-colors border, so it is not colour only.
- `status` never relies on colour: an icon sits at the inline end, `success` and `warning` add visually hidden text referenced by `aria-describedby`, and `error` sets `aria-invalid`.
- Responsive: the trigger text is 16px below `md` and 14px from `md`, with a 44px minimum height on touch pointers. Below `sm` the dropdown is as wide as the trigger (at least 276px) and two months wrap onto separate rows; from `sm` it is as wide as its content.

Example: Basic
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const range = ref(null)
</script>

<div class="grid min-h-96 max-w-sm content-start gap-2">
  <DateRangePicker v-model="range" aria-label="Date range" />
  <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
    {{ range ? range.start.toDateString() + ' to ' + range.end.toDateString() : 'No range chosen' }}
  </p>
</div>
```

Example: Two months, clearable, in a Field
```vue

const stay = ref(null)
</script>

<Field class="min-h-96 max-w-sm content-start" label="Stay" hint="Check-in to check-out." :error="stay ? '' : 'Choose your dates'" required>
  <DateRangePicker v-model="stay" :number-of-months="2" clearable :min="today" />
</Field>
```

Example: Preselected, localised

```vue
</script>

<DateRangePicker class="max-w-sm" v-model="range" locale="de-DE" :format="{ dateStyle: 'long' }" :week-start="1" aria-label="Zeitraum" />
```

Example: Sizes and states
```vue
<div class="grid max-w-sm gap-2">
  <DateRangePicker size="xs" aria-label="Extra small" />
  <DateRangePicker size="sm" aria-label="Small" />
  <DateRangePicker aria-label="Medium" />
  <DateRangePicker size="lg" aria-label="Large" />
  <DateRangePicker disabled aria-label="Disabled" />
  <DateRangePicker readonly aria-label="Read only" :model-value="{ start: new Date(2024, 4, 1), end: new Date(2024, 4, 7) }" />
  <DateRangePicker invalid aria-label="Invalid" />
</div>
```

Example: Presets

```vue
  { label: 'First week of February', range: { start: day(1), end: day(7) } },
```

# TimeInput
group: forms / Date & time
Segmented HH:mm time field with arrow-key stepping, digit typing, optional 12h AM/PM, min/max, minute step, variants, shapes and status.

Use `TimeInput` to pick a time of day without a popover. The model is always a 24h `HH:mm` string (or `null` when empty), even in `hour12` mode. Each segment (hours, minutes, AM/PM) is a spinbutton: ArrowUp/ArrowDown step it (minutes move by `step`), digits type directly and auto-advance, Backspace clears, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight move between segments. `null` is emitted whenever a segment is empty; the value is re-emitted once complete. `min`/`max` clamp the result. For dates use `DateInput`; for durations or plain numbers use `NumberInput`.

import { TimeInput } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- modelValue: string | null - 24h `HH:mm` (e.g. `"09:05"`). `null` or an invalid string shows empty segments. Uncontrolled when omitted.
- hour12: boolean = false - Show hours 1-12 plus an AM/PM segment. The model stays 24h.
- step: number = 1 - Minutes moved by ArrowUp/ArrowDown on the minute segment (floored, clamped to 1..60). Typed minutes are not snapped.
- min: string - Earliest `HH:mm`. Ignored when invalid or greater than `max`.
- max: string - Latest `HH:mm`. Ignored when invalid or less than `min`.
- disabled: boolean = false - Blocks interaction and removes segments from the tab order. Also inherited from a Field.
- readonly: boolean = false - Segments stay focusable (arrow-left/right navigation) but cannot be edited.
- required: boolean = false - Sets `aria-required` on the segments. Also inherited from a Field.
- invalid: boolean = false - Sets `aria-invalid` and the destructive ring. Also set by a Field with an error.
- variant: 'outline' | 'filled' | 'underline' | 'ghost' = 'outline' - Surface: muted fill (`filled`), bottom border only (`underline`), border on hover and fill while a segment has focus (`ghost`). Unknown values fall back to `outline`.
- size: 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = 'md' - Field height: 28, 32, 36 and 44px. Text is 16px below the `md` breakpoint (no iOS focus zoom) and smaller from `md` up. On coarse pointers the field is at least 44px high (except `lg`, already 44px). Unknown values fall back to `md`.
- shape: 'rounded' | 'pill' | 'square' = 'rounded' - Corners. `pill` is fully rounded; `underline` has no corners and ignores it. Unknown values fall back to `rounded`.
- status: 'default' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error' = 'default' - Status colour with an icon at the end. `success` and `warning` add visually hidden text referenced by the group `aria-describedby`; `error` also sets `aria-invalid="true"` on every segment. Unknown values fall back to `default`.
- statusLabel: string = 'Valid' or 'Warning' - Screen reader text of the `success` and `warning` status. Set it when the app is not in English.
- name: string - Renders a hidden input with the 24h value (empty while incomplete).
- hourLabel: string = 'Hours' - Accessible name of the hour segment.
- minuteLabel: string = 'Minutes' - Accessible name of the minute segment.
- periodLabel: string = 'AM/PM' - Accessible name of the AM/PM segment.
- adjustedLabel: string = 'Adjusted to' - Spoken through the polite live region when `min`/`max` moves the entered time (`Adjusted to 09:00`).
- class: string | object | array - Merged last with tailwind-merge; wins over internal classes.

Events:
- update:modelValue [value: string | null] - 24h `HH:mm` when both segments are filled (after min/max clamping); `null` when a segment is cleared. Duplicate values are not re-emitted.

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when the group has no accessible name: no `Field` label, `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` (the named segments do not name the group).
- Throws a ContractError when `hourLabel` or `minuteLabel` is blank, or `periodLabel` is blank with `hour12`.

Rules:
- The model is always 24h "HH:mm" or null, even with `hour12`.
- Pass `min`/`max` as "HH:mm"; reversed or invalid bounds are ignored.
- Always add `aria-label` or wrap in Field with a label.
- Use `status` for validation feedback (it adds the icon) and still show the message through `Field error` or `hint`.
- Do not validate by regex yourself: `null` means incomplete.

Accessibility:
- Status is never colour alone: an icon appears for `success`, `warning` and `error`; `success` and `warning` add screen reader text referenced by the group `aria-describedby`, and `error` sets `aria-invalid="true"` on every segment (pair it with a visible message in `Field`).
- Because the surface is a wrapper, the variants react to `focus-within`: `underline` thickens its bottom border and `ghost` fills while a segment has focus, and forced-colors mode keeps the outline.
- Root is `role="group"`; each segment is a `role="spinbutton"` with `aria-label`, `aria-valuemin/max/now` and `aria-valuetext` ("Empty" when unset). Segments are at least 24px square and each is a tab stop.
- Keyboard: ArrowUp/ArrowDown step, digits type, A/P set AM/PM, Backspace/Delete clear, Home/End jump to bounds, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight move between segments.
- A time moved by `min`/`max` is announced through a polite `role="status"` region ("Adjusted to 09:00"). The focused segment shows a filled highlight plus a forced-colors outline.
- Segments are not text inputs, so touch users get no on-screen keyboard: pair the field with presets or a native `type="time"` input where touch entry matters.
- Name the group with `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` (fall through to the root). Inside `Field` the group is named from the Field label through `aria-labelledby` (a native label cannot name a span). `invalid`, `required`, `disabled` and `readonly` are mirrored on every segment.

Example: Basic (24h)
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">

</script>

  <TimeInput v-model="time" aria-label="Start time" />
  <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Value: {{ time ?? 'empty' }}</p>
</div>
```


# TimeRangePicker
group: forms / Date & time
Pick a time window from presets (last 15 minutes to 30 days, today, yesterday) or a custom from and to, as a popover, an inline panel or a segmented row, in an explicit time zone.

Use `TimeRangePicker` where the question is "which window of time": dashboards, logs, audit trails, exports. Use `DateRangePicker` when only whole days matter, and `DatePicker` for one date. v-model is `{ from, to }` as ISO 8601 strings, always emitted in UTC (`2024-05-01T10:00:00.000Z`) with `from <= to`. Incoming strings may carry an offset (`+02:00`); one without an offset is read as UTC. An end that is not a valid date makes the whole value count as empty. **Presets resolve when you choose them.** `last-15-minutes` to `last-30-days` end at the current time and are exact elapsed lengths (a "day" is 24 hours). `today` runs from the start of the day in `timeZone` to now; `yesterday` is the whole previous day in `timeZone` (23 or 25 hours across a daylight saving change). The component emits concrete from and to strings, never a relative expression, so a saved value always means the same window. Pass `now` to fix the clock in tests, demos and server-rendered pages. **Time zones.** `timeZone` is an IANA name (`Europe/Warsaw`) and defaults to `UTC`. It decides which day "today" is, how the value is displayed (with a short zone name after the end), and how typed dates and times are read. It never changes the emitted value, which is always UTC. An unknown name shows UTC (and throws a ContractError in strict mode). Only `Intl` is used. A wall time that does not exist (a spring forward gap, or the skipped Samoa day of 2011-12-30) moves forward; a wall time that happens twice (fall back) is read as its first occurrence; the fields then show the time that was stored. **Custom range.** The `custom` preset shows a calendar plus a date and a time field for each end, a note naming the zone, and an Apply button. The range is only emitted when it is valid: Apply with a start after the end, a missing end, or a time outside `min` and `max` shows the reason as visible text with an icon and does not emit. Times have minute precision. `variant` picks the layout: `popover` (trigger and dropdown, the default), `inline` (a bordered panel that is always open) or `segmented` (a row of presets as one radio group with the custom fields below). `class` goes on the root; extra attributes go to the trigger (`popover`) or to the group root (`inline`, `segmented`).

import { TimeRangePicker } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- modelValue: { from: string; to: string } | null - v-model. ISO 8601 strings, emitted as UTC. Strings without an offset are UTC. Wrong shapes and invalid dates count as empty. Uncontrolled when omitted.
- now: Date | string | number - The current time used to resolve relative presets and to bound them by `min`/`max`. A `Date`, milliseconds or an ISO string. Defaults to the clock at the moment of selection; an invalid value falls back to the clock.
- timeZone: string = ConfigProvider time zone, else 'UTC' - IANA zone for display, typed times and the day boundaries of `today` and `yesterday`. Unknown names show UTC.
- name: string - Form field name. Adds hidden inputs `name[from]` and `name[to]` that submit UTC ISO instants with a native form. A required, empty picker blocks the submit.
- min: Date | string | number - Earliest allowed instant (inclusive). A preset or a custom range that starts earlier is disabled or rejected. Swapped with `max` when reversed.
- max: Date | string | number - Latest allowed instant (inclusive).
- presets: TimeRangePresetId[] - Ids to show, in order: `last-15-minutes`, `last-30-minutes`, `last-1-hour`, `last-6-hours`, `last-24-hours`, `last-7-days`, `last-30-days`, `today`, `yesterday`, `custom`. Default: all. Without `custom` there are no from/to fields. Unknown ids are ignored (and throw in strict mode).
- presetLabels: Partial<Record<TimeRangePresetId, string>> - Visible text per preset id, to translate or reword. A blank text keeps the default.
- locale: string - BCP 47 locale for the displayed value and the calendar. Default: the ConfigProvider locale, else `en`.
- format: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions - How each end is displayed (the zone is always `timeZone`). The default is the medium date with hours and minutes, and a short zone name after the end. Invalid combinations fall back to the default.
- variant: 'popover' | 'inline' | 'segmented' = 'popover' - Layout. `popover` is a trigger with a dropdown, `inline` a bordered panel that is always open, `segmented` a row of presets with the custom fields below. Unknown values fall back to `popover`.
- size: 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = 'md' - Height of the trigger and the fields: `xs` 28px, `sm` 32px, `md` 36px, `lg` 44px. The segmented row maps `xs` to `sm`. Unknown values fall back to `md`.
- shape: 'rounded' | 'pill' | 'square' = 'rounded' - Corners of the trigger and the fields. Unknown values fall back to `rounded`.
- status: 'default' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error' = 'default' - Status colour plus an icon. `success` and `warning` add hidden text, `error` sets `aria-invalid`. An invalid range sets `error` by itself and shows its message as visible text. In `inline` it colours the panel border. Unknown values fall back to `default`.
- statusLabel: string - Hidden text of the success and warning icons. Defaults to the English text (translate it).
- align: 'start' | 'end' = 'start' - Which trigger edge the dropdown aligns to (`popover`).
- showCalendar: boolean = true - Show the range calendar beside the fields (`popover` and `inline`). The `segmented` variant never shows it.
- hour12: boolean = false - Show the 12-hour clock with an AM/PM segment in the time fields. The value stays 24 hour.
- messages: { incomplete?: string; order?: string; min?: string; max?: string } - Texts of the validation errors. `{min}` and `{max}` are replaced with the limit formatted in the zone. Blank or non-string entries keep the default.
- clearable: boolean = false - Show a clear button while a range is set (`popover` only; hidden when disabled or readonly).
- disabled: boolean = false - Disables every control. Also inherited from a surrounding Field. Closes an open dropdown.
- readonly: boolean = false - Shows the range; nothing can be opened, chosen, typed or cleared.
- required: boolean = false - Adds a visually hidden `requiredLabel` to the description (`aria-required` is not allowed on a button or a group). Also inherited from a surrounding Field.
- invalid: boolean = false - Sets `aria-invalid="true"` and destructive styling regardless of the range. Also set by a Field with an error.
- open: boolean - v-model:open. Controls the dropdown of the `popover` variant; uncontrolled when omitted.
- placeholder: string = 'Pick a time range' - Text shown while no range is set.
- presetsLabel: string = 'Presets' - Accessible name of the presets group. Translate it.
- fromLabel: string = 'From' - Legend of the start fields and the first word of their names (`From date`, `From time`).
- toLabel: string = 'To' - Legend of the end fields and the first word of their names.
- dateLabel: string = 'date' - Last word of the name of each date input.
- timeLabel: string = 'time' - Last word of the name of each time input.
- applyLabel: string = 'Apply' - Text of the button that applies the custom range.
- zoneLabel: string = 'Times are in {zone}' - Visible note above Apply naming the zone. `{zone}` is replaced with the resolved zone name.
- clearLabel: string = 'Clear time range' - aria-label of the clear button.
- requiredLabel: string = 'Required' - Visually hidden description announced while `required` (translate it).
- dialogLabel: string = 'Choose time range' - aria-label of the dropdown dialog (`popover`).
- class: string | object | array - Merged last on the root with tailwind-merge.

Events:
- update:modelValue [value: { from: string; to: string } | null] - A preset was chosen, a valid custom range was applied, or the value was cleared (null). Not emitted for an invalid draft.
- update:open [open: boolean] - The dropdown asked to open or close (`popover`).
- select [selection: { preset: TimeRangePresetId; value: { from: string; to: string } }] - Which preset (or `custom`) produced the value just emitted. Use it to remember that a window was relative.
- validate [result: { valid: boolean; reason: "incomplete" | "order" | "min" | "max" | null; message: string | null; from: string | null; to: string | null }] - The custom fields were edited or applied: whether the draft is valid and why not.
- invalid [result: { valid: boolean; reason: string | null; message: string | null; from: string | null; to: string | null }] - Only when the custom draft is not valid and its message is shown.

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when nothing names the control: no `Field` label, wrapping or `for` label, `aria-label`, or `aria-labelledby` pointing at text (the range or placeholder shown does not count).
- Throws a ContractError when `presetsLabel`, `fromLabel`, `toLabel` or `applyLabel` is blank, when `dialogLabel` is blank, or when `clearLabel` is blank while `clearable` is set.
- Throws a ContractError when `timeZone` is not a zone name that `Intl` accepts (it shows UTC until fixed).
- Throws a ContractError when an entry of `presets` is not one of the documented ids.

Rules:
- Use `v-model` with `{ from: string, to: string } | null`; both are UTC ISO strings and `from <= to`. Never put a relative expression such as "now-15m" in the model: presets resolve to concrete strings when chosen.
- Always set `timeZone` when the audience is not in UTC (it defaults to UTC); it changes display, typed times and the day of `today`/`yesterday`, never the emitted value.
- Pass `now` in tests, stories and server-rendered pages so presets are deterministic.
- Always label it: wrap in `Field` with a label, or set `aria-label`. Use `variant="inline"` or `"segmented"` when the choice should stay visible.
- Use `select` to learn which preset produced the value (store the preset id to refresh a relative window later); use `min`/`max` to bound it.
- Use `DateRangePicker` for whole days and `DatePicker` for one date.

Accessibility:
- `popover`: the trigger is a button with `aria-haspopup="dialog"`, `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` (while open). Its name is the label source (`Field` label, `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`) followed by the visible range, so the visible text is part of the name. Enter, Space or a click toggles the dropdown, ArrowDown opens it with focus on the chosen (or first enabled) preset, Escape closes it and returns focus to the trigger, and Tab out of it closes it.
- `inline` and `segmented` render a `role="group"` named by `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby` or the surrounding `Field` label. `segmented` presets are one `radiogroup`: arrow keys move focus and choose, as in any radio group.
- Presets are a `role="group"` named by `presetsLabel`; each is a real button (32px, 44px on touch) with `aria-pressed` for the chosen one and `disabled` when its range leaves `min` or `max`. The pressed state also has heavier text and a forced-colors border.
- Each end is a `fieldset` with a visible legend. The date input is named `From date`, the time input `From time` (same for the end), so the visible legend is contained in the name. Enter in a date or time field applies the range; Enter on a calendar day only selects the day. Calendar keys are documented on Calendar.
- Errors are visible text with an icon, in a polite `role="status"` region that exists before it has text. A range that fails also sets `aria-invalid` and the error status icon, and the trigger is described by the message. The reason is never conveyed by colour alone.
- `required` is a visually hidden description (`requiredLabel`) because `aria-required` is not allowed on a button or a group. `status` adds an icon, and `success` and `warning` add hidden text.
- Times are shown with a short zone name after the end, and the custom fields state the zone in text (`zoneLabel`). Relative presets are exact elapsed lengths, so a range that spans a daylight saving change is 23 or 25 wall-clock hours long for `yesterday` and the same elapsed time for `last-*`.
- Responsive: field text is 16px below `md`, controls reach 44px on touch pointers, the dropdown is as wide as the trigger below `sm` (the presets and the custom fields stack) and works at 320px. Logical properties only, so right to left mirrors it. Targets stay at least 24px in the dense style packs.

Example: Basic

```vue
  <TimeRangePicker v-model="range" aria-label="Time window" />
  <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{{ range ? range.from + ' to ' + range.to : 'No window chosen' }}</p>
</div>
```
