
Example: Variant: dots

```vue
  { target: null, title: 'Second step', description: 'The filled dot moves on.' },
  { target: null, title: 'Third step', description: 'Last step.' },
]

</script>
```

# Command
group: overlays / Menus
Searchable command palette: an input that filters a keyboard-navigable list of items. Inline or inside a modal `CommandDialog`.

Compose `Command` + `CommandInput` + `CommandList` (+ `CommandEmpty`, `CommandGroup`, `CommandItem`, `CommandShortcut`, `CommandSeparator`). Items are filtered as the user types: every whitespace-separated word of the search must appear (case-insensitive) in the item `value` or its `keywords`. ArrowUp/ArrowDown move the highlight (disabled items are skipped, focus stays in the input), Enter runs the highlighted item via its `select` event, and the first match is highlighted automatically while typing. Use `CommandDialog` for a global Cmd/Ctrl+K palette. Set `shouldFilter` to false to filter yourself (async/server search). `variant` sets where it sits: `palette` (default) is borderless and fills its surface (a `CommandDialog` or a popover); `inline` adds a border and a light shadow so the command list can sit in a page like a card. `size` (`sm` | `md` | `lg`) sets the height of the search row, the row padding and type, and the maximum list height; `CommandDialog` takes the same `size` and also sets its width. Defaults are unchanged. Use `DropdownMenu` for fixed action lists and `Select` or `Combobox` (forms) for picking a form value.

import { Command, CommandInput, CommandList, CommandEmpty, CommandGroup, CommandItem, CommandShortcut, CommandSeparator, CommandDialog } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- defaultValue: string | string[] - Initially selected value(s) when uncontrolled (reka-ui Listbox).
- multiple: boolean - Allow selecting more than one item.
- orientation: 'vertical' | 'horizontal' - Arrow-key direction (reka-ui Listbox).
- dir: 'ltr' | 'rtl' - Reading direction for keyboard navigation.
- disabled: boolean - Disable the whole list.
- selectionBehavior: 'toggle' | 'replace' - How selection behaves in multiple mode (reka-ui).
- by: string | ((a: unknown, b: unknown) => boolean) - How to compare object values.
- asChild: boolean - Render the single slot child instead of a wrapper element.
- as: string | Component - Element or component to render as.
- name: string - Form field name when the list takes part in a form.
- required: boolean - Mark the list required inside a form.
- search: string = '' - Search text (v-model:search).
- modelValue: string | number | object - Last selected item value (v-model). Prefer the item `select` event for actions.
- shouldFilter: boolean = true - Filter items by the search text. Turn off for custom/async filtering.
- loop: boolean = true - Wrap keyboard highlight from last to first item.
- highlightOnHover: boolean = true - Highlight the item under the pointer.
- variant: 'palette' | 'inline' = 'palette' - Surface: `palette` fills its container without a border, `inline` adds a border and light shadow (unknown values fall back to palette). Adds data-variant when inline.
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = 'md' - Search row height, row padding and type, and list max height (unknown values fall back to md). Adds data-size when not md.
- class: string | object | array - Merged onto the root.

Parts:
- CommandInput - Search field with a magnifier icon. Native input attributes (placeholder, aria-label, disabled) fall through.
- CommandList - Scrollable listbox (max-h-80) that contains the groups and items.
    - label: string = 'Results' - Accessible name of the listbox. Ignored when `aria-labelledby` is passed.
- CommandEmpty - Shown only when no item matches. Default text "No results found."
- CommandGroup - Labelled group; hidden while none of its items match.
    - heading: string - Group heading text.
- CommandItem - Selectable row (role=option). Emits `select`.
    - value: string | number | object - Identity and primary search text (objects are only searchable through keywords).
    - keywords: string[] - Extra search terms that are not visible.
    - disabled: boolean = false - Skipped by keyboard navigation and cannot be selected.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last.
- CommandShortcut - Right-aligned keyboard hint inside an item (decorative).
- CommandSeparator - Divider between groups; hidden while a search is active.
- CommandDialog - Modal wrapper: Dialog + sr-only title/description + a Command. Put CommandInput/CommandList inside. Supports v-model:open and v-model:search.
    - open: boolean - Controlled open state (v-model:open).
    - title: string = 'Command palette' - Screen-reader title.
    - description: string = 'Search for a command and press Enter to run it.' - Screen-reader description.
    - shouldFilter: boolean = true - Forwarded to Command.
    - size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = 'md' - Dialog max width from the sm breakpoint (28rem, 36rem, 42rem) and the Command size inside (unknown values fall back to md).
    - class: string | object | array - Merged onto the dialog panel.

Slots:
- default - CommandInput and CommandList.

Events:
- update:search [value: string] - Search text changed.
- update:modelValue [value: AcceptableValue] - An item was selected.

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when a `Command` renders no `CommandEmpty` (it has a default message, and an empty search must be announced).
- Throws a ContractError when a `CommandItem` has no `value` (or a blank one), or shares its `value` with another item in the same `Command`.
- Throws a ContractError when `CommandInput` or `CommandList` has no accessible name (they default to "Search" and "Results"; blanking them throws).
- Throws a ContractError when `CommandDialog` has a blank `title` (it is the screen-reader name of the dialog).

Rules:
- Run actions with @select on CommandItem (close the dialog yourself with v-model:open).
- Every CommandItem needs a unique value; searchable text is the value plus keywords, not the rendered label, so use a descriptive value or add keywords.
- Always render a CommandEmpty so empty results are announced.
- For a global Cmd/Ctrl+K shortcut register the keydown listener in your app and toggle CommandDialog v-model:open (and remove the listener on unmount).
- Use shouldFilter=false when results come from the server.
- Use variant="inline" for a command list placed in a page (border and shadow); the default palette variant is for CommandDialog and popovers. size (sm, md, lg) and variant fall back to md and palette when unknown.

Accessibility:
- CommandInput is the combobox-style text field (default aria-label "Search", override it). CommandList is a named listbox (`label`, default "Results") and items are role=option. The highlighted option is exposed through aria-activedescendant.
- Keyboard: type to filter. ArrowUp and ArrowDown move the highlight (disabled items are skipped, it wraps). Home and End jump. Enter selects. Esc closes a CommandDialog.
- Size and variant change spacing, type and the border only. The input name, listbox name, option roles, keyboard map and live status region are the same in every combination; `lg` uses 16px input text.
- Separators are decorative (hidden from assistive tech), so the listbox contains only options and groups.
- A visually hidden status region reports the number of results, or "No results found.", as the search changes. CommandEmpty is the visible counterpart.
- CommandDialog is a labelled modal dialog (title and description are screen-reader only).

Example: Inline command list
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { faCalendar, faGear, faUser } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons'
</script>

<Command class="max-w-md rounded-lg border shadow-md">
  <CommandInput placeholder="Type a command or search..." />
  <CommandList>
    <CommandEmpty>No results found.</CommandEmpty>
    <CommandGroup heading="Suggestions">
      <CommandItem value="calendar"><Icon :icon="faCalendar" />Calendar</CommandItem>
      <CommandItem value="profile" :keywords="['account', 'user']"><Icon :icon="faUser" />Profile <CommandShortcut>⌘P</CommandShortcut></CommandItem>
      <CommandItem value="billing" disabled>Billing (disabled)</CommandItem>
    </CommandGroup>
    <CommandSeparator />
    <CommandGroup heading="Settings">
      <CommandItem value="settings"><Icon :icon="faGear" />Settings <CommandShortcut>⌘,</CommandShortcut></CommandItem>
    </CommandGroup>
  </CommandList>
</Command>
```

Example: Variants and sizes
```vue
<div class="flex flex-col gap-4">
  <Command variant="inline" class="max-w-md">
    <CommandInput placeholder="Inline variant" aria-label="Search inline commands" />
    <CommandList label="Inline results">
      <CommandEmpty>No results found.</CommandEmpty>
      <CommandItem value="inline-one">First command</CommandItem>
      <CommandItem value="inline-two">Second command</CommandItem>
    </CommandList>
  </Command>
  <Command v-for="size in ['sm', 'md', 'lg']" :key="size" variant="inline" :size="size" class="max-w-md">
    <CommandInput :placeholder="'Size ' + size" :aria-label="'Search size ' + size" />
    <CommandList :label="'Results size ' + size">
      <CommandEmpty>No results found.</CommandEmpty>
      <CommandGroup heading="Commands">
        <CommandItem :value="'open-' + size">Open file <CommandShortcut>Ctrl O</CommandShortcut></CommandItem>
        <CommandItem :value="'save-' + size">Save file</CommandItem>
      </CommandGroup>
    </CommandList>
  </Command>
</div>
```

Example: Command palette dialog
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const open = ref(false)
const picked = ref('none')
</script>

<div class="flex items-center gap-3">
  <Button variant="outline" @click="open = true">Open palette</Button>
  <span class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">picked: {{ picked }}</span>
</div>
<CommandDialog v-model:open="open" title="Quick actions" description="Search and run an action">
  <CommandInput placeholder="Search actions..." />
  <CommandList>
    <CommandEmpty>Nothing found.</CommandEmpty>
    <CommandGroup heading="Actions">
      <CommandItem value="new-file" @select="picked = 'new-file'; open = false">New file</CommandItem>
      <CommandItem value="open-settings" :keywords="['preferences']" @select="picked = 'settings'; open = false">Open settings</CommandItem>
    </CommandGroup>
  </CommandList>
</CommandDialog>
```

# ContextMenu
group: overlays / Menus
Right-click (long-press on touch) menu with items, checkboxes, radios, groups and nested sub menus.

Compose `ContextMenu` + `ContextMenuTrigger` (the region that reacts to right-click or touch long-press) + `ContextMenuContent`, then reuse the same part set as `DropdownMenu`: `ContextMenuItem`, `ContextMenuCheckboxItem`, `ContextMenuRadioGroup`, `ContextMenuRadioItem`, `ContextMenuLabel`, `ContextMenuSeparator`, `ContextMenuGroup`, `ContextMenuSub`, `SubTrigger`, `SubContent` and `ContextMenuShortcut`. The menu opens at the pointer position. Never make it the only way to reach an action: also expose the action in a visible control (touch and keyboard users). Use `DropdownMenu` for button-triggered menus. `density` (`default` | `compact` | `comfortable`) sets the row spacing and `size` (`sm` | `md` | `lg`) sets the type scale, icon size and minimum width, exactly as on `DropdownMenu`; set them once on `ContextMenu` (or on `ContextMenuContent` to override) and every part and sub menu follows. The defaults are unchanged.

import { ContextMenu, ContextMenuTrigger, ContextMenuContent, ContextMenuItem, ContextMenuCheckboxItem, ContextMenuRadioGroup, ContextMenuRadioItem, ContextMenuLabel, ContextMenuSeparator, ContextMenuGroup, ContextMenuSub, ContextMenuSubTrigger, ContextMenuSubContent, ContextMenuShortcut } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- open: boolean - Controlled open state (v-model:open).
- modal: boolean = true - Block pointer interaction outside while open.
- pressOpenDelay: number = 700 - Touch long-press duration in ms before the menu opens.
- dir: 'ltr' | 'rtl' - Reading direction (affects sub-menu arrow keys).
- density: 'default' | 'compact' | 'comfortable' = 'default' - Row spacing for every part inside, sub menus included (unknown values fall back to default).
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = 'md' - Type scale, icon size and minimum width for every part inside (unknown values fall back to md).

Parts:
- ContextMenuTrigger - Region that opens the menu on right-click / long-press. Renders a span by default; use as-child or `as="div"` for blocks.
    - disabled: boolean = false - Use the native browser menu instead.
- ContextMenuContent - Portalled menu surface (role=menu), placed to the right of the pointer and aligned to its start (fixed by reka-ui). Attributes fall through.
    - loop: boolean = false - Wrap keyboard focus from last to first item.
    - density: 'default' | 'compact' | 'comfortable' - Overrides the density set on ContextMenu for this menu (and its sub menus). Adds data-density when not default.
    - size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' - Overrides the size set on ContextMenu for this menu (and its sub menus). Adds data-size when not md.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged onto the surface.
- ContextMenuItem - Action row. Emits `select`; closes the menu unless the event is default-prevented.
    - disabled: boolean = false - Not focusable by pointer, does not fire select.
    - destructive: boolean = false - Destructive colour (data-variant="destructive").
    - inset: boolean = false - Left padding to align with rows that have an indicator.
    - textValue: string - Text used for type-ahead when children are not plain text.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last.
- ContextMenuCheckboxItem - Toggle row with a check indicator (role=menuitemcheckbox). v-model:modelValue.
    - modelValue: boolean | 'indeterminate' - Checked state (v-model).
    - disabled: boolean = false - Disable the row.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last.
- ContextMenuRadioGroup - Groups radio items (role=group). v-model:modelValue holds the selected value.
    - modelValue: string - Selected radio value (v-model).
- ContextMenuRadioItem - Radio row with a dot indicator (role=menuitemradio).
    - value: string - Value written to the group when selected.
    - disabled: boolean = false - Disable the row.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last.
- ContextMenuLabel - Non-interactive heading row; supports `inset`.
    - inset: boolean = false - Align with indicator rows.
- ContextMenuSeparator - Divider line (role=separator).
- ContextMenuGroup - Semantic group (role=group) of related items.
- ContextMenuSub - Wraps a SubTrigger + SubContent pair. Supports v-model:open.
- ContextMenuSubTrigger - Row that opens a sub menu (ArrowRight / hover); shows a chevron; supports `inset`.
- ContextMenuSubContent - Portalled sub-menu surface.
- ContextMenuShortcut - Right-aligned keyboard hint text inside an item (decorative).

Slots:
- default - ContextMenuTrigger and ContextMenuContent.

Events:
- update:open [value: boolean] - Open state changed.

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when the element a `ContextMenuTrigger` renders has no accessible name (an area without text needs `aria-label`).

Rules:
- ContextMenuTrigger wraps the region that should react to right-click; use as="div" for block regions.
- Never put an action ONLY in a context menu; mirror it in a visible control or DropdownMenu.
- Run actions with @select on ContextMenuItem; call event.preventDefault() to keep the menu open.
- Mark dangerous items with the destructive prop and put them last.
- Set density (default, compact, comfortable) and size (sm, md, lg) once on ContextMenu; a value on ContextMenuContent overrides it. Unknown values fall back to default and md.

Accessibility:
- Density and size change spacing and type only: roles, keyboard map and the 44px coarse-pointer row height are the same in every combination.
- Content: role=menu. Items are menuitem, menuitemcheckbox or menuitemradio.
- Keyboard: opens wherever the browser fires a contextmenu event (ContextMenu key, Shift+F10). ArrowUp and ArrowDown move (skipping disabled), Home and End jump, ArrowRight and ArrowLeft open and close sub menus, typing jumps to a matching item, Esc closes and returns focus.
- Touch: long-press opens it. Always provide a visible alternative for the same actions.
- The menu keeps 8px from the viewport edges (collision padding), never grows beyond the available height (it scrolls) and never exceeds the viewport width. Rows are 44px high on coarse pointers. Highlight uses system colours in forced-colors mode. RTL mirrors indicators and chevrons.

Example: Basic
```vue
<ContextMenu>
  <ContextMenuTrigger as="div" class="flex h-32 w-72 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-dashed text-sm text-muted-foreground">
    Right click here
  </ContextMenuTrigger>
  <ContextMenuContent class="w-56">
    <ContextMenuLabel>File</ContextMenuLabel>
    <ContextMenuSeparator />
    <ContextMenuItem>Open <ContextMenuShortcut>⌘O</ContextMenuShortcut></ContextMenuItem>
    <ContextMenuItem>Rename</ContextMenuItem>
    <ContextMenuItem disabled>Share</ContextMenuItem>
    <ContextMenuSub>
      <ContextMenuSubTrigger>Move to</ContextMenuSubTrigger>
      <ContextMenuSubContent>
        <ContextMenuItem>Projects</ContextMenuItem>
        <ContextMenuItem>Archive</ContextMenuItem>
      </ContextMenuSubContent>
    </ContextMenuSub>
    <ContextMenuSeparator />
    <ContextMenuItem destructive>Delete</ContextMenuItem>
  </ContextMenuContent>
</ContextMenu>
```

Example: Checkbox and radio items
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const showHidden = ref(false)
const sort = ref('name')
</script>

<ContextMenu>
  <ContextMenuTrigger as="div" class="flex h-24 w-72 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-dashed text-sm text-muted-foreground">
    hidden={{ showHidden }}, sort={{ sort }}
  </ContextMenuTrigger>
  <ContextMenuContent>
    <ContextMenuCheckboxItem v-model="showHidden">Show hidden files</ContextMenuCheckboxItem>
    <ContextMenuSeparator />
    <ContextMenuRadioGroup v-model="sort">
      <ContextMenuRadioItem value="name">Sort by name</ContextMenuRadioItem>
      <ContextMenuRadioItem value="date">Sort by date</ContextMenuRadioItem>
    </ContextMenuRadioGroup>
  </ContextMenuContent>
</ContextMenu>
```

Example: Densities and sizes
```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
  <ContextMenu v-for="density in ['default', 'compact', 'comfortable']" :key="density" :density="density">
    <ContextMenuTrigger as="div" class="flex h-20 w-40 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-dashed px-2 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">{{ density }} density</ContextMenuTrigger>
    <ContextMenuContent>
      <ContextMenuLabel>File</ContextMenuLabel>
      <ContextMenuItem>Open</ContextMenuItem>
      <ContextMenuItem inset>Rename</ContextMenuItem>
      <ContextMenuSeparator />
      <ContextMenuItem destructive>Delete</ContextMenuItem>
    </ContextMenuContent>
  </ContextMenu>
  <ContextMenu v-for="size in ['sm', 'md', 'lg']" :key="size" :size="size">
    <ContextMenuTrigger as="div" class="flex h-20 w-40 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-dashed px-2 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">size {{ size }}</ContextMenuTrigger>
    <ContextMenuContent>
      <ContextMenuLabel>File</ContextMenuLabel>
      <ContextMenuItem>Open <ContextMenuShortcut>Ctrl O</ContextMenuShortcut></ContextMenuItem>
      <ContextMenuItem>Rename</ContextMenuItem>
      <ContextMenuSeparator />
      <ContextMenuItem destructive>Delete</ContextMenuItem>
    </ContextMenuContent>
  </ContextMenu>
</div>
```

# DropdownMenu
group: overlays / Menus
Menu of actions opened from a button, with items, checkboxes, radios, groups and nested sub menus.

Compose `DropdownMenu` + `DropdownMenuTrigger` + `DropdownMenuContent` and fill it with `DropdownMenuItem`, `DropdownMenuCheckboxItem`, `DropdownMenuRadioGroup`, `DropdownMenuRadioItem`, `DropdownMenuLabel`, `DropdownMenuSeparator`, `DropdownMenuGroup`, `DropdownMenuSub`, `SubTrigger`, `SubContent` and `DropdownMenuShortcut`. Items fire `select` (call `event.preventDefault()` to keep the menu open). Use for lists of ACTIONS; use `Select` (forms) for choosing a value and `Popover` for arbitrary content. Density: `density="compact"` (on `DropdownMenu`, or on `DropdownMenuContent` to override) tightens every row, label, separator and the surface padding for toolbars, table row actions and dense admin UIs; it propagates to all items and sub menus through provide/inject, so you set it once. `density="comfortable"` does the opposite: roomier rows for touch-first or sparse menus. `size` (`sm` | `md` | `lg`) sets the type scale, icon size and minimum width independently of the density; `md` is the default. The default density and size are unchanged. For a right-click menu use `ContextMenu`.

import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuTrigger, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuCheckboxItem, DropdownMenuRadioGroup, DropdownMenuRadioItem, DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuSeparator, DropdownMenuGroup, DropdownMenuSub, DropdownMenuSubTrigger, DropdownMenuSubContent, DropdownMenuShortcut } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- open: boolean - Controlled open state (v-model:open).
- defaultOpen: boolean = false - Initial state when uncontrolled.
- modal: boolean = true - Block pointer interaction outside while open.
- dir: 'ltr' | 'rtl' - Reading direction (affects sub-menu arrow keys).
- density: 'default' | 'compact' | 'comfortable' = 'default' - Row spacing for every part inside, sub menus included (unknown values fall back to default).
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = 'md' - Type scale, icon size and minimum width for every part inside (unknown values fall back to md).

Parts:
- DropdownMenuTrigger - Opens the menu (use as-child on a Button). Enter, Space and ArrowDown also open it.
- DropdownMenuContent - Portalled menu surface (role=menu). Attributes fall through.
    - side: 'top' | 'right' | 'bottom' | 'left' = 'bottom' - Preferred side of the trigger.
    - align: 'start' | 'center' | 'end' = 'start' - Alignment along the side axis.
    - sideOffset: number = 4 - Gap in px between trigger and menu.
    - loop: boolean = false - Wrap keyboard focus from last to first item.
    - density: 'default' | 'compact' | 'comfortable' - Overrides the density set on DropdownMenu for this menu (and its sub menus). Adds data-density when not default.
    - size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' - Overrides the size set on DropdownMenu for this menu (and its sub menus). Adds data-size when not md.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged onto the surface.
- DropdownMenuItem - Action row. Emits `select`; closes the menu unless the event is default-prevented.
    - disabled: boolean = false - Not focusable by pointer, does not fire select.
    - destructive: boolean = false - Destructive colour (data-variant="destructive").
    - inset: boolean = false - Left padding to align with rows that have an indicator.
    - textValue: string - Text used for type-ahead when children are not plain text.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last.
- DropdownMenuCheckboxItem - Toggle row with a check indicator (role=menuitemcheckbox). v-model:modelValue.
    - modelValue: boolean | 'indeterminate' - Checked state (v-model).
    - disabled: boolean = false - Disable the row.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last.
- DropdownMenuRadioGroup - Groups radio items (role=group). v-model:modelValue holds the selected value.
    - modelValue: string - Selected radio value (v-model).
- DropdownMenuRadioItem - Radio row with a dot indicator (role=menuitemradio).
    - value: string - Value written to the group when selected.
    - disabled: boolean = false - Disable the row.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last.
- DropdownMenuLabel - Non-interactive heading row; supports `inset`.
    - inset: boolean = false - Align with indicator rows.
- DropdownMenuSeparator - Divider line (role=separator).
- DropdownMenuGroup - Semantic group (role=group) of related items.
- DropdownMenuSub - Wraps a SubTrigger + SubContent pair. Supports v-model:open.
- DropdownMenuSubTrigger - Row that opens a sub menu (ArrowRight / hover); shows a chevron; supports `inset`.
- DropdownMenuSubContent - Portalled sub-menu surface.
- DropdownMenuShortcut - Right-aligned keyboard hint text inside an item (decorative).

Slots:
- default - DropdownMenuTrigger and DropdownMenuContent.

Events:
- update:open [value: boolean] - Open state changed.

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when the element a `DropdownMenuTrigger` renders has no accessible name (an icon-only button needs `aria-label`).

Rules:
- Use DropdownMenuTrigger as-child on a Button; give icon-only triggers an aria-label.
- Run actions with @select on DropdownMenuItem; call event.preventDefault() to keep the menu open.
- Mark dangerous items with the destructive prop and put them last, after a DropdownMenuSeparator.
- Use DropdownMenuCheckboxItem/RadioGroup with v-model; do not simulate toggles with plain items.
- Menus are for actions, not form value selection; use Select for that.
- Use density="compact" on DropdownMenu for dense UIs (table row actions, toolbars); it applies to all items and sub menus. Default density is the right choice for primary navigation-like menus and touch-first screens.
- Unknown density or size values fall back to default and md; a density or size on DropdownMenuContent overrides the one on DropdownMenu.
- Use density="comfortable" for touch-first menus and size="sm" or "lg" to match the type scale around the trigger.

Accessibility:
- Density and size change spacing and type only: roles, keyboard map and the 44px coarse-pointer row height are the same in every combination.
- Trigger: aria-haspopup=menu, aria-expanded. Content: role=menu. Items are menuitem, menuitemcheckbox or menuitemradio.
- Keyboard: Enter, Space and ArrowDown open. ArrowUp and ArrowDown move (skipping disabled), Home and End jump, ArrowRight and ArrowLeft open and close sub menus, typing jumps to a matching item, Esc closes and returns focus to the trigger.
- Icon-only triggers need an aria-label.
- The menu keeps 8px from the viewport edges (collision padding), scrolls when taller than the available space and never exceeds the viewport width. Rows are 44px high on coarse pointers. Highlight uses system colours in forced-colors mode. RTL mirrors indicators and chevrons.

Example: Actions
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { faEllipsis } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons'
</script>

<DropdownMenu>
  <DropdownMenuTrigger as-child>
    <Button variant="outline" size="icon" aria-label="Open menu"><Icon :icon="faEllipsis" /></Button>
  </DropdownMenuTrigger>
  <DropdownMenuContent class="w-56">
    <DropdownMenuLabel>My account</DropdownMenuLabel>
    <DropdownMenuSeparator />
    <DropdownMenuGroup>
      <DropdownMenuItem>Profile <DropdownMenuShortcut>⌘P</DropdownMenuShortcut></DropdownMenuItem>
      <DropdownMenuItem>Settings <DropdownMenuShortcut>⌘,</DropdownMenuShortcut></DropdownMenuItem>
      <DropdownMenuItem disabled>Billing</DropdownMenuItem>
    </DropdownMenuGroup>
    <DropdownMenuSub>
      <DropdownMenuSubTrigger>Invite</DropdownMenuSubTrigger>
      <DropdownMenuSubContent>
        <DropdownMenuItem>Email</DropdownMenuItem>
        <DropdownMenuItem>Link</DropdownMenuItem>
      </DropdownMenuSubContent>
    </DropdownMenuSub>
    <DropdownMenuSeparator />
    <DropdownMenuItem destructive>Delete account</DropdownMenuItem>
  </DropdownMenuContent>
</DropdownMenu>
```

Example: Checkbox and radio items
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">

const density = ref('comfortable')
</script>

<div class="flex items-center gap-3">
  <DropdownMenu>
    <DropdownMenuTrigger as-child><Button variant="outline">View</Button></DropdownMenuTrigger>

      <DropdownMenuLabel>Appearance</DropdownMenuLabel>
      <DropdownMenuCheckboxItem v-model="showToolbar">Show toolbar</DropdownMenuCheckboxItem>

      <DropdownMenuRadioGroup v-model="density">
        <DropdownMenuRadioItem value="compact">Compact</DropdownMenuRadioItem>

      </DropdownMenuRadioGroup>
    </DropdownMenuContent>
  </DropdownMenu>
  <span class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">toolbar={{ showToolbar }}, density={{ density }}</span>
</div>
```

# AlertDialog
group: overlays / Modals
Modal confirmation that interrupts the user and requires an explicit Cancel or Action choice.

Use for destructive or irreversible confirmations ("Delete project?"). Unlike `Dialog` it has no close (X) button and does NOT close on overlay click; only `AlertDialogCancel`, `AlertDialogAction` or Esc dismiss it. Focus starts on the Cancel button. Style the confirm button with `variant="destructive"` for destructive actions, or set `tone="danger"` on `AlertDialogContent`: it tints the border and makes `AlertDialogAction` destructive unless the action sets its own `variant`. `tone` also takes `warning`, `success` and `info` (border only). `size` (`xs` | `sm` | `md` | `lg`) sets the max width and `variant="centered"` centres the text and the buttons; `alertDialogContentVariants` is exported for reuse. For forms and general content use `Dialog`; for side panels use `Sheet`.

import { AlertDialog, AlertDialogTrigger, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- unmountOnHide: boolean - Unmount the content from the DOM when closed (reka-ui). Leave at the default unless you need the content to stay mounted.
- open: boolean - Controlled open state (v-model:open).
- defaultOpen: boolean = false - Initial state when uncontrolled.

Parts:
- AlertDialogTrigger - Element that opens the dialog (use as-child on a Button).
- AlertDialogContent - Portalled panel with scrim overlay. Accepts reka-ui DialogContent props (e.g. `forceMount`) and falls attributes through.
    - size: 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = 'md' - Max-width preset from the sm breakpoint (unknown values fall back to md).
    - variant: 'default' | 'centered' = 'default' - Text and footer alignment (unknown values fall back to default). Adds nothing but classes.
    - tone: 'neutral' | 'danger' | 'warning' | 'success' | 'info' = 'neutral' - Border colour (unknown values fall back to neutral). `danger` also makes AlertDialogAction destructive by default. Adds data-tone when not neutral.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged onto the panel.
- AlertDialogHeader - Stacks title + description.
- AlertDialogTitle - Required accessible name (aria-labelledby).
- AlertDialogDescription - Explains the consequence (aria-describedby).
- AlertDialogFooter - Right-aligned action row (stacked on mobile).
- AlertDialogAction - Confirms and closes. Styled with `buttonVariants`.
    - variant: ButtonVariant = 'default' ('destructive' inside a danger dialog) - Button variant; an explicit value always wins. Use 'destructive' for destructive confirmations.
    - size: ButtonSize = 'md' - Button size.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last.
- AlertDialogCancel - Dismisses without acting. Receives initial focus.
    - variant: ButtonVariant = 'outline' - Button variant.
    - size: ButtonSize = 'md' - Button size.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last.

Slots:
- default - AlertDialogTrigger and AlertDialogContent.

Events:
- update:open [value: boolean] - Open state changed.

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when `AlertDialogContent` is shown without an `AlertDialogTitle` (or `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby`).
- Throws a ContractError when `AlertDialogContent` is shown without an `AlertDialogDescription` (or `aria-describedby`): an alert dialog must say what is being confirmed.

Rules:
- Use AlertDialog only for confirmations that need an explicit decision; use Dialog for forms.
- Always include AlertDialogTitle and AlertDialogDescription.
- Destructive confirmations: <AlertDialogAction variant="destructive"> or tone="danger" on AlertDialogContent; keep Cancel as the safe default.
- size (xs, sm, md, lg), variant (default, centered) and tone (neutral, danger, warning, success, info) fall back to md, default and neutral when unknown.
- AlertDialogAction/Cancel close the dialog by themselves; do not also toggle open manually.

Accessibility:
- role="alertdialog", aria-labelledby on AlertDialogTitle, aria-describedby on AlertDialogDescription. Page content behind it is inert.
- Focus is trapped, starts on Cancel (the safe action) and returns to the trigger on close.
- Esc cancels. A click on the overlay does not close it: an explicit choice is required.
- Tone is a border colour (and the default action colour for danger). The title and description must say what is at stake in words.
- The panel is capped at the viewport width minus 2rem, keeps `100dvh` minus 2rem as max height and scrolls inside itself. Scroll chaining to the page is stopped.

Example: Destructive confirmation
```vue
<AlertDialog>
  <AlertDialogTrigger as-child><Button variant="destructive">Delete project</Button></AlertDialogTrigger>
  <AlertDialogContent>
    <AlertDialogHeader>
      <AlertDialogTitle>Delete this project?</AlertDialogTitle>
      <AlertDialogDescription>This permanently removes the project and all of its data. This cannot be undone.</AlertDialogDescription>
    </AlertDialogHeader>
    <AlertDialogFooter>
      <AlertDialogCancel>Keep project</AlertDialogCancel>
      <AlertDialogAction variant="destructive">Delete</AlertDialogAction>
    </AlertDialogFooter>
  </AlertDialogContent>
</AlertDialog>
```

Example: Tones
```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
  <AlertDialog v-for="tone in ['neutral', 'danger', 'warning', 'success', 'info']" :key="tone">
    <AlertDialogTrigger as-child><Button variant="outline">{{ tone }}</Button></AlertDialogTrigger>
    <AlertDialogContent :tone="tone" size="sm">
      <AlertDialogHeader>
        <AlertDialogTitle>Confirm the {{ tone }} action</AlertDialogTitle>
        <AlertDialogDescription>The border follows the tone and this text names it.</AlertDialogDescription>
      </AlertDialogHeader>
      <AlertDialogFooter>
```

# Dialog
group: overlays / Modals
Modal window that blocks the page until dismissed. Compound component built on reka-ui.

Compose `Dialog` + `DialogTrigger` + `DialogContent` (+ `DialogHeader`, `DialogTitle`, `DialogDescription`, `DialogFooter`, `DialogClose`). Control with `v-model:open` or leave uncontrolled. A `DialogTitle` is REQUIRED for accessibility. Variations on `DialogContent`: `variant="default"` centred card for general content; `variant="centered-form"` roomier padding with centred text/header/footer for single-purpose forms (sign in, invite, rename); `variant="fullscreen"` covers the viewport for editors, wizards and immersive flows; `variant="drawer-bottom-on-mobile"` is a bottom sheet below the `sm` breakpoint and a normal centred dialog from `sm` up (use for mobile-first pickers and forms). `size` (`xs` | `sm` | `md` | `lg` | `xl` | `2xl` | `full`) sets the max width from `sm` up and is ignored by `fullscreen`. `tone` (`neutral` | `danger` | `warning` | `success` | `info`) tints the panel border for a dialog about a risk or an outcome; the colour never carries the meaning, so the title and description must say it in words. `dialogContentVariants` is exported for reuse. Use `AlertDialog` for destructive confirmations and `Sheet` for side panels.

import { Dialog, DialogTrigger, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription, DialogFooter, DialogClose } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- unmountOnHide: boolean - Unmount the content from the DOM when closed (reka-ui). Leave at the default unless you need the content to stay mounted.
- open: boolean - Controlled open state (v-model:open).
- defaultOpen: boolean = false - Initial state when uncontrolled.
- modal: boolean = true - Block interaction outside.

Parts:
- DialogTrigger - Element that opens the dialog (use as-child on a Button).
- DialogContent - Portalled panel with overlay and built-in close X.
    - variant: 'default' | 'centered-form' | 'fullscreen' | 'drawer-bottom-on-mobile' = 'default' - Layout of the panel (unknown values fall back to default).
    - size: 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' | '2xl' | 'full' = 'md' - Max-width preset from the sm breakpoint (unknown values fall back to md; ignored by fullscreen).
    - tone: 'neutral' | 'danger' | 'warning' | 'success' | 'info' = 'neutral' - Border colour for a danger, warning, success or info dialog (unknown values fall back to neutral). Adds data-tone when not neutral.
    - showClose: boolean = true - Show the X button.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged onto the panel (wins over variant classes).
- DialogHeader - Stacks title + description.
- DialogTitle - Required accessible name.
- DialogDescription - Supporting text (aria-describedby).
- DialogFooter - Right-aligned action row.
- DialogClose - Closes the dialog; use as-child on a Button.

Events:
- update:open [value: boolean] - Open state changed.

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when `DialogContent` is shown without a `DialogTitle` inside it (or `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby` on the content). Wrap the title in `VisuallyHidden` when it must not be visible.

Rules:
- Always include DialogTitle (wrap in VisuallyHidden if it must not be visible).
- Do not nest dialogs more than one level deep.
- Pick variant by intent: default for general content, centered-form for short forms, fullscreen for editors/wizards, drawer-bottom-on-mobile for mobile-first pickers.
- size only sets max width from the sm breakpoint; fullscreen ignores it. Unknown variant/size values fall back to default/md.
- tone (neutral, danger, warning, success, info) only tints the border; say the situation in the title. Unknown tones fall back to neutral.
- Override anything with the class prop; it is merged last.

Accessibility:
- role=dialog, aria-modal, aria-labelledby on DialogTitle and aria-describedby on DialogDescription. Content outside is inert.
- Focus moves in, is trapped, and returns to the trigger on close. Esc and a click on the overlay close it.
- The panel is at most the viewport width minus 2rem, has `100dvh` minus 2rem as max height and scrolls inside itself. Body scroll is locked without a layout shift and scroll chaining is stopped.
- Tone is a border colour only. It never replaces words: write the risk or the outcome in the title and description.
- The close button is 28px square, 40px on coarse pointers, and is positioned with logical properties. The fullscreen and bottom-drawer variants respect the safe-area inset.

Example: Basic
```vue
<Dialog>
  <DialogTrigger as-child><Button variant="outline">Open</Button></DialogTrigger>
  <DialogContent>
    <DialogHeader>
      <DialogTitle>Edit profile</DialogTitle>
      <DialogDescription>Make changes and save when you are done.</DialogDescription>
    </DialogHeader>
    <Input placeholder="Display name" aria-label="Display name" />
    <DialogFooter>
      <DialogClose as-child><Button variant="outline">Cancel</Button></DialogClose>
      <Button>Save</Button>
    </DialogFooter>
  </DialogContent>
</Dialog>
```

Example: Sizes
```vue

  <Dialog v-for="size in ['xs', 'sm', 'md', 'lg', 'xl', '2xl', 'full']" :key="size">
    <DialogTrigger as-child><Button variant="outline">{{ size }}</Button></DialogTrigger>
    <DialogContent :size="size">
      <DialogHeader>
        <DialogTitle>Size {{ size }}</DialogTitle>
        <DialogDescription>Max-width preset applied from the sm breakpoint.</DialogDescription>
      </DialogHeader>
    </DialogContent>
  </Dialog>
</div>
```

Example: Tones
```vue

      <DialogHeader>
        <DialogTitle>Tone {{ tone }}</DialogTitle>

      <DialogFooter>
        <DialogClose as-child><Button variant="outline">Close</Button></DialogClose>
```

# Sheet
group: overlays / Modals
Modal panel that slides in from the top, right, bottom or left edge. Compound component built on reka-ui Dialog.

Compose `Sheet` + `SheetTrigger` + `SheetContent` (+ `SheetHeader`, `SheetTitle`, `SheetDescription`, `SheetFooter`, `SheetClose`). Use for filters, detail panes, mobile navigation, and long forms that should not leave the page. Variations: `side` (`top` | `right` | `bottom` | `left`) picks the edge and slide animation (right for detail/filters, left for navigation, bottom for mobile action sheets, top for banners/search); `size` (`sm` | `md` | `lg` | `xl` | `full`) sets the width on left/right and the max height on top/bottom; `inset` makes a floating card that keeps a margin to the viewport edges with rounded corners (use for settings drawers and previews that should feel detached from the page chrome); `variant="flush"` removes the padding and gap so a nav list or a table runs edge to edge; `tone` (`neutral` | `danger` | `warning` | `success` | `info`) tints the border (the title must still say the situation in words). Use `Dialog` for centred modals and `Popover` for small anchored content. `sheetVariants` is exported for reusing the panel styling.

import { Sheet, SheetTrigger, SheetContent, SheetHeader, SheetTitle, SheetDescription, SheetFooter, SheetClose } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- unmountOnHide: boolean - Unmount the content from the DOM when closed (reka-ui). Leave at the default unless you need the content to stay mounted.
- open: boolean - Controlled open state (v-model:open).
- defaultOpen: boolean = false - Initial state when uncontrolled.
- modal: boolean = true - Block interaction outside.

Parts:
- SheetTrigger - Element that opens the sheet (use as-child on a Button).
- SheetContent - Portalled sliding panel with scrim overlay and built-in close X.
    - side: 'top' | 'right' | 'bottom' | 'left' = 'right' - Edge it slides in from (unknown values fall back to right).
    - size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' | 'full' = 'md' - Width preset for left/right, max-height preset for top/bottom.
    - inset: boolean = false - Floating card look: margin to the viewport edges, rounded corners, full border (adds data-inset).
    - variant: 'default' | 'flush' = 'default' - Padding: `flush` removes the padding and the gap, keeping the safe-area padding on the docked edge (unknown values fall back to default). Adds data-variant when flush.
    - tone: 'neutral' | 'danger' | 'warning' | 'success' | 'info' = 'neutral' - Border colour (unknown values fall back to neutral). Adds data-tone when not neutral.
    - showClose: boolean = true - Show the X button.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged onto the panel (wins over variant classes).
- SheetHeader - Stacks title + description.
- SheetTitle - Required accessible name.
- SheetDescription - Supporting text (aria-describedby).
- SheetFooter - Action row pushed to the bottom of the panel.
- SheetClose - Closes the sheet; use as-child on a Button.

Slots:
- default - SheetTrigger and SheetContent.

Events:
- update:open [value: boolean] - Open state changed.

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when `SheetContent` is shown without a `SheetTitle` inside it (or `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby` on the content).

Rules:
- Always include SheetTitle (wrap in VisuallyHidden if it must not be visible).
- Choose side=right for detail/filters, left for navigation, bottom for mobile action sheets.
- Choose size=sm/md for forms and filters, lg/xl for detail panes, full for immersive flows; on top/bottom sides size limits the height.
- Use inset for a floating, rounded panel; combine it with any side and size.
- Use variant="flush" when the content has its own full-width rows; tone only tints the border.
- Unknown side/size/variant/tone values fall back to right/md/default/neutral; the class prop is merged last and wins.
- Do not put destructive confirmations in a Sheet; use AlertDialog.

Accessibility:
- role=dialog, aria-modal, aria-labelledby on SheetTitle and aria-describedby on SheetDescription. Content outside is inert.
- Focus moves in, is trapped and returns to the trigger on close. Esc and a click on the overlay close it.
- Panels scroll inside themselves, stop scroll chaining and respect the safe-area inset on the docked edge. Side sheets are 75% of the viewport wide below `sm`.
- Tone is a border colour only; state the situation in the title and description. The flush variant keeps the focusable close button and the safe-area padding.
- Slide animations respect reduced motion through the theme animation tokens.

Example: Sides
```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
  <Sheet v-for="side in ['top', 'right', 'bottom', 'left']" :key="side">
    <SheetTrigger as-child><Button variant="outline" class="capitalize">{{ side }}</Button></SheetTrigger>
    <SheetContent :side="side">
      <SheetHeader>
        <SheetTitle>Sheet from the {{ side }}</SheetTitle>
        <SheetDescription>Press Esc or click outside to close.</SheetDescription>
      </SheetHeader>
    </SheetContent>
  </Sheet>
</div>
```

```vue
    <SheetTrigger as-child><Button variant="outline">{{ size }}</Button></SheetTrigger>
    <SheetContent :size="size">
      <SheetHeader>
        <SheetTitle>Size {{ size }}</SheetTitle>
        <SheetDescription>Width preset on the right edge.</SheetDescription>
      </SheetHeader>
    </SheetContent>
  </Sheet>
```

# ShortcutsDialog
group: overlays / Modals
Help dialog that lists the keyboard shortcuts of a page, grouped, with keys drawn as Kbd chips. Opens with `?` by default.

Use it once per page or app shell. Shortcuts come from two places: everything registered with the `useHotkeys` composable (listed automatically, grouped by `group`, with its `description`), and an optional `shortcuts` array for display-only entries such as combos the browser owns. Entries without a description are not listed.

`useHotkeys(map | array | getter, options?)` registers combos for the life of a component: `"mod+k"` (`mod` is Cmd on macOS and Ctrl elsewhere), plain keys (`"?"`, `"esc"`, `"f5"`), and sequences joined with `then` (`"g then d"`, up to 5 steps, `timeout` ms between steps, default 1000). It listens on the document, or on one element with `target`. Events that come from inputs, textareas, selects and contenteditable elements are ignored unless `allowInInputs` is set. Events that are already `defaultPrevented`, and (unless `allowInModal` is set) key presses outside an open `aria-modal="true"` dialog, are ignored too. `shift+1` matches the physical digit key; Alt+letter matches the character the layout produces. `preventDefault` defaults to true. Invalid combos (empty, modifier-only, unknown key names, longer than 5 steps) are ignored and warned about in development. Two shortcuts that collide (same combo, or one sequence starting another) warn in development and are silent in production. Write punctuation as the character it produces (`"?"`, not `"shift+/"`). The registry is filled on mount in the browser only, so server rendering is safe. `listHotkeys()`, `useRegisteredHotkeys()`, `parseHotkey()` and `formatHotkey()` are exported for custom help screens.

Variations: `size` (`sm` | `md` | `lg` | `xl`) is the max width from the `sm` breakpoint up; `layout` is `list` (one column) or `columns` (two columns from `sm` up, pair with `size="lg"`); `density` is `comfortable` or `compact`; `headingLevel` sets the level of the group names (the dialog title is an h2). Open it with the `hotkey`, with a `trigger` slot, or with `v-model:open`. While it is open, other registered shortcuts still run: disable them with their `enabled` option if they would act on the page behind the dialog. Use `Command` for a searchable palette and `Dialog` for anything that is not a shortcut list.

import { ShortcutsDialog } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- title*: string - Accessible name and visible heading of the dialog. Throws a ContractError when blank.
- description: string - Supporting text under the title (aria-describedby).
- open: boolean = false - Open state (v-model:open). Uncontrolled when omitted.
- hotkey: string = '?' - Combo that opens the dialog, e.g. `?` or `mod+/`. An empty string turns it off. An invalid combo throws a ContractError.
- hotkeyLabel: string = 'Show keyboard shortcuts' - Description the dialog's own shortcut gets in the list.
- registered: boolean = true - Also list every shortcut registered with `useHotkeys` on the page.
- shortcuts: ShortcutItem[] = [] - Display-only entries: `{ keys, description, group? }`. Invalid combos and blank descriptions are skipped. Duplicates of registered entries are merged.
- emptyText: string = 'No keyboard shortcuts are registered on this page.' - Shown when nothing is listed.
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' = 'md' - Max width from the `sm` breakpoint up: max-w-sm, max-w-lg, max-w-2xl, max-w-4xl. Unknown values fall back to md.
- layout: 'list' | 'columns' = 'list' - `list` stacks the groups in one column; `columns` uses two columns from the `sm` breakpoint up. Unknown values fall back to list.
- density: 'comfortable' | 'compact' = 'comfortable' - Row padding, text size and key chip size. Unknown values fall back to comfortable.
- headingLevel: 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 = 3 - Heading level of the group names. Unknown values fall back to 3.
- class: string | object | array - Merged onto the dialog panel (wins over internal classes).

Slots:
- trigger - Element that opens the dialog (rendered as the trigger; use a Button).

Events:
- update:open [value: boolean] - Open state changed.

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when `title` is empty or missing.
- Throws a ContractError when `hotkey` is not a valid key combination (use an empty string to turn it off).

Rules:
- Render one ShortcutsDialog per app; register shortcuts with useHotkeys and give each a `description` and `group` so it is listed.
- Always set `title`. Use `hotkey=""` for a second dialog on the same page: two dialogs with the same hotkey conflict.
- Write combos as "mod+k", "g then d", "?" or "esc". `mod` is Cmd on macOS and Ctrl elsewhere. Never write "shift+/" for "?".
- Do not register single-key shortcuts that act while typing: the composable ignores inputs unless `allowInInputs` is set.
- Use `registered` false plus `shortcuts` for a fixed list; use `hidden` on a registration to keep it out of the list.
- Disable page shortcuts with `enabled` while a modal is open if they would act on content behind it.

Accessibility:
- Built on Dialog: role=dialog, focus is trapped and returns to the trigger on close, Esc closes, the title names it.
- Each shortcut is a list item; groups are lists named by their heading. The visual key chips are hidden from assistive technology and replaced by a spoken form such as "Control plus K" or "G then D".
- Shortcuts never fire while focus is in a text field (WCAG 2.1.4); use `allowInInputs` only for combos with a modifier.
- A single-character shortcut can be turned off or remapped by the app through `enabled` or `hotkey`. Do not register single printable keys without a way to turn them off.
- Key chips are 24px high (20px in compact density); the list is read-only, so no pointer target size applies to the rows.

Example: Registered shortcuts
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const last = ref('none')
useHotkeys({
  'mod+k': { handler: () => (last.value = 'search'), description: 'Search the catalogue', group: 'Navigation' },
  'g then d': { handler: () => (last.value = 'dashboard'), description: 'Go to the dashboard', group: 'Navigation' },
  'g then o': { handler: () => (last.value = 'orders'), description: 'Go to orders', group: 'Navigation' },
  n: { handler: () => (last.value = 'new shipment'), description: 'Create a shipment', group: 'Shipments' },
})
</script>

<div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
  <ShortcutsDialog title="Keyboard shortcuts" description="Shortcuts for the Kestrel Freight console. Sample data.">
    <template #trigger><Button variant="outline">Show shortcuts</Button></template>
  </ShortcutsDialog>
  <p role="status" class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Last shortcut: {{ last }}</p>
</div>
```

Example: Display-only list
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const open = ref(false)
const shortcuts = [
  { keys: 'mod+k', description: 'Search the catalogue', group: 'Navigation' },
  { keys: 'g then d', description: 'Go to the dashboard', group: 'Navigation' },
  { keys: 'g then o', description: 'Go to orders', group: 'Navigation' },
  { keys: 'n', description: 'Create a shipment', group: 'Shipments' },
  { keys: 'shift+e', description: 'Export the selected rows', group: 'Shipments' },
]
</script>

<div>
  <Button variant="outline" @click="open = true">Open the list</Button>
  <ShortcutsDialog v-model:open="open" title="Console shortcuts" hotkey="" :registered="false" :shortcuts="shortcuts" />
</div>
```

Example: Two columns

```vue
  { keys: 'mod+k', description: 'Search the catalogue', group: 'Navigation' },
  { keys: 'g then d', description: 'Go to the dashboard', group: 'Navigation' },
  { keys: 'g then o', description: 'Go to orders', group: 'Navigation' },
  { keys: 'n', description: 'Create a shipment', group: 'Shipments' },
  { keys: 'shift+e', description: 'Export the selected rows', group: 'Shipments' },
```


Example: Sizes
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const shortcuts = [{ keys: 'mod+k', description: 'Search the catalogue' }]
</script>

<div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
  <ShortcutsDialog v-for="size in ['sm', 'md', 'lg', 'xl']" :key="size" :title="'Size ' + size" hotkey="" :registered="false" :shortcuts="shortcuts" :size="size">
    <template #trigger><Button variant="outline">{{ size }}</Button></template>
  </ShortcutsDialog>
</div>
```

Example: Another hotkey and heading level
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const open = ref(false)
const shortcuts = [{ keys: 'esc', description: 'Close the dialog', group: 'Dialog' }]
</script>

<div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
  <ShortcutsDialog v-model:open="open" title="Help" hotkey="mod+/" :registered="false" :shortcuts="shortcuts" :heading-level="4" description="Press Ctrl+/ or Cmd+/ to open this list from anywhere." />
  <Button variant="outline" @click="open = true">Open help</Button>
  <span class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Shortcut: <KbdGroup :keys="['Ctrl', '/']" separator="+" /></span>
</div>
```

Example: Scoped shortcuts with useHotkeys
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const region = ref(null)
const count = ref(0)
useHotkeys(
  {
    j: () => count.value++,
    k: () => count.value--,
    'g then r': () => (count.value = 0),
  },
  { target: region, group: 'Counter' },
)
</script>

<div ref="region" role="group" aria-label="Counter shortcuts" tabindex="0" class="max-w-sm rounded-md border p-4 text-sm outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-ring">
  <p>Count: <span class="tabular-nums font-semibold">{{ count }}</span></p>
  <p class="text-muted-foreground">Focus here, then press <Kbd>j</Kbd> or <Kbd>k</Kbd>.</p>
</div>
```

# BackToTop
group: navigation / Accessibility
Floating button that appears after scrolling down and scrolls the window back to the top.

Mount once near the root of a long page. It is rendered only while `window` has scrolled past `threshold` px (tracked with the library's own `useWindowScroll` helper, no extra dependency), is fixed to the bottom end corner (`end-6 bottom-6`, so it mirrors in RTL; override with `class`), and scrolls smoothly unless `smooth` is false or the user prefers reduced motion. It tracks the window only; for scrollable containers build the button yourself.

import { BackToTop } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- threshold: number = 300 - Scroll distance in px after which the button appears. Invalid or negative values fall back to 300.
- label: string = 'Back to top' - aria-label and title.
- variant: 'button' | 'pill' = 'button' - `button`: icon-only circle. `pill`: the arrow plus the `label` as visible text. Unknown values fall back to `button`.
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = 'md' - Circle: 36px, 44px or 56px. Pill: 32px, 36px or 44px high (at least 44px on coarse pointers). Unknown values fall back to `md`.
- smooth: boolean = true - Smooth scrolling (ignored under prefers-reduced-motion).
- class: string | object | array - Merged last (e.g. `left-6 right-auto`).

Slots:
- default - Replaces the arrow icon (and, in the `pill` variant, the visible label).

Rules:
- Mount a single BackToTop per page.
- Do not wrap it in a container with transform/overflow that breaks position: fixed.

Accessibility:
- Native button with an accessible name (`label`, also used as the title); not rendered at all while hidden, so it is never a hidden tab stop.
- The `pill` variant shows the label as visible text, which is also its accessible name (label in name). Target is a 44px circle by default (36px at `sm`, which grows to 44px on coarse pointers; 56px at `lg`). Smooth scrolling and the fade-in are off under prefers-reduced-motion.
- It sits at the end of the DOM-order tab sequence only when the page is scrolled; place it last in the document.

Example: Default (appears after 300px)
```vue
<div class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Scroll the page down: a button appears at the bottom end corner.<BackToTop /></div>
```

Example: Custom threshold and position
```vue
<div class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Appears after 100px, bottom-start corner.<BackToTop :threshold="100" label="Jump to top" class="end-auto start-6" /></div>
```

Example: Pill with a visible label
```vue
<div class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Scroll the page down: a pill with the arrow and the label appears at the bottom end corner.<BackToTop variant="pill" size="sm" :threshold="200" label="Back to top" /></div>
```

# SkipLink
group: navigation / Accessibility
Visually hidden "Skip to main content" link that appears on keyboard focus.

Render it as the very first focusable element of the page and give your main landmark `id="main-content"` (or change `href`). It is invisible until focused with Tab, then shows as a fixed button. Activating it moves focus to the target (adding `tabindex="-1"` when needed) so the skip also works with screen readers in single-page apps. If the target is missing the browser handles the fragment natively.

import { SkipLink } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- href: string = '#main-content' - Fragment link to the main landmark. Non-fragment values are left to the browser.
- variant: 'solid' | 'outline' | 'inverted' = 'solid' - Look of the link while it is focused: primary fill, bordered page surface or foreground fill. Unknown values fall back to `solid`.
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = 'md' - Padding and text size while focused. Unknown values fall back to `md`.
- class: string | object | array - Merged last.

Slots:
- default - Link text. Defaults to "Skip to main content".

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when `href` is a fragment (`#main-content`) and no element with that id exists in the document after mount.
- Throws a ContractError when `href` is blank, or the link has no text.

Rules:
- Place it first inside <body>/#app, before the header.
- Ensure the main element has the matching id and is rendered in the same layout: the id is checked shortly after the link mounts.
- Do not hide it with display:none or visibility:hidden.

Accessibility:
- Meets WCAG 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks.
- Hidden with sr-only so it stays in the tab order; on focus it appears at the start edge of the viewport (`start-3`, RTL-safe) with the focus ring and a surface chosen by `variant` (primary fill, bordered page surface or foreground fill, all token pairs that pass AA). `size` only changes the padding and text size of that focused state; the smallest is 24px high.
- Enter on it moves focus to the target (tabindex="-1" is added when missing), rather than only the scroll position.
- Use one SkipLink per page and one `main` landmark as its target; a second `main` or a `main` nested in another landmark fails axe.

Example: Default
```vue
<div class="relative rounded-lg border p-4">
  <SkipLink href="#skip-demo-target" class="focus:absolute" />
  <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Press Tab to reveal the link.</p>
  <div id="skip-demo-target" class="mt-3 text-sm">Target content</div>
</div>
```

Example: Custom text and target
```vue
<div class="relative rounded-lg border p-4">
  <SkipLink href="#skip-demo-docs" class="focus:absolute">Skip to documentation</SkipLink>
  <div id="skip-demo-docs" class="text-sm">Documentation body</div>
</div>
```

Example: Variants and sizes
```vue
<div class="relative grid gap-3 rounded-lg border p-4">
  <SkipLink href="#skip-demo-solid" variant="solid" class="focus:absolute">Skip to the solid example</SkipLink>
  <SkipLink href="#skip-demo-outline" variant="outline" size="sm" class="focus:absolute">Skip to the outline example</SkipLink>
  <SkipLink href="#skip-demo-inverted" variant="inverted" size="lg" class="focus:absolute">Skip to the inverted example</SkipLink>
  <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Press Tab to reveal each link in turn.</p>
  <div id="skip-demo-solid" class="text-sm">Solid target</div>
  <div id="skip-demo-outline" class="text-sm">Outline target</div>
  <div id="skip-demo-inverted" class="text-sm">Inverted target</div>
</div>
```

# AppHeader
group: navigation / App shell
Top bar with brand, navigation and action slots, an optional sticky mode and a built-in mobile menu.

Fill the `brand`, `nav` (desktop, hidden below `md`), `actions` and `mobile` slots. A `nav` slot requires a `mobile` slot, otherwise the links are unreachable on small screens. When the `mobile` slot is present a menu button appears below `md` that toggles a `MobileNav` panel (dropdown by default, `mobile-variant="sheet"` for a side sheet); its open state is `v-model:mobileOpen`. `sticky` pins the bar to the top. The slots are layout-only: put `NavLink`s, `ThemeToggle`, buttons etc. inside. Use `SidebarNav` for app-level vertical navigation.

import { AppHeader } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- sticky: boolean = false - Stick to the top of the viewport (`position: sticky`).
- bordered: boolean = true - Bottom border.
- mobileOpen: boolean - Mobile menu open state (v-model:mobileOpen).
- mobileVariant: 'dropdown' | 'sheet' = 'dropdown' - Presentation of the mobile panel.
- navLabel: string = 'Main' - aria-label of the desktop nav landmark. Use a different value for each header on a page.
- menuLabel: string = 'Menu' - Accessible name of the mobile menu button. Constant; aria-expanded carries the open state.
- class: string | object | array - Merged last.

Slots:
- brand - Logo / site name.
- nav - Desktop navigation links (hidden below `md`).
- actions - Right-aligned controls (search, theme toggle, sign in).
- mobile ({ close: () => void }) - Mobile menu content; enables the menu button.

Events:
- update:mobileOpen [open: boolean] - The mobile menu opened or closed.

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when a `nav` slot is given without a `mobile` slot, because the nav is hidden below `md` and its links would be unreachable.
- Throws a ContractError when `menuLabel` is blank while a `mobile` slot is given, or `navLabel` is blank while a `nav` slot is given.

Rules:
- Always provide the `mobile` slot when you give a `nav` slot (it throws otherwise).
- Do not render the same links twice in nav and mobile without keeping them in sync.
- Use `sticky`, not custom position classes.

Accessibility:
- `<header>` landmark with an opaque `bg-background` surface and a bottom border (no blur). The desktop links sit in `<nav aria-label>` (default "Main"): give every header on a page its own `nav-label`.
- The menu button has a constant accessible name (`menuLabel`, default "Menu") plus aria-expanded and aria-controls; the name does not flip between open and close.
- Opening the panel moves focus into it; Esc closes it and returns focus to the button. Tab order follows the DOM: brand, nav, actions, menu button.
- The nav is hidden below `md` and the menu button above it. If the viewport grows past `md` while the panel is open, it closes.
- Buttons keep their own 36px target (44px on coarse pointers). Logical properties (`ms-auto`) keep the actions on the correct side in RTL.

Example: Brand, nav, actions
```vue
<div @click.prevent>
  <AppHeader nav-label="Sample main" class="rounded-lg border">
    <template #brand><span class="text-sm font-semibold">Sample app</span></template>
    <template #nav>
      <NavLink href="/components" variant="pill" active>Components</NavLink>
      <NavLink href="/guides/getting-started" variant="pill">Guides</NavLink>
    </template>
    <template #actions><Button size="sm">Sign in</Button></template>
    <template #mobile>
      <div class="flex flex-col gap-1">
        <NavLink href="/components" variant="pill" active>Components</NavLink>
        <NavLink href="/guides/getting-started" variant="pill">Guides</NavLink>
      </div>
    </template>
  </AppHeader>
</div>
```

Example: With mobile menu
```vue
<div class="h-64 overflow-hidden rounded-lg border" @click.prevent>
  <AppHeader sticky :bordered="false" nav-label="Compact main">
    <template #brand><span class="text-sm font-semibold">Sample app</span></template>
    <template #nav><NavLink href="/components" variant="pill">Components</NavLink></template>
    <template #actions><Button variant="ghost" size="icon" aria-label="Notifications"><Icon :icon="faBell" /></Button></template>
    <template #mobile>
      <div class="flex flex-col gap-1">
        <NavLink href="/components" variant="pill">Components</NavLink>
        <NavLink href="/guides/getting-started" variant="pill">Guides</NavLink>
      </div>
    </template>
  </AppHeader>
</div>
```

# MobileNav
group: navigation / App shell
Small-screen navigation panel: slides down under a header or opens as a side sheet. Esc closes and focus is managed.

Control with `v-model:open`. The `dropdown` variant is absolutely positioned under its nearest positioned ancestor (AppHeader does this for you); `sheet` is a fixed left panel with an overlay and a Tab focus trap. On open focus moves to the first focusable element (or the panel); on close it returns to the previously focused element. Clicking a link, or an element with `data-mobile-nav-close`, closes it unless `close-on-navigate` is false. It is not portalled and renders nothing while closed. For modal dialogs in general use `Dialog`/`Sheet`.

import { MobileNav } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- open: boolean - Open state (v-model:open).
- defaultOpen: boolean = false - Initial state when uncontrolled.
- variant: 'dropdown' | 'sheet' = 'dropdown' - Slide-down panel or fixed side sheet.
- label: string = 'Navigation' - Accessible name of the panel.
- closeOnNavigate: boolean = true - Close when a link or [data-mobile-nav-close] inside is clicked.
- id: string - Panel id (target of aria-controls on the toggle).
- class: string | object | array - Merged onto the panel.

Slots:
- default ({ close: () => void }) - Panel content (links).

Events:
- update:open [open: boolean] - The panel asked to open/close (Escape, overlay, link click).

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when `label` is blank, because every panel needs its own name.
- Throws a ContractError when nothing can open the panel: neither `v-model:open` (`open`) nor `default-open` is set.

Rules:
- Use inside AppHeader via its `mobile` slot instead of wiring the toggle yourself.
- The dropdown variant needs a positioned ancestor (relative/sticky).
- Hide the opener above the desktop breakpoint with `md:hidden`.

Accessibility:
- Escape closes; focus moves to the first focusable element on open and returns to the opener on close. A panel that renders already open does not take focus on load.
- The sheet is role="dialog" aria-modal with Tab/Shift+Tab trapped, an overlay that closes on click, and `overscroll-contain` so the page behind does not scroll. The dropdown is a non-modal role="navigation" panel, so put a `div` (not another `nav`) inside it.
- Every panel needs its own `label`; a nav placed inside a sheet needs a different `aria-label` from the sheet.
- Opaque `bg-background` with a border, no blur. The slide-in mirrors in RTL and animations are off under `motion-reduce`.
- Pair the opener with aria-expanded and aria-controls (AppHeader wires this).

Example: Sheet
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const open = ref(false)
</script>

<div @click.prevent>
  <Button variant="outline" @click="open = true">Open menu</Button>
  <MobileNav v-model:open="open" variant="sheet" label="Sample menu">
    <nav aria-label="Sample pages" class="flex flex-col gap-1">
      <NavLink href="/components" variant="pill" active>Components</NavLink>
      <NavLink href="/guides/getting-started" variant="pill">Guides</NavLink>
      <Button variant="ghost" data-mobile-nav-close>Close</Button>
    </nav>
  </MobileNav>
</div>
```

Example: Dropdown under a positioned container
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const open = ref(true)
</script>

<div class="relative h-56 rounded-lg border" @click.prevent>
  <div class="flex h-12 items-center justify-between px-3">
    <span class="text-sm font-medium">Sample site</span>
    <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" :aria-expanded="open" @click="open = !open">Menu</Button>
  </div>
  <MobileNav v-model:open="open" label="Sample dropdown">
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-1">
      <NavLink href="/components" variant="pill">Components</NavLink>
      <NavLink href="/guides/getting-started" variant="pill">Guides</NavLink>
    </div>
  </MobileNav>
</div>
```

# SidebarNav
group: navigation / App shell
Grouped application sidebar navigation with icons, badges, nested items and an icon-only collapsed mode.

Pass `groups` (`{ label?, items }`) where each item is `{ label, href | to, icon?, badge?, active?, disabled?, children? }`. Set `current` to the current path/href, or provide `NAV_IS_ACTIVE_KEY` once for router-driven state. Items with `children` become expandable (auto-open when a child is active). `collapsed` shows icons only with the label as a `title` tooltip; clicking a parent in the collapsed rail emits `update:collapsed=false` so the parent can expand it. Links emit `navigate`; for vue-router pass `link-as` a RouterLink. Uses the `sidebar-*` tokens. For a docs-style text list use `DocsSidebar`.

import { SidebarNav } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- groups*: SidebarNavGroup[] - Groups `{ id?, label?, items: SidebarNavItem[] }`. Malformed groups/items are skipped.
- collapsed: boolean = false - Icon-only rail (w-14); labels become sr-only + title.
- current: string - Current path/href; the item with the same `to`/`href` is active unless it sets `active`.
- linkAs: string | Component = 'a' - Link element/component, e.g. RouterLink (receives `to`).
- label: string = 'Sidebar' - aria-label of the nav landmark.
- variant: 'default' | 'compact' | 'rail' = 'default' - `default`: 240px list. `compact`: denser spacing, 208px. `rail`: an 80px strip of tiles with the icon above a short label (sub-items open below their parent tile). `collapsed` always wins and shows icons only. Unknown values fall back to `default`.
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = 'md' - Link height: 32px, 36px or 44px; sub-items are one step smaller. Unknown values fall back to `md`.
- class: string | object | array - Merged last (override width with `w-72` etc.).

Slots:
- header ({ collapsed: boolean }) - Brand/logo area above the groups.
- footer ({ collapsed: boolean }) - Pinned to the bottom (user menu, collapse button).

Events:
- navigate [item: SidebarNavItem, event: MouseEvent] - A link was clicked (not emitted for disabled items).
- update:collapsed [collapsed: boolean] - Emitted with false when a parent item is clicked in collapsed mode.

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when `groups` is empty, or a group has no `items`.
- Throws a ContractError when an item has no non-empty `label`.
- Throws a ContractError when a leaf item has neither `href` nor `to` and is not `disabled`, unless `@navigate` handles it as an action (it then renders as a button).
- Throws a ContractError when `label` is blank, because it names the nav landmark.

Rules:
- Every item needs a `label` and an `href` or `to`; an item with neither is an action, handled with `@navigate`, and renders as a button.
- Icons are FontAwesome IconDefinition objects in `item.icon`.
- Control collapse with `v-model:collapsed`; render the toggle button yourself (footer slot).
- Use `link-as` with RouterLink or `@navigate` + preventDefault for programmatic routing.
- Do not nest groups more than one level; `children` is a single sub-list level.

Accessibility:
- `<nav aria-label>` (default "Sidebar"): give each sidebar on a page its own label, because landmarks must be unique.
- Each group is `role="group"` named by its heading. Group headings use `text-sidebar-foreground`, a token pair that passes AA.
- The active link has aria-current="page"; parent buttons expose aria-expanded/aria-controls and toggle with Enter or Space.
- Tab moves through every link; there is no arrow-key roving, so the order stays predictable.
- `variant` and `size` only change spacing, width and link height: landmarks, groups, aria-current and aria-expanded are the same. In `rail` the label stays visible under the icon (and is also the `title`), and `collapsed` still turns every variant into icons with sr-only text.
- Collapsed mode keeps labels as sr-only text and adds a title tooltip. Targets are at least 32px high (40px on coarse pointers).
- Uses logical properties (`border-e`, `ms-*`, `ps-*`) so it mirrors in RTL; the width transition runs only under `motion-safe`. Active items also get an underline in forced-colors mode.
- The nav is `max-w-full`, so it never forces horizontal scroll at 320px.

Example: Grouped with nested items
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const current = ref('/components')
</script>

<SidebarNav :groups="groups" :current="current" label="Sample app" class="h-96 rounded-lg border" @navigate="(item, e) => { e.preventDefault(); if (item.href) current = item.href }">
  <template #header><p class="px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold">Sample app</p></template>
</SidebarNav>
```

Example: Compact and rail
```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap gap-4">
  <SidebarNav :groups="groups" current="/components" variant="compact" size="sm" label="Compact sample" class="h-96 rounded-lg border" @navigate="(i, e) => e.preventDefault()" />
  <SidebarNav :groups="groups" current="/components/data-display" variant="rail" label="Rail sample" class="h-96 rounded-lg border" @navigate="(i, e) => e.preventDefault()" />
</div>
```

Example: Collapsible rail
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const collapsed = ref(false)
</script>

<div class="flex flex-wrap gap-4">
  <SidebarNav v-model:collapsed="collapsed" :groups="groups" current="/components/data-display" label="Collapsible sample" class="h-96 rounded-lg border" @navigate="(i, e) => e.preventDefault()">
    <template #footer="{ collapsed }">
      <p class="px-2 text-xs text-sidebar-foreground">{{ collapsed ? 'Sample' : 'Sample footer' }}</p>
    </template>
  </SidebarNav>
  <Button variant="outline" size="sm" class="self-start" @click="collapsed = !collapsed">Toggle collapsed</Button>
</div>
```

# DocsSidebar
group: navigation / Docs
Documentation-style grouped link list with section titles and an active page indicator.

Pass `sections` (`{ title, items: { label, href | to, badge?, active? }[] }`). The link equal to `current` is highlighted with `aria-current="page"`. Lighter and text-only compared with `SidebarNav` (no icons, no collapsing). Router-agnostic: use `link-as` with RouterLink or react to `navigate`. Pair with `TableOfContents` for a docs layout.

import { DocsSidebar } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- sections*: DocsSidebarSection[] - Sections `{ id?, title, items: DocsSidebarLink[] }`. Malformed entries are skipped.
- current: string - Current path/href; the matching link is active unless it sets `active`.
- linkAs: string | Component = 'a' - Link element/component, e.g. RouterLink (receives `to`).
- variant: 'default' | 'compact' | 'rail' = 'default' - `default`: pill links. `compact`: tighter spacing. `rail`: plain links on a vertical rule with a marker on the current page. Unknown values fall back to `default`.
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = 'md' - Link height: 24px, 32px or 36px. Unknown values fall back to `md`.
- label: string = 'Documentation' - aria-label of the nav landmark.
- class: string | object | array - Merged last.

Events:
- navigate [link: DocsSidebarLink, event: MouseEvent] - A link was clicked.

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when `sections` is empty, or a section has no `title` or no `items`.
- Throws a ContractError when a link has no non-empty `label`.
- Throws a ContractError when a link has neither `href` nor `to`, unless `@navigate` handles it as an action (it then renders as a button).
- Throws a ContractError when `label` is blank, because it names the nav landmark.

Rules:
- Use for documentation navigation; use SidebarNav for app navigation with icons.
- Pass `current` instead of per-link `active` flags.

Accessibility:
- `<nav aria-label>` (default "Documentation"): pass a distinct `label` when another navigation landmark with that name is on the page.
- Section titles are plain text (no heading level) so the sidebar never breaks the page heading order; each list is named by its title with aria-labelledby.
- Active link has aria-current="page". Links are at least 32px high (40px on coarse pointers).
- Tab moves through the links in order. Logical properties keep it correct in RTL.
- Every variant keeps the same lists, names and aria-current. In `rail` the current page is also marked by an inline-start border (not colour alone) and the usual forced-colors underline.

Example: Basic
```vue
<div @click.prevent>
  <DocsSidebar :sections="sections" current="/guides/testing" label="Sample guides" class="w-56 max-w-full" />
</div>
```

Example: Compact and rail
```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-8">
  <DocsSidebar :sections="sections" current="/guides/getting-started" variant="compact" size="sm" label="Compact guides" class="w-48 max-w-full" @navigate="(l, e) => e.preventDefault()" />
  <DocsSidebar :sections="sections" current="/guides/getting-started" variant="rail" label="Rail guides" class="w-48 max-w-full" @navigate="(l, e) => e.preventDefault()" />
</div>
```

Example: Driven by state
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const current = ref('/guides/getting-started')
</script>

<div class="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-6">
  <DocsSidebar :sections="sections" :current="current" label="Interactive guides" class="w-56 max-w-full" @navigate="(l, e) => { e.preventDefault(); current = l.href }" />
  <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Current: {{ current }}</p>
</div>
```
