# TableOfContents
group: navigation / Docs
In-page "On this page" list that highlights the section being read and scrolls to a section on click.

Pass `items` (`{ id, label, level? }`) whose `id`s match heading/section elements in the page. The active entry is tracked with an `IntersectionObserver` (first visible section in document order wins; the last one stays active while none is visible) and is exposed with `v-model`. Without IntersectionObserver (or when no target element exists) it degrades gracefully: links still navigate natively, clicks set the active entry and the initial entry comes from the URL hash. `offset` reserves space for a sticky header. Indentation is relative to the shallowest level present. Use `Breadcrumb` for site hierarchy and `Tabs` for switching views.

import { TableOfContents } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- items*: TocItem[] - Entries `{ id, label, level? }`. Items with a missing id or non-string label are skipped.
- modelValue: string - Active section id (v-model). Tracked internally when omitted.
- title: string = 'On this page' - Heading above the list; empty string hides it.
- offset: number = 80 - Pixels at the top of the viewport reserved for a sticky header.
- variant: 'line' | 'rail' | 'boxed' = 'line' - `line`: a thin rule with a marker on the current entry. `rail`: a thicker rule. `boxed`: a bordered card where the current entry is filled. Unknown values fall back to `line`.
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = 'md' - Text size of the title and entries. Unknown values fall back to `md`.
- smooth: boolean = true - Smooth scroll on click (ignored under prefers-reduced-motion).
- class: string | object | array - Merged last.

Events:
- update:modelValue [id: string] - The active section changed (scroll tracking or click).
- select [id: string] - A link was clicked.

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when `items` is empty or not an array.
- Throws a ContractError when an item has a blank `id` or `label`, or two items share an `id`. Whether an id exists in the page is not checked, because routes render later.

Rules:
- Every `id` must exist on an element in the page, otherwise that entry is not tracked.
- Render it once the heading list is known: empty `items` throws.
- Set `offset` to your sticky header height.
- Make it sticky with a class (`sticky top-20`), not inside the component.

Accessibility:
- `<nav aria-label>` (the title, or "Table of contents"): use a different `title` for each TableOfContents on a page.
- The active link has aria-current="location" and, besides the colour change, a border marker and a medium font weight (underline in forced-colors mode).
- Links are native anchors, so Tab and Enter work; each is at least 24px high. Indentation uses `ps-*` and the rail uses `border-s`, so it mirrors in RTL.
- In `boxed` the current entry is filled with the accent surface and keeps the medium weight; in `line` and `rail` it gets the border marker. Both are underlined in forced colors, so the state never relies on colour alone.
- Clicking moves the viewport and updates the URL hash without a page reload; reduced motion disables smooth scrolling.

Example: Basic
```vue
<div class="w-56">
  <h2 id="toc-demo-overview" class="sr-only">Overview</h2>
  <h2 id="toc-demo-install" class="sr-only">Installation</h2>
  <h3 id="toc-demo-usage" class="sr-only">Usage</h3>
  <h2 id="toc-demo-api" class="sr-only">API</h2>
  <TableOfContents :items="items" />
</div>
```

Example: Variants
```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-6">
  <TableOfContents v-for="variant in ['line', 'rail', 'boxed']" :key="variant" :items="items" model-value="toc-demo-install" :variant="variant" :title="'Variant ' + variant" class="w-52" />
</div>
```

Example: Sizes
```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-6">
  <TableOfContents v-for="size in ['sm', 'md', 'lg']" :key="size" :items="items" model-value="toc-demo-usage" :size="size" :title="'Size ' + size" class="w-52" />
</div>
```

Example: Controlled active section
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const active = ref('toc-demo-install')
</script>

<div class="space-y-3">
  <TableOfContents v-model="active" :items="items" title="Contents" class="w-56" />
  <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Active: {{ active }}</p>
</div>
```

# NavLink
group: navigation / Links
Navigation link with an active state (aria-current), optional icon and badge. Router-agnostic.

Renders an `<a>`. Set `active` explicitly, or provide an app-wide predicate once with `provide(NAV_IS_ACTIVE_KEY, (target) => boolean)` and NavLink derives `aria-current="page"` from its `href`/string `to`. Works without vue-router: for client-side routing pass `as` a RouterLink (it receives `to`) or wrap one with `as-child`. `variant` selects the active treatment: `default` (text colour), `pill` (accent background), `sidebar` (sidebar tokens), `underline` (bottom border), `plain` (body text, bold when current), `solid` (primary chip) and `outline` (bordered chip). `size` runs from `xs` (24px) to `lg` (44px) and `shape` rounds the corners (`rounded`, `pill`, `square`). Use `Link` from primitives for inline text links; use NavLink for navigation lists.

import { NavLink } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- href: string - Plain URL for the anchor.
- to: string | object - Router target. A string doubles as the target for the injected isActive predicate; forwarded as `to` when `as` is a component.
- active: boolean - Explicit active state. When omitted, the injected NAV_IS_ACTIVE_KEY predicate decides (inactive if none).
- disabled: boolean = false - Removes href, sets aria-disabled, blocks clicks.
- variant: 'default' | 'pill' | 'sidebar' | 'underline' | 'plain' | 'solid' | 'outline' = 'default' - Active/hover treatment. `plain` has no hover fill and is bold when current, `solid` fills the current link with the primary colour, `outline` borders it.
- size: 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = 'md' - Height and padding (24px, 32px, 36px, 44px). Coarse pointers get at least 40px. Unknown values fall back to `md`.
- shape: 'rounded' | 'pill' | 'square' = 'rounded' - Corner style. `rounded` keeps the variant radius; `underline` has no corners. Unknown values fall back to `rounded`.
- icon: IconDefinition - FontAwesome icon before the label.
- badge: string | number - Trailing badge text.
- collapsed: boolean = false - Icon-only: label becomes sr-only and the badge is hidden.
- as: string | Component = 'a' - Element or component (e.g. RouterLink).
- asChild: boolean = false - Render the single child instead of an anchor.
- class: string | object | array - Merged last with tailwind-merge.

Slots:
- default - Label.
- icon - Custom icon content (overrides the icon prop).
- badge - Custom trailing content (overrides the badge prop).

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when a `NavLink` rendered as an anchor or a router component has no `href` or `to` (unless `disabled`, `as-child` or `as="button"`).
- Throws a ContractError when a `NavLink` has no accessible name (text or `aria-label`).

Rules:
- Do not hard-code router logic; pass `as` a RouterLink or use `as-child`.
- Prefer providing NAV_IS_ACTIVE_KEY once over setting `active` on each link.
- Use `collapsed` together with a `title` for icon-only links.
- Icons are FontAwesome IconDefinition objects, not strings.

Accessibility:
- Active link gets aria-current="page" and, in forced-colors mode, an underline (backgrounds are dropped there). Every variant marks the current page by more than colour: a fill, a border, a bottom rule or bold text.
- Disabled links drop href, get aria-disabled and tabindex=-1.
- Collapsed mode keeps the label as sr-only text; add a `title` for a tooltip. The badge is hidden when collapsed.
- Targets are 24px (`xs`), 32px (`sm`), 36px (`md`) and 44px (`lg`) high, at least 40px on coarse pointers. The badge uses `ms-auto`, so it mirrors in RTL.
- Focus is shown with the shared focus ring; transitions only run under `motion-safe`.

Example: Variants and active state
```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2" @click.prevent>
  <NavLink href="/components" active>Components</NavLink>
  <NavLink href="/guides/getting-started">Guides</NavLink>
  <NavLink href="/components" variant="pill" active>Pill</NavLink>
  <NavLink href="/components" variant="underline" active>Underline</NavLink>
  <NavLink href="/components" disabled>Disabled</NavLink>
</div>
```

Example: More variants
```vue
<div class="grid gap-3" @click.prevent>
  <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2"><NavLink href="/components" variant="plain" active>Plain</NavLink><NavLink href="/guides/getting-started" variant="plain">Guides</NavLink></div>
  <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2"><NavLink href="/components" variant="solid" active>Solid</NavLink><NavLink href="/guides/getting-started" variant="solid">Guides</NavLink></div>
  <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2"><NavLink href="/components" variant="outline" active>Outline</NavLink><NavLink href="/guides/getting-started" variant="outline">Guides</NavLink></div>
</div>
```

Example: Sizes and shapes
```vue
<div class="grid gap-3" @click.prevent>
  <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2"><NavLink v-for="size in ['xs', 'sm', 'md', 'lg']" :key="size" href="/components" variant="solid" :size="size" active>Size {{ size }}</NavLink></div>
  <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2"><NavLink v-for="shape in ['rounded', 'pill', 'square']" :key="shape" href="/components" variant="solid" :shape="shape" active>{{ shape }}</NavLink></div>
</div>
```

Example: Icon and badge, sidebar style
```vue
<div class="w-56 max-w-full space-y-1 rounded-lg bg-sidebar p-2" @click.prevent>
  <NavLink href="/components" variant="sidebar" :icon="faHouse" active>Overview</NavLink>
  <NavLink href="/components/feedback" variant="sidebar" :icon="faBell" badge="3">Alerts</NavLink>
  <NavLink href="/guides/customisation" variant="sidebar" :icon="faGear">Settings</NavLink>
</div>
```

Example: Collapsed, icon only
```vue
<div class="w-14 space-y-1 rounded-lg bg-sidebar p-2" @click.prevent>
  <NavLink href="/components" variant="sidebar" :icon="faHouse" collapsed title="Overview">Overview</NavLink>
  <NavLink href="/guides/customisation" variant="sidebar" :icon="faGear" collapsed title="Settings">Settings</NavLink>
</div>
```

Example: Active from an injected predicate
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const current = ref('/a')
</script>

<div class="flex gap-2">
  <NavLink href="/components" variant="pill" :active="current === '/a'" @click.prevent="current = '/a'">First</NavLink>
  <NavLink href="/guides/getting-started" variant="pill" :active="current === '/b'" @click.prevent="current = '/b'">Second</NavLink>
</div>
```

# Menubar
group: navigation / Menus
Desktop-style horizontal menu bar (File, Edit, View) whose menus open from triggers with full keyboard roving.

Compose `Menubar` > `MenubarMenu` > `MenubarTrigger` + `MenubarContent` and fill the content with `MenubarItem`, `MenubarCheckboxItem`, `MenubarRadioGroup` with `MenubarRadioItem`, `MenubarLabel`, `MenubarSeparator`, `MenubarGroup`, `MenubarSub` with `MenubarSubTrigger` and `MenubarSubContent` and `MenubarShortcut`. Once one menu is open, hovering or arrowing to a neighbouring trigger switches menus. Item styling is shared with `DropdownMenu`/`ContextMenu`. Use it for application command bars (editors, dashboards). Use `DropdownMenu` for a single action menu, `NavigationMenu` for site navigation links, `Command` for a search palette. Built on reka-ui `Menubar*`.

import { Menubar, MenubarMenu, MenubarTrigger, MenubarContent, MenubarItem, MenubarCheckboxItem, MenubarRadioGroup, MenubarRadioItem, MenubarLabel, MenubarSeparator, MenubarGroup, MenubarSub, MenubarSubTrigger, MenubarSubContent, MenubarShortcut } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- modelValue: string - Value of the open menu (v-model). Empty string = all closed.
- defaultValue: string - Menu opened initially when uncontrolled.
- loop: boolean = false - Wrap arrow-key focus from the last trigger to the first.
- dir: 'ltr' | 'rtl' - Reading direction (swaps horizontal arrows).
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = 'md' - Height of the bar and size of its triggers: 32px, 36px or 44px. Unknown values fall back to `md`. The menus that open from it keep the shared menu styling.
- class: string | object | array - Merged last (tailwind-merge).

Parts:
- MenubarMenu - Pairs one trigger with its content. Renderless. Give it a unique `value`.
    - value: string - Identity used by v-model; becomes the trigger id. Auto-generated when omitted.
- MenubarTrigger - Bar button that opens its menu (role=menuitem, aria-haspopup=menu). Enter/Space/ArrowDown open.
    - disabled: boolean = false - Not focusable by pointer, cannot open.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last (tailwind-merge).
- MenubarContent - Portalled menu surface (role=menu). Attributes fall through.
    - align: 'start' | 'center' | 'end' = 'start' - Alignment along the trigger.
    - sideOffset: number = 8 - Gap in px between trigger and menu.
    - alignOffset: number = -4 - Offset along the alignment axis.
    - loop: boolean = false - Wrap item focus inside the menu.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last (tailwind-merge).
- MenubarItem - Action row. Emits `select`; closes the menubar unless the event is default-prevented.
    - disabled: boolean = false - Does not fire select.
    - destructive: boolean = false - Destructive colour (data-variant="destructive").
    - inset: boolean = false - Left padding aligning with indicator rows.
    - textValue: string - Text used for type-ahead when children are not plain text.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last (tailwind-merge).
- MenubarCheckboxItem - Toggle row with check indicator (role=menuitemcheckbox). v-model.
    - modelValue: boolean | 'indeterminate' - Checked state (v-model).
    - disabled: boolean = false - Disable the row.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last (tailwind-merge).
- MenubarRadioGroup - Groups radio items (role=group). v-model holds the selected value.
    - modelValue: string - Selected value (v-model).
- MenubarRadioItem - Radio row with dot indicator (role=menuitemradio).
    - value: string - Value written to the group.
    - disabled: boolean = false - Disable the row.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last (tailwind-merge).
- MenubarLabel - Non-interactive heading; supports `inset`.
    - inset: boolean = false - Align with indicator rows.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last (tailwind-merge).
- MenubarSeparator - Divider line (role=separator).
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last (tailwind-merge).
- MenubarGroup - Semantic group (role=group) of related items.
- MenubarSub - Wraps a SubTrigger + SubContent pair. Supports v-model:open.
- MenubarSubTrigger - Row opening a sub menu (ArrowRight / hover); shows a chevron; supports `inset`.
    - inset: boolean = false - Align with indicator rows.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last (tailwind-merge).
- MenubarSubContent - Portalled sub-menu surface.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last (tailwind-merge).
- MenubarShortcut - Right-aligned keyboard hint text inside an item (decorative).
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last (tailwind-merge).

Slots:
- default ({ modelValue: string }) - One or more MenubarMenu.

Events:
- update:modelValue [value: string] - The open menu changed ("" when all closed).

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when `Menubar` has no accessible name (`aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`).
- Throws a ContractError when two `MenubarMenu`s share a `value`, or a menu has a blank `value`.
- Throws a ContractError when a `MenubarMenu` has no `MenubarTrigger` or no `MenubarContent`.
- Throws a ContractError when a `MenubarTrigger` has no accessible name (text or `aria-label`).

Rules:
- Always wrap each trigger and its content in MenubarMenu with a unique `value`.
- Run actions with @select on MenubarItem; call event.preventDefault() to keep the menu open.
- Use destructive on dangerous items and place them last after a MenubarSeparator.
- Use MenubarCheckboxItem / MenubarRadioGroup with v-model for toggles and single choices.
- Menubar is for application commands; use NavigationMenu for site links and DropdownMenu for one standalone menu.
- Do not set `id` on MenubarTrigger. Add aria-label to the Menubar.

Accessibility:
- Root has role=menubar; triggers are role=menuitem with aria-haspopup=menu and aria-expanded; content is role=menu with menuitem / menuitemcheckbox / menuitemradio rows.
- Keyboard: ArrowLeft/Right move between triggers (swapped in RTL, wraps with `loop`); Enter/Space/ArrowDown open; inside a menu ArrowUp/Down move (skipping disabled), ArrowRight/Left open/close sub menus or step to the neighbouring menu, Home/End jump, type-ahead; Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger.
- Give the bar an aria-label. Do not set `id` on MenubarTrigger: the menu `value` is its id.
- Disabled triggers and items stay in the DOM with data-disabled and are skipped by keyboard.
- Shortcut text is a visual hint only; wire the real keyboard shortcut in your app. Triggers and rows are 44px high on coarse pointers (24px minimum on the `sm` bar), the bar scrolls inside itself at narrow widths, and highlighted rows use system colours in forced-colors mode.

Example: Application menu
```vue
<Menubar aria-label="Application menu">
  <MenubarMenu value="file">
    <MenubarTrigger>File</MenubarTrigger>
    <MenubarContent>
      <MenubarItem>New tab <MenubarShortcut>Ctrl+T</MenubarShortcut></MenubarItem>
      <MenubarItem>New window <MenubarShortcut>Ctrl+N</MenubarShortcut></MenubarItem>
      <MenubarItem disabled>New incognito window</MenubarItem>
      <MenubarSeparator />
      <MenubarSub>
        <MenubarSubTrigger>Share</MenubarSubTrigger>
        <MenubarSubContent>
          <MenubarItem>Email link</MenubarItem>
          <MenubarItem>Messages</MenubarItem>
        </MenubarSubContent>
      </MenubarSub>
      <MenubarSeparator />
      <MenubarItem destructive>Close window <MenubarShortcut>Ctrl+W</MenubarShortcut></MenubarItem>
    </MenubarContent>
  </MenubarMenu>
  <MenubarMenu value="edit">
    <MenubarTrigger>Edit</MenubarTrigger>
    <MenubarContent>
      <MenubarItem>Undo <MenubarShortcut>Ctrl+Z</MenubarShortcut></MenubarItem>
      <MenubarItem>Redo <MenubarShortcut>Ctrl+Shift+Z</MenubarShortcut></MenubarItem>
    </MenubarContent>
  </MenubarMenu>
</Menubar>
```

Example: Sizes
```vue
<div class="flex flex-col items-start gap-3">
  <Menubar v-for="size in ['sm', 'md', 'lg']" :key="size" :size="size" :aria-label="'Menu bar ' + size">
    <MenubarMenu :value="'file-' + size"><MenubarTrigger>File {{ size }}</MenubarTrigger><MenubarContent><MenubarItem>Open</MenubarItem></MenubarContent></MenubarMenu>
    <MenubarMenu :value="'edit-' + size"><MenubarTrigger>Edit</MenubarTrigger><MenubarContent><MenubarItem>Undo</MenubarItem></MenubarContent></MenubarMenu>
  </Menubar>
</div>
```

Example: Checkbox and radio items
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const showBookmarks = ref(true)
const profile = ref('b')
</script>

<div class="flex flex-col gap-3">
  <Menubar aria-label="View options">
    <MenubarMenu value="view">
      <MenubarTrigger>View</MenubarTrigger>
      <MenubarContent>
        <MenubarLabel>Toolbars</MenubarLabel>
        <MenubarCheckboxItem v-model="showBookmarks">Always show bookmarks</MenubarCheckboxItem>
        <MenubarSeparator />
        <MenubarLabel>Profiles</MenubarLabel>
        <MenubarRadioGroup v-model="profile">
          <MenubarRadioItem value="a">Profile A</MenubarRadioItem>
          <MenubarRadioItem value="b">Profile B</MenubarRadioItem>
        </MenubarRadioGroup>
      </MenubarContent>
    </MenubarMenu>
  </Menubar>
  <span class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">bookmarks={{ showBookmarks }}, profile={{ profile }}</span>
</div>
```

Example: Controlled (v-model)
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const open = ref('')
</script>

<div class="flex flex-col gap-3">
  <Menubar v-model="open" loop aria-label="Controlled menu">
    <MenubarMenu value="file"><MenubarTrigger>File</MenubarTrigger><MenubarContent><MenubarItem>Open</MenubarItem></MenubarContent></MenubarMenu>
    <MenubarMenu value="help"><MenubarTrigger>Help</MenubarTrigger><MenubarContent><MenubarItem>About</MenubarItem></MenubarContent></MenubarMenu>
  </Menubar>
  <span class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">open = "{{ open }}"</span>
</div>
```

# NavigationMenu
group: navigation / Menus
Site navigation bar with hover/click mega-menu panels, an optional shared viewport and an optional indicator.

Compose `NavigationMenu` > `NavigationMenuList` > `NavigationMenuItem` and give each item either a `NavigationMenuTrigger` + `NavigationMenuContent` pair (a panel with links) or a bare `NavigationMenuLink` (`variant="trigger"`) for a top-level link. By default panels render in one shared `NavigationMenuViewport` that animates its size between panels (mega menu); set `viewport=false` to position each panel under its own trigger. Add `NavigationMenuIndicator` inside the list for an arrow that follows the active trigger. Use it for a site or app header with grouped links. Use `Menubar` / `DropdownMenu` for ACTIONS, `Tabs` for in-page panels and `SidebarNav` for persistent side navigation. Built on reka-ui `NavigationMenu*`.

import { NavigationMenu, NavigationMenuList, NavigationMenuItem, NavigationMenuTrigger, NavigationMenuContent, NavigationMenuLink, NavigationMenuViewport, NavigationMenuIndicator } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- asChild: boolean - Render the single slot child instead of a wrapper element.
- modelValue: string - Value of the open item (v-model). Empty string = closed.
- defaultValue: string - Item opened initially when uncontrolled.
- orientation: 'horizontal' | 'vertical' = 'horizontal' - Layout and arrow-key axis. Vertical stacks the list and opens panels to the side.
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = 'md' - Height and text size of triggers and top-level (`variant="trigger"`) links: 32px, 36px or 44px. Rows inside panels keep their own spacing. Unknown values fall back to `md`.
- viewport: boolean = true - Render the shared animated viewport. `false` positions each content under its trigger.
- delayDuration: number = 200 - Hover delay in ms before a panel opens.
- skipDelayDuration: number = 300 - Window in ms after closing during which hovering another trigger opens instantly.
- disableClickTrigger: boolean = false - Triggers only open on hover.
- disableHoverTrigger: boolean = false - Triggers only open on click.
- disablePointerLeaveClose: boolean = false - Keep the panel open when the pointer leaves.
- unmountOnHide: boolean = true - Unmount closed panels. `false` keeps them mounted (hidden).
- dir: 'ltr' | 'rtl' - Reading direction.
- as: string | Component = 'nav' - Root element.
- class: string | object | array - Merged last (tailwind-merge) so it wins over internal classes.

Parts:
- NavigationMenuList - The `ul` holding the items. Place `NavigationMenuIndicator` inside it.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last (tailwind-merge) so it wins over internal classes.
- NavigationMenuItem - An `li`. Give items with panels a unique `value`.
    - value: string - Item identity used by v-model. Auto-generated when omitted.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last (tailwind-merge) so it wins over internal classes.
- NavigationMenuTrigger - Button that opens its sibling NavigationMenuContent (aria-expanded, aria-controls). Shows a rotating chevron.
    - variant: 'default' | 'ghost' | 'outline' = 'default' - Visual style.
    - hideChevron: boolean = false - Hide the trailing chevron.
    - disabled: boolean = false - Disable the trigger.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last (tailwind-merge) so it wins over internal classes.
- NavigationMenuContent - The panel. Rendered into the viewport (or in place when `viewport=false`). Emits dismissal events.
    - forceMount: boolean = false - Keep mounted while closed (animation libraries).
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last (tailwind-merge) so it wins over internal classes.
- NavigationMenuLink - Link; renders `a`. Selecting it closes the menu (unless `select` is default-prevented). Use `as-child` with router links.
    - active: boolean = false - Current page: sets aria-current="page" and data-active.
    - variant: 'content' | 'card' | 'plain' | 'trigger' = 'content' - `content`/`card`/`plain` for rows in a panel; `trigger` for a top-level link that looks like a trigger.
    - triggerVariant: 'default' | 'ghost' | 'outline' = 'default' - Look of `variant="trigger"` links.
    - asChild: boolean = false - Render the single child element instead of `a`.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last (tailwind-merge) so it wins over internal classes.
- NavigationMenuViewport - Shared animated surface for panels. Rendered automatically; only add it yourself when `viewport=false` and you want a custom one. `class` styles the viewport surface.
    - align: 'start' | 'center' | 'end' = 'center' - Alignment CSS variables.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last (tailwind-merge) so it wins over internal classes.
- NavigationMenuIndicator - Arrow that slides under the active trigger. Decorative (aria-hidden).
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last (tailwind-merge) so it wins over internal classes.

Slots:
- default ({ modelValue: string }) - NavigationMenuList (and optionally a custom NavigationMenuViewport when `viewport=false`).

Events:
- update:modelValue [value: string] - The open item changed ("" when closed).

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when a `NavigationMenuItem` is not inside a `NavigationMenuList`.
- Throws a ContractError when a `NavigationMenuItem` has a `NavigationMenuTrigger` without a `NavigationMenuContent`, or the reverse.
- Throws a ContractError when an item with a trigger and content has no `value`, or two items share a `value`.
- Throws a ContractError when a `NavigationMenuTrigger` or a `NavigationMenuLink` has no accessible name (text or `aria-label`).

Rules:
- Always nest NavigationMenuList > NavigationMenuItem; give every item with a Trigger/Content pair a unique `value`.
- Top-level links without a panel are NavigationMenuLink variant="trigger" inside an Item, not a Trigger.
- Use `as-child` on NavigationMenuLink to wrap router links; set `active` on the current route.
- Panel rows use NavigationMenuLink (variant content | card | plain) so selecting one closes the menu.
- Use viewport=false for small menus; keep the default viewport for wide mega-menus.
- Do not set `id` on NavigationMenuTrigger. Add aria-label to the root.
- Use v-model (string value, "" = closed) to open panels programmatically.
- Reuse `navigationMenuTriggerStyle({ variant })` for plain anchors that must look like triggers.

Accessibility:
- Root is a `nav`: give it an aria-label when the page has several navigation landmarks.
- Trigger: aria-expanded and aria-controls; content is labelled by its trigger. Do not override the trigger `id` (reka wires aria-labelledby to its own id).
- Keyboard: Tab/Shift+Tab move through triggers and links; Enter/Space toggle a panel; Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger; ArrowLeft/Right (ArrowUp/Down when vertical) move between triggers; ArrowDown (ArrowRight when vertical) from an open trigger enters its panel; Home/End jump.
- The current page link has aria-current="page" via `active`. The indicator is aria-hidden.
- `size` only changes height, padding and text size (24px of text plus padding at `sm`, 44px at `lg`); roles, names and keyboard behaviour are the same for every size.
- Hover opening is a convenience; everything is also reachable by click and keyboard. Hit areas grow on coarse pointers. Animations are disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.
- The list wraps instead of overflowing at 320px, panels span the full width below `md`, and the viewport anchors to the start edge so it mirrors in RTL.

Example: Mega menu
```vue
<div @click.prevent>
  <NavigationMenu aria-label="Main">

      <NavigationMenuItem value="components">
```

# Toolbar
group: navigation / Menus
A row or column of related controls that is one tab stop and moves focus with the arrow keys (WAI-ARIA toolbar).

Compose `Toolbar` with `ToolbarButton`, `ToolbarToggleGroup` + `ToolbarToggleItem`, `ToolbarLink` and `ToolbarSeparator`. Use it when three or more controls act on the same thing (text formatting, zoom, view options) so keyboard users cross them with one Tab stop instead of one per control. Do not use it for site navigation (use `NavigationMenu` or `SidebarNav`), for a menu of commands that open sub menus (use `Menubar`), or for two buttons in a form footer (use plain `Button`s). `variant` is the look of the bar: `plain` (no chrome), `outline` (border), `filled` (muted fill) and `floating` (border, popover surface and the shared medium shadow, for a bar that sits over content). `size` (`sm` 32px, `md` 36px, `lg` 44px) and `density` (`compact`, `default`, `spacious`) are set on the bar and reach every part through context; a part can override `size`. `orientation="vertical"` runs the bar as a column and switches the arrow keys to Up and Down. `overflow` decides what happens when the items do not fit: `wrap` flows onto more lines (default, no hidden controls), `scroll` keeps one line and scrolls inside the bar; use `scroll` only when a single line matters, because items past the edge are out of sight until focus or a swipe brings them in. The bar needs an accessible name (`aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`); icon-only buttons and toggle items need their own. `toolbarVariants`, `toolbarButtonVariants`, `toolbarToggleItemVariants`, `toolbarLinkVariants`, `toolbarToggleGroupVariants` and `toolbarSeparatorVariants` are exported for reuse (wrap them in `cn()` when you add classes).

import { Toolbar, ToolbarButton, ToolbarToggleGroup, ToolbarToggleItem, ToolbarLink, ToolbarSeparator } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- variant: 'plain' | 'outline' | 'filled' | 'floating' = 'plain' - Look of the bar. Unknown values fall back to `plain`.
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = 'md' - Item height: 32px, 36px or 44px (all 44px on coarse pointers). Unknown values fall back to `md`.
- density: 'compact' | 'default' | 'spacious' = 'default' - Padding of the bar and inline padding of the items. Targets stay at least 24px in every density. Unknown values fall back to `default`.
- orientation: 'horizontal' | 'vertical' = 'horizontal' - Direction of the items and of the arrow keys. Sets `aria-orientation`.
- gap: 'none' | 'sm' | 'md' = 'sm' - Space between items (0, 4px, 8px). Unknown values fall back to `sm`.
- overflow: 'wrap' | 'scroll' = 'wrap' - `wrap` flows items onto more lines; `scroll` keeps one line and scrolls inside the bar. Unknown values fall back to `wrap`.
- dir: 'ltr' | 'rtl' - Reading direction. In `rtl` the horizontal arrow keys swap and the bar mirrors.
- loop: boolean = true - Wrap keyboard focus from the last item to the first and back.
- as: string | Component = 'div' - Element to render.
- asChild: boolean = false - Render the single slot child instead of a wrapper element (reka-ui).
- class: string | object | array - Merged last (tailwind-merge); wins over internal classes.

Parts:
- ToolbarButton - An action button (type=button). Part of the roving focus sequence. Disabled buttons stay in the DOM and are skipped by the arrow keys.
    - size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' - Overrides the size of the bar for this button.
    - tone: 'neutral' | 'primary' = 'neutral' - `primary` is a solid fill for the one main action of the bar. Unknown values fall back to `neutral`.
    - disabled: boolean = false - Disables the button.
    - as: string | Component - Element to render instead of the default.
    - asChild: boolean = false - Render the single slot child instead of a wrapper element (reka-ui).
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last (tailwind-merge); wins over internal classes.
- ToolbarToggleGroup - Related toggle items (role=group). `single` behaves like radio buttons (role=radio, aria-checked), `multiple` like pressed buttons (aria-pressed). Name it with `aria-label` when its purpose is not clear from the items.
    - type: 'single' | 'multiple' = 'single' - One pressed item at a time (string value) or any number (string[] value).
    - modelValue: string | string[] - Pressed value(s) (v-model). Leave undefined for uncontrolled use.
    - defaultValue: string | string[] - Initial value(s) when uncontrolled.
    - disabled: boolean = false - Disables every item.
    - as: string | Component - Element to render instead of the default.
    - asChild: boolean = false - Render the single slot child instead of a wrapper element (reka-ui).
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last (tailwind-merge); wins over internal classes.
- ToolbarToggleItem - A toggle button inside `ToolbarToggleGroup`. A pressed item shows a foreground border (2px and underlined in forced-colors mode) as well as a fill, so the state is never colour alone.
    - value: string - Value reported to the group. Must be non-empty and unique in the group.
    - size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' - Overrides the size of the bar for this item.
    - disabled: boolean = false - Disables the item.
    - as: string | Component - Element to render instead of the default.
    - asChild: boolean = false - Render the single slot child instead of a wrapper element (reka-ui).
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last (tailwind-merge); wins over internal classes.
- ToolbarLink - A link in the bar (an `a` by default, underlined so it is told apart from buttons without colour). Space activates it, as on a button.
    - size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' - Overrides the size of the bar for this link.
    - as: string | Component - Element to render instead of the default.
    - asChild: boolean = false - Render the single slot child instead of a wrapper element (reka-ui).
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last (tailwind-merge); wins over internal classes.
- ToolbarSeparator - Divider between groups of controls (role=separator). It runs across the bar: a vertical line in a horizontal bar, a horizontal line in a vertical one. Drawn as a border so it survives forced-colors mode. Not focusable.
    - as: string | Component - Element to render instead of the default.
    - asChild: boolean = false - Render the single slot child instead of a wrapper element (reka-ui).
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last (tailwind-merge); wins over internal classes.

Slots:
- default - ToolbarButton, ToolbarToggleGroup, ToolbarLink and ToolbarSeparator.

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when `Toolbar` has no accessible name (`aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`).
- Throws a ContractError when an icon-only `ToolbarButton` has no accessible name (text or `aria-label`).
- Throws a ContractError when an icon-only `ToolbarToggleItem` has no accessible name (text or `aria-label`).
- Throws a ContractError when a `ToolbarToggleItem` has a blank `value`.
- Throws a ContractError when a `ToolbarLink` has no accessible name (text or `aria-label`).

Rules:
- Always give Toolbar an aria-label (or aria-labelledby). Always give an icon-only ToolbarButton or ToolbarToggleItem an aria-label.
- Use ToolbarToggleGroup with v-model for on/off or one-of-many controls; type="multiple" holds a string[], type="single" a string.
- Give every ToolbarToggleItem a unique non-empty value.
- Put related controls next to each other and divide groups with ToolbarSeparator; do not put form fields, long text or menus that need Tab inside a toolbar.
- Do not add tabindex to parts and do not nest a Toolbar in a Toolbar: roving focus is handled for you.
- Prefer overflow="wrap" (default). Use overflow="scroll" only when the bar must stay on one line, and keep the most important controls first.
- Use orientation="vertical" for a column of tools; the separator and arrow keys follow it.
- Parts must be rendered inside Toolbar; outside it reka-ui throws a missing-context error.
- Use Menubar for application menus with sub menus, ToggleGroup for a standalone group of toggles outside a toolbar.

Accessibility:
- Root has role=toolbar and aria-orientation; it needs `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`. Use one toolbar per related set of controls; a page with several toolbars needs distinct names.
- The bar is a single tab stop (roving tabindex, from reka-ui): Tab moves focus into the bar, to the item that last had focus (the first one at first), and Tab again leaves it. Shift+Tab leaves backwards.
- Keyboard: ArrowRight/ArrowLeft move between items in a horizontal bar (swapped in `rtl`), ArrowDown/ArrowUp in a vertical bar, Home and End jump to the first and last item, and `loop` (on by default) wraps. Enter and Space press a button, toggle an item or follow a link. Disabled items are skipped.
- `ToolbarToggleGroup type="multiple"` items expose aria-pressed; `type="single"` items expose role=radio with aria-checked. A pressed item has a fill and a foreground border; in forced-colors mode the border is 2px and the label is underlined.
- Targets are at least 32px tall (24px floor in the dense style packs) and 44px on coarse pointers. Focus uses the shared ring, which stays an outline in forced-colors mode.
- Scroll overflow: the scrolling bar is itself focusable (it is the tab stop and hands focus to an item), so keyboard users can reach it, and the browser scrolls a focused item into view. No extra `tabindex` is added, so the roving sequence is unchanged. Wrap mode keeps every control visible and is the safer default on a 320px screen.
- Transitions are removed under prefers-reduced-motion. Separators are borders, so they stay visible in forced-colors mode; they are not focusable and are not announced as controls.

Example: Minimal
```vue
<Toolbar aria-label="Document actions">
  <ToolbarButton>New</ToolbarButton>
  <ToolbarButton>Open</ToolbarButton>
  <ToolbarButton>Save</ToolbarButton>
</Toolbar>
```

# Pagination
group: navigation / Paging
Page navigation with first/prev/next/last, sibling window and ellipses. Compact "Page X of Y" on small screens.

Give it `total` (item count) and `pageSize`; bind the 1-based page with `v-model:page`. Invalid input is sanitised: the page is clamped into range (and `update:page` re-emitted with the corrected value), a negative/NaN total means one empty page, and a pageSize below 1 falls back to 10. Below the `sm` breakpoint it shows a compact summary between prev/next; `compact` forces that everywhere. For cursor/"load more" lists use a Button instead.

import { Pagination } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- page: number - Current page, 1-based (v-model:page). Clamped to [1, totalPages].
- defaultPage: number = 1 - Initial page when uncontrolled.
- total: number = 0 - Total item count.
- pageSize: number = 10 - Items per page.
- siblings: number = 1 - Page buttons kept each side of the current page.
- showEdges: boolean = true - Show first/last buttons.
- variant: 'numbered' | 'simple' | 'compact' = 'numbered' - `numbered`: page buttons (compact summary below `sm`). `simple`: outline Previous and Next buttons with text and "Page X of Y" between them; page and edge buttons are not rendered. `compact`: "Page X of Y" between icon arrows at every width. Unknown values fall back to `numbered`.
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = 'md' - Button and text size: 24px, 32px or 44px targets (coarse pointers get at least 40px). Unknown values fall back to `md`.
- shape: 'rounded' | 'pill' | 'square' = 'rounded' - Corner style of every button. Unknown values fall back to `rounded`.
- compact: boolean = false - Same as `variant="compact"`: always use the "Page X of Y" layout.
- disabled: boolean = false - Disable every control.
- labels: Partial<PaginationLabels> - Override nav, first, previous, next, last, page, summary (`{page}`/`{total}` placeholders) for i18n.
- class: string | object | array - Merged onto the nav.

Events:
- update:page [page: number] - Page changed by the user, or corrected after clamping.

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when a `labels` entry (`nav`, `previous`, `next`, `page`, and `first` / `last` while `showEdges` is on) is blank. Invalid `page`, `total` and `pageSize` are still clamped without an error.

Rules:
- Use `v-model:page` with a 1-based page; pass `total` as an item count, not a page count.
- Do not clamp the page yourself; the component does and re-emits.
- Pass `labels` when the app is localised.

Accessibility:
- `<nav aria-label="Pagination">`; the current page button has aria-current="page". Pass `labels.nav` when a page holds more than one pager.
- Every button has an accessible name ("Page 3", "Next page"...); the visible number is inside it (WCAG 2.5.3). Page numbers use `tabular-nums` so the controls do not jump.
- The compact summary is aria-live="polite". Edge buttons are truly disabled; when the pressed button becomes disabled (Next on the last page) focus moves to the opposite arrow instead of falling to the page.
- Buttons are 32px (40px on coarse pointers) at `md`, 24px at `sm` (40px on coarse pointers) and 44px at `lg`; the row wraps at narrow widths, and arrows flip in RTL.
- The `simple` variant names its buttons from their visible text ("Previous page", "Next page") and keeps the live "Page X of Y" summary; `shape` and `size` never change names or roles.

Example: Basic
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const page = ref(1)
</script>

<div class="space-y-2">
  <Pagination v-model:page="page" :total="235" :page-size="10" :labels="{ nav: 'Basic pagination' }" />
  <p class="text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">Showing page {{ page }}</p>
</div>
```

Example: Many pages, wider window
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const page = ref(50)
</script>

<Pagination v-model:page="page" :total="10000" :page-size="10" :siblings="2" :labels="{ nav: 'Wide pagination' }" />
```

Example: Simple variant
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const page = ref(2)
</script>

<Pagination v-model:page="page" variant="simple" :total="90" :labels="{ nav: 'Simple pagination' }" />
```

Example: Sizes and shapes
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const page = ref(4)
</script>

<div class="grid gap-4">
  <Pagination v-model:page="page" size="sm" shape="rounded" :total="200" :labels="{ nav: 'Small rounded pagination' }" />
  <Pagination v-model:page="page" size="md" shape="pill" :total="200" :labels="{ nav: 'Medium pill pagination' }" />
  <Pagination v-model:page="page" size="lg" shape="square" :total="200" :labels="{ nav: 'Large square pagination' }" />
</div>
```

Example: Compact without edges
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const page = ref(3)
</script>

<Pagination v-model:page="page" :total="90" variant="compact" :show-edges="false" :labels="{ nav: 'Compact pagination' }" />
```

# Stepper
group: navigation / Progress
Shows progress through a multi-step flow, horizontal or vertical, optionally clickable.

Pass a `steps` array and the 0-based `current` index (`v-model:current`). Each step is `complete`, `current` or `upcoming` by position, or set `status` explicitly (including `error`). Unknown statuses are ignored and `current` is clamped into range. With `clickable`, steps become buttons that emit `update:current`; the Stepper only shows progress, it does not render step bodies. Use `Tabs` for peer panels and `Breadcrumb` for hierarchy.

import { Stepper } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- steps*: StepperStep[] - Steps `{ id?, title, description?, status?, icon?, disabled?, optional? }`.
- current: number - Current step index, 0-based (v-model:current). Clamped.
- defaultCurrent: number = 0 - Initial index when uncontrolled.
- orientation: 'horizontal' | 'vertical' = 'horizontal' - Layout.
- variant: 'numbered' | 'dots' | 'bar' = 'numbered' - `numbered`: circles with the step number. `dots`: smaller circles with no numbers (a check marks complete and a cross marks error; `icon` is ignored). `bar`: one progress segment per step with a check or cross before the title. Unknown values fall back to `numbered`.
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = 'md' - Marker, title text and connector size. Unknown values fall back to `md`.
- clickable: boolean = false - Render steps as buttons that emit update:current.
- label: string = 'Progress' - aria-label of the list.
- labels: Partial<Record<StepStatus, string>> & { optional?: string } - Screen-reader/status text overrides for i18n.
- class: string | object | array - Merged last with tailwind-merge.

Slots:
- step ({ step: StepperStep, index: number, status: StepStatus }) - Replaces the title/description block of each step.

Events:
- update:current [index: number] - A clickable step was chosen.

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when `steps` is empty or not an array, or a step is not an object.
- Throws a ContractError when a step has no non-empty `title` (unless the `step` slot draws the step).
- Throws a ContractError when `label` is blank, because it names the list.

Rules:
- `current` is 0-based, unlike Pagination `page`.
- Stepper renders progress only; render the step body yourself with v-if/v-show.
- Use `status: "error"` on a step to flag validation problems.

Accessibility:
- `<ol>` with aria-label (`label`, default "Progress"); the current step has aria-current="step".
- Status is announced via visually hidden text ("Completed:", "Current step:", "Error:"), so state is never colour alone: complete shows a check and error shows a cross.
- Clickable steps are real buttons (Tab, Enter, Space); non-clickable steps are plain text and not focusable. Indicators are 32px, and button text aligns to the start edge for RTL.
- Connectors are decorative (aria-hidden) and logical (`ms-3.75`).
- Every variant keeps the same list, status text and aria-current. `dots` and `bar` markers are decorative and carry no number, so state comes from the visually hidden status text and from the check or cross (a check or cross before the title in `bar`), never from colour alone.
- A horizontal stepper below the `sm` breakpoint shows only the current step title and keeps the others as visually hidden text, so it fits 320px without scrolling.

Example: Horizontal, clickable
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const current = ref(1)
const steps = [{ title: 'Account', description: 'Create login' }, { title: 'Profile' }, { title: 'Plan', optional: true }, { title: 'Done' }]
</script>

<div class="space-y-4">
  <Stepper v-model:current="current" :steps="steps" clickable />
  <div class="flex gap-2">
    <Button variant="outline" size="sm" :disabled="current === 0" @click="current--">Back</Button>
    <Button size="sm" :disabled="current === steps.length - 1" @click="current++">Next</Button>
  </div>
</div>
```

Example: Vertical with error and icon
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const steps = [{ title: 'Payment', status: 'error', description: 'Card declined' }, { title: 'Shipping', icon: faTruck }, { title: 'Review' }]
</script>

<Stepper :steps="steps" :current="1" orientation="vertical" />
```

Example: Dots
```vue
<Stepper :steps="[{ title: 'Cart' }, { title: 'Address' }, { title: 'Payment' }, { title: 'Review' }]" :current="2" variant="dots" label="Checkout dots" />
```

Example: Bar, horizontal and vertical
```vue
<div class="grid gap-6">
  <Stepper :steps="[{ title: 'Upload' }, { title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Publish' }]" :current="1" variant="bar" label="Publishing bar" />
  <Stepper :steps="[{ title: 'Upload' }, { title: 'Review', status: 'error' }, { title: 'Publish' }]" :current="1" variant="bar" orientation="vertical" label="Publishing bar vertical" />
</div>
```

Example: Sizes
```vue
<div class="grid gap-6">
  <Stepper v-for="size in ['sm', 'md', 'lg']" :key="size" :steps="[{ title: 'First' }, { title: 'Second' }, { title: 'Third' }]" :current="1" :size="size" :label="'Numbered ' + size" />
  <Stepper v-for="size in ['sm', 'md', 'lg']" :key="'d' + size" :steps="[{ title: 'First' }, { title: 'Second' }, { title: 'Third' }]" :current="1" :size="size" variant="dots" :label="'Dots ' + size" />
</div>
```

# Accordion
group: navigation / Tabs & disclosure
Vertically stacked sections that expand and collapse. Single or multiple open items. Built on reka-ui.

Compose `Accordion` + `AccordionItem` (unique `value`) + `AccordionTrigger` + `AccordionContent`. `type="single"` keeps one item open (and `collapsible`, on by default, lets it close); `type="multiple"` allows several. Control with `v-model` (string for single, string[] for multiple) or use `defaultValue`. Content animates with `animate-ds-collapse-*` and respects reduced motion. For one standalone toggle use `Collapsible`.

import { Accordion, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, AccordionContent } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- type: 'single' | 'multiple' = 'single' - Open behaviour. Unknown values fall back to `single`.
- modelValue: string | string[] - Controlled open item(s) (v-model).
- defaultValue: string | string[] - Initially open item(s).
- collapsible: boolean = true - In single mode, allow closing the open item.
- disabled: boolean = false - Disable all items.
- orientation: 'vertical' | 'horizontal' = 'vertical' - Arrow-key axis.
- dir: 'ltr' | 'rtl' - Reading direction.
- variant: 'flush' | 'bordered' | 'separated' | 'filled' = 'flush' - `flush`: items divided by a rule. `bordered`: one rounded frame around all items. `separated`: each item a bordered card with a gap. `filled`: each item on a muted surface. Unknown values fall back to `flush`.
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = 'md' - Text size and padding of triggers and content. Unknown values fall back to `md`.
- iconPosition: 'start' | 'end' = 'end' - Where the chevron (or the `icon` slot) sits relative to the title. Unknown values fall back to `end`.
- as: string | Component = 'div' - Root element.
- asChild: boolean = false - Render the single child as the root.
- class: string | object | array - Merged last with tailwind-merge.

Parts:
- AccordionItem - One section. Divided by `border-b` in `flush`/`bordered`, its own card in `separated` and `filled`.
    - value: string - Unique identifier.
    - disabled: boolean = false - Disable this item.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last.
- AccordionTrigger - Heading button (wrapped in an `h3` by default) with a rotating chevron. Slot `icon` replaces the chevron.
    - headingLevel: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 = 3 - Level of the wrapping heading; match it to the page outline.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last.
- AccordionContent - Collapsible region (`role="region"`); `class` is applied to the padded inner wrapper.
    - forceMount: boolean = false - Keep mounted while closed.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged onto the inner wrapper.

Slots:
- default - AccordionItem parts.

Events:
- update:modelValue [value: string | string[] | undefined] - Open item(s) changed.

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when two `AccordionItem`s share a `value`, or an item has a blank `value`.
- Throws a ContractError when an `AccordionItem` has no `AccordionTrigger` or no `AccordionContent`.
- Throws a ContractError when an `AccordionTrigger` has no accessible name (text or `aria-label`).

Rules:
- Every AccordionItem needs a unique `value`.
- Set `heading-level` on AccordionTrigger to the level below the surrounding heading.
- v-model is a string for `single` and a string[] for `multiple`.
- Put content classes on AccordionContent (applied to the inner padded wrapper), not on the animated outer element.

Accessibility:
- Each trigger is a button inside a heading with aria-expanded and aria-controls.
- Content is role="region" labelled by its trigger.
- Arrow Up/Down, Home and End move focus between triggers; Enter/Space toggles. Tab also reaches every trigger.
- Set `headingLevel` on AccordionTrigger so the headings fit the page outline (default h3).
- Triggers are at least 44px high on coarse pointers, text aligns to the start edge (RTL-safe), and the open/close animation is off under `motion-reduce`.
- `variant`, `size` and `iconPosition` only change the look. Roles, heading levels, names, arrow-key movement and the reduced-motion handling are identical for every value; the chevron is decorative, so moving it to the start changes nothing for assistive technology.
- Disabled items stay in the DOM with the disabled attribute and are skipped by arrow keys.

Example: Single, collapsible
```vue
<Accordion type="single" default-value="shipping" class="max-w-md">
  <AccordionItem value="shipping">
    <AccordionTrigger>Shipping</AccordionTrigger>
    <AccordionContent>Orders ship within two business days.</AccordionContent>
  </AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem value="returns">
    <AccordionTrigger>Returns</AccordionTrigger>
    <AccordionContent>Return unused items within 30 days.</AccordionContent>
  </AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem value="support" disabled>
    <AccordionTrigger>Support</AccordionTrigger>
    <AccordionContent>Unavailable.</AccordionContent>
  </AccordionItem>
</Accordion>
```

Example: Variants
```vue
<div class="grid max-w-md gap-6">
  <Accordion v-for="variant in ['flush', 'bordered', 'separated', 'filled']" :key="variant" type="single" collapsible :variant="variant" default-value="one">
    <AccordionItem value="one"><AccordionTrigger>Variant {{ variant }}</AccordionTrigger><AccordionContent>Open section.</AccordionContent></AccordionItem>
    <AccordionItem value="two"><AccordionTrigger>Second section</AccordionTrigger><AccordionContent>Closed section.</AccordionContent></AccordionItem>
  </Accordion>
</div>
```

Example: Sizes
```vue
<div class="grid max-w-md gap-6">
  <Accordion v-for="size in ['sm', 'md', 'lg']" :key="size" type="single" collapsible variant="bordered" :size="size" default-value="one">
    <AccordionItem value="one"><AccordionTrigger>Size {{ size }}</AccordionTrigger><AccordionContent>Content at the same size.</AccordionContent></AccordionItem>
  </Accordion>
</div>
```

Example: Icon at the start
```vue
<Accordion type="single" collapsible variant="separated" icon-position="start" default-value="one" class="max-w-md">
  <AccordionItem value="one"><AccordionTrigger>Chevron before the title</AccordionTrigger><AccordionContent>Useful for tree-like lists.</AccordionContent></AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem value="two"><AccordionTrigger>Second section</AccordionTrigger><AccordionContent>More text.</AccordionContent></AccordionItem>
</Accordion>
```

Example: Multiple with v-model
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const open = ref(['a'])
</script>

<div class="max-w-md space-y-2">
  <Accordion v-model="open" type="multiple">
    <AccordionItem value="a"><AccordionTrigger>Section A</AccordionTrigger><AccordionContent>Alpha</AccordionContent></AccordionItem>
    <AccordionItem value="b"><AccordionTrigger>Section B</AccordionTrigger><AccordionContent>Beta</AccordionContent></AccordionItem>
  </Accordion>
  <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Open: {{ open.join(', ') || 'none' }}</p>
</div>
```

# Collapsible
group: navigation / Tabs & disclosure
A single show/hide region with an animated reveal. Built on reka-ui.

Compose `Collapsible` + `CollapsibleTrigger` + `CollapsibleContent`. Control with `v-model:open` or leave uncontrolled (`defaultOpen`). The default slot receives `{ open }`. Use as-child on the trigger to turn your own Button into the toggle. For several related sections use `Accordion`.

import { Collapsible, CollapsibleTrigger, CollapsibleContent } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- as: string | Component - Element or component to render as (reka-ui Primitive).
- asChild: boolean - Render the single slot child instead of a wrapper element.
- open: boolean - Controlled open state (v-model:open).
- defaultOpen: boolean = false - Initial state when uncontrolled.
- disabled: boolean = false - Prevent toggling.
- unmountOnHide: boolean = false - Unmount content while closed.
- variant: 'plain' | 'bordered' | 'filled' = 'plain' - `plain`: no surface. `bordered`: rounded frame with padding. `filled`: muted surface with padding. Unknown values fall back to `plain`.
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = 'md' - Padding of the framed variants and text size of the content. Unknown values fall back to `md`.
- class: string | object | array - Merged last.

Parts:
- CollapsibleTrigger - Toggle element (button by default; `as-child` to use your own). Sets aria-expanded/aria-controls.
    - asChild: boolean = false - Render the single child.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last.
- CollapsibleContent - Region that animates with `animate-ds-collapse-*`.
    - forceMount: boolean = false - Keep mounted while closed.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last.

Slots:
- default ({ open: boolean }) - Trigger and content.

Events:
- update:open [value: boolean] - Open state changed.

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when `Collapsible` has no `CollapsibleTrigger` or no `CollapsibleContent`.
- Throws a ContractError when a `CollapsibleTrigger` rendered as a button or link has no accessible name (text or `aria-label`).

Rules:
- Use `as-child` on CollapsibleTrigger to reuse Button; do not nest a Button inside it.
- Prefer `Accordion` for groups of sections.
- Use `v-model:open` for controlled state.

Accessibility:
- Trigger has aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at the content.
- Enter/Space toggles; disabled sets the disabled attribute.
- The reveal animation is turned off under `motion-reduce`.
- `variant` and `size` only change the surface, padding and text size; the trigger and region wiring is identical.
- The trigger is a real button, so give an icon-only trigger an aria-label and keep the visible text inside its name.

Example: Basic
```vue
<Collapsible class="w-72 space-y-2">
  <CollapsibleTrigger as-child><Button variant="outline" size="sm">Toggle details</Button></CollapsibleTrigger>
  <CollapsibleContent class="rounded-md border p-3 text-sm">Extra details that were hidden.</CollapsibleContent>
</Collapsible>
```

Example: Bordered and filled
```vue
<div class="grid max-w-sm gap-4">
  <Collapsible v-for="variant in ['bordered', 'filled']" :key="variant" :variant="variant" size="sm" default-open class="space-y-2">
    <CollapsibleTrigger as-child><Button variant="outline" size="sm">Toggle {{ variant }}</Button></CollapsibleTrigger>
    <CollapsibleContent>Details inside the {{ variant }} surface.</CollapsibleContent>
  </Collapsible>
  <Collapsible variant="bordered" size="lg" default-open class="space-y-2">
    <CollapsibleTrigger as-child><Button variant="outline" size="sm">Toggle large</Button></CollapsibleTrigger>
    <CollapsibleContent>Larger padding and text.</CollapsibleContent>
  </Collapsible>
</div>
```

Example: Controlled with icon
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const open = ref(true)
</script>

<Collapsible v-model:open="open" class="w-72 space-y-2">
  <CollapsibleTrigger class="flex w-full items-center justify-between text-sm font-medium">
    Advanced options
    <Icon :icon="faChevronDown" :class="open ? 'rotate-180' : ''" />
  </CollapsibleTrigger>
  <CollapsibleContent class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Timeouts, retries and proxies.</CollapsibleContent>
</Collapsible>
```

# Tabs
group: navigation / Tabs & disclosure
Switch between related panels of content without leaving the page. Compound component built on reka-ui.

Compose `Tabs` + `TabsList` + `TabsTrigger` + `TabsContent`. The `variant` (`line` underline, `pill` muted track, `segmented` bordered track with a solid active segment, or `enclosed` boxed tabs), `size`, `fullWidth` and `orientation` are set once on `Tabs`. Control with `v-model` or leave uncontrolled with `defaultValue`. Every `TabsTrigger` `value` must match exactly one `TabsContent` `value`. Use `Tabs` for peer views of the same object; use `Stepper` for a sequence and `NavLink`/`SidebarNav` for page navigation (tabs do not change the URL).

import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- modelValue: string | number - Controlled active tab (v-model).
- defaultValue: string | number - Initial active tab when uncontrolled.
- variant: 'line' | 'pill' | 'segmented' | 'enclosed' = 'line' - Visual style. `line` underlines the active tab, `pill` raises it on a muted track, `segmented` fills it on a bordered track, `enclosed` boxes every tab. Unknown values fall back to `line`.
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = 'md' - Text size and padding of the triggers. Unknown values fall back to `md`.
- fullWidth: boolean = false - Stretch a horizontal list across the container so the triggers share the width. Has no effect on vertical tabs.
- orientation: 'horizontal' | 'vertical' = 'horizontal' - Layout and arrow-key axis.
- activationMode: 'automatic' | 'manual' = 'automatic' - Activate on focus or only on Enter/Space/click.
- dir: 'ltr' | 'rtl' - Reading direction.
- as: string | Component = 'div' - Root element.
- asChild: boolean = false - Render the single child as the root.
- class: string | object | array - Merged last with tailwind-merge.

Parts:
- TabsList - The `role="tablist"` row (or column when vertical). Give it an `aria-label`.
    - loop: boolean = true - Arrow keys wrap from last to first.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last.
- TabsTrigger - A tab button. Styled by the variant set on `Tabs`.
    - value: string | number - Identifier shared with the matching TabsContent.
    - disabled: boolean = false - Prevents activation and skips it in keyboard navigation.
    - asChild: boolean = false - Render the single child instead of a button.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last.
- TabsContent - Panel shown when its tab is active (`role="tabpanel"`, labelled by the trigger).
    - value: string | number - Matches a TabsTrigger value.
    - forceMount: boolean = false - Keep mounted while inactive (hidden) to preserve state.
    - class: string | object | array - Merged last.

Slots:
- default - TabsList and TabsContent parts.

Events:
- update:modelValue [value: string | number] - Active tab changed.

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when `TabsList` has no accessible name (`aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`).
- Throws a ContractError when a `TabsTrigger` value has no `TabsContent` with the same value, when a `TabsContent` value has no `TabsTrigger`, or when a value is used twice.
- Throws a ContractError when `Tabs` holds no `TabsTrigger`, or a trigger or content has a blank `value`.
- Throws a ContractError when a `TabsTrigger` has no accessible name (text or `aria-label`).

Rules:
- Every TabsTrigger value needs a TabsContent with the same value.
- Set variant/orientation on Tabs, never on TabsList or TabsTrigger.
- Give TabsList an aria-label.
- Do not use Tabs for page routing; use NavLink so the URL changes.

Accessibility:
- Roles tablist / tab / tabpanel with aria-selected and aria-controls wired by reka-ui.
- Arrow keys move between tabs (Left/Right, or Up/Down when vertical), Home/End jump; disabled tabs are skipped.
- Give TabsList an aria-label when the purpose is not obvious from context.
- Only the active tab is a tab stop; Tab then moves into the panel, which is focusable. `activationMode="manual"` activates on Enter/Space instead of on arrow focus.
- The list scrolls horizontally inside its own container when the tabs do not fit (320px, 200% zoom), so the page never scrolls sideways. Triggers do not shrink or wrap.
- The active tab is marked by a border, a filled surface or a solid fill plus `data-state` (never colour alone); in forced-colors mode it is also underlined. Triggers are at least 24px high even at `sm`, 32px at `md` and 44px on coarse pointers.
- `fullWidth` only changes the layout: roles, names and keyboard behaviour are identical for every variant, size and orientation.
- Vertical tabs use logical borders (`border-e`), so they mirror in RTL. Colour transitions run only under `motion-safe`.

Example: Basic (line)
```vue
<Tabs default-value="account" class="w-full max-w-md">
  <TabsList aria-label="Settings sections">
    <TabsTrigger value="account">Account</TabsTrigger>
    <TabsTrigger value="security">Security</TabsTrigger>
    <TabsTrigger value="billing" disabled>Billing</TabsTrigger>
  </TabsList>
  <TabsContent value="account">Manage your profile and preferences.</TabsContent>
  <TabsContent value="security">Password and two-factor settings.</TabsContent>
  <TabsContent value="billing">Billing is unavailable.</TabsContent>
</Tabs>
```

Example: Pill variant with v-model
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const tab = ref('overview')
</script>

<div class="space-y-3">
  <Tabs v-model="tab" variant="pill" class="w-full max-w-md">
    <TabsList aria-label="Report views">
      <TabsTrigger value="overview">Overview</TabsTrigger>
      <TabsTrigger value="activity">Activity</TabsTrigger>
    </TabsList>
    <TabsContent value="overview">Totals for the selected period.</TabsContent>
    <TabsContent value="activity">Latest events.</TabsContent>
  </Tabs>
  <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Active: {{ tab }}</p>
</div>
```

Example: Variants
```vue
<div class="grid w-full max-w-md gap-6">
  <Tabs default-value="a" variant="line">
    <TabsList aria-label="Line variant"><TabsTrigger value="a">Line</TabsTrigger><TabsTrigger value="b">Second</TabsTrigger></TabsList>
    <TabsContent value="a">Underlined active tab.</TabsContent><TabsContent value="b">Second panel.</TabsContent>
  </Tabs>
  <Tabs default-value="a" variant="pill">
    <TabsList aria-label="Pill variant"><TabsTrigger value="a">Pill</TabsTrigger><TabsTrigger value="b">Second</TabsTrigger></TabsList>
    <TabsContent value="a">Raised active tab on a muted track.</TabsContent><TabsContent value="b">Second panel.</TabsContent>
  </Tabs>
  <Tabs default-value="a" variant="segmented">
    <TabsList aria-label="Segmented variant"><TabsTrigger value="a">Segmented</TabsTrigger><TabsTrigger value="b">Second</TabsTrigger></TabsList>
    <TabsContent value="a">Solid active segment in a bordered track.</TabsContent><TabsContent value="b">Second panel.</TabsContent>
  </Tabs>
  <Tabs default-value="a" variant="enclosed">
    <TabsList aria-label="Enclosed variant"><TabsTrigger value="a">Enclosed</TabsTrigger><TabsTrigger value="b">Second</TabsTrigger></TabsList>
    <TabsContent value="a">Boxed tabs; the active one matches the panel.</TabsContent><TabsContent value="b">Second panel.</TabsContent>
  </Tabs>
</div>
```

Example: Sizes
```vue
<div class="grid gap-4">
  <Tabs v-for="size in ['sm', 'md', 'lg']" :key="size" default-value="a" variant="pill" :size="size">
    <TabsList :aria-label="'Size ' + size"><TabsTrigger value="a">Size {{ size }}</TabsTrigger><TabsTrigger value="b">Second</TabsTrigger></TabsList>
    <TabsContent value="a" class="sr-only">First panel.</TabsContent><TabsContent value="b" class="sr-only">Second panel.</TabsContent>
  </Tabs>
</div>
```

Example: Full width segmented
```vue
<Tabs default-value="day" variant="segmented" full-width class="w-full max-w-md">
  <TabsList aria-label="Range">
    <TabsTrigger value="day">Day</TabsTrigger>
    <TabsTrigger value="week">Week</TabsTrigger>
    <TabsTrigger value="month">Month</TabsTrigger>
  </TabsList>
  <TabsContent value="day">Today.</TabsContent>
  <TabsContent value="week">This week.</TabsContent>
  <TabsContent value="month">This month.</TabsContent>
</Tabs>
```

Example: Vertical enclosed
```vue
<Tabs default-value="general" orientation="vertical" variant="enclosed" class="w-full max-w-lg">
  <TabsList aria-label="Enclosed preferences">
    <TabsTrigger value="general">General</TabsTrigger>
    <TabsTrigger value="notifications">Notifications</TabsTrigger>
  </TabsList>
  <TabsContent value="general" class="px-4">General preferences.</TabsContent>
  <TabsContent value="notifications" class="px-4">Notification channels.</TabsContent>
</Tabs>
```

Example: Vertical
```vue
<Tabs default-value="general" orientation="vertical" class="w-full max-w-lg">
  <TabsList aria-label="Preferences">
    <TabsTrigger value="general">General</TabsTrigger>
    <TabsTrigger value="notifications">Notifications</TabsTrigger>
  </TabsList>
  <TabsContent value="general" class="px-4">General preferences.</TabsContent>
  <TabsContent value="notifications" class="px-4">Notification channels.</TabsContent>
</Tabs>
```

# AccentPicker
group: navigation / Theme
Radio group of colour swatches that switches the accent preset (`data-theme`).

Offers every preset in `THEME_ACCENTS` (or the `accents` you pass) and stores the choice with `useThemeStore().setAccent()`. Swatches show each preset colour regardless of the active theme (they mirror the preset `--primary` hues; this is the one place colours are not live tokens). It is a single tab stop; arrow keys, Home and End move the selection. The accent CSS (`@perfect-design/ui/themes/<name>.css`) must be imported by the app for the preset to take effect. Pair with `ThemeToggle`.

import { AccentPicker } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- accents: ThemeAccent[] = THEME_ACCENTS - Presets to offer, in order. Unknown names are ignored.
- label: string = 'Accent colour' - aria-label of the radiogroup.
- shape: 'circle' | 'rounded' | 'square' = 'circle' - Swatch corners. Unknown values fall back to `circle`.
- size: 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' = 'md' - Swatch size: 24px, 32px or 40px (coarse pointers get 32px, 40px and 44px). There is no smaller size because the swatches are the click targets. Unknown values fall back to `md`.
- layout: 'inline' | 'grid' | 'list' = 'inline' - `inline`: a wrapping row. `grid`: three columns. `list`: one row per preset with the visible name and a check on the chosen one. Unknown values fall back to `inline`.
- class: string | object | array - Merged last.

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when no Pinia instance is active (`app.use(createPinia())`).
- Throws a ContractError when `label` is blank, or `accents` has no known preset.

Rules:
- Requires an active Pinia instance and the accent CSS imports.
- Do not recolour swatches with `bg-primary`; they intentionally show fixed preset colours.

Accessibility:
- `role="radiogroup"` with `role="radio"` swatches and aria-checked; the group has an aria-label (`label`).
- Roving tabindex: Tab enters once on the selected swatch; Arrow keys, Home and End change the selection and move focus (Left and Right follow the reading direction, so they swap in RTL).
- Each swatch has an accessible name (the preset name) and a title tooltip. Selection is shown by a ring plus the aria-checked state, never by colour alone.
- Swatches are 24px (`md`), 32px (`lg`) or 40px (`xl`), at least 32px on coarse pointers, and wrap onto new lines at narrow widths. In the `list` layout each row shows the preset name as text and a check mark on the chosen one, and the whole row is the radio.
- In forced-colors mode swatches keep their preset colour (`forced-color-adjust: none`) and the selected one gets a thicker outline.

Example: All presets
```vue
<AccentPicker />
```

Example: Shapes and sizes
```vue
<div class="grid gap-3"><AccentPicker shape="circle" label="Circle swatches" /><AccentPicker shape="rounded" size="lg" label="Rounded swatches" /><AccentPicker shape="square" size="xl" label="Square swatches" /></div>
```

Example: Grid and list layouts
```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-8"><AccentPicker layout="grid" label="Grid of accents" /><AccentPicker layout="list" label="Accent list" class="w-48" /></div>
```

Example: Subset
```vue
<AccentPicker :accents="subset" label="Brand colour" />
```

# ThemeToggle
group: navigation / Theme
Button that cycles the colour mode light → dark → system and shows the matching icon.

Reads and writes `useThemeStore()` (Pinia). Each click calls `cycleMode()`; the icon shows the CURRENT mode (sun, moon, desktop) and the accessible name starts with the current mode and then names the NEXT one ("Theme: Light. Switch to dark."). `variant="button"` additionally shows the current mode name. The store starts from defaults and reads the saved choice in `init()` (so server and first client render agree). It must be initialised once (`useThemeStore().init()` at app start or via a ThemeProvider) so the choice is applied to `<html>` and persisted; the toggle itself only changes state. Pair with `AccentPicker` to choose the accent preset.

import { ThemeToggle } from '@perfect-design/ui'

Props:
- variant: 'icon' | 'button' | 'switch' | 'segmented' = 'icon' - `icon`: square ghost icon button. `button`: outline button with the current mode name. `switch`: a light and dark switch (a sun or moon thumb), for apps that offer no system mode. `segmented`: a radio group of light, dark and system, each choosable directly. Unknown values fall back to `icon`.
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' = 'md' - Control size. The `icon` button is 24px, 36px or 44px square, the `button` 32px, 36px or 44px high, the `segmented` options 24px, 32px or 40px, and the `switch` track 20px, 24px or 28px high; coarse pointers get at least 40px targets. Unknown values fall back to `md`.
- label: string - Accessible name of the `switch` (default "Dark mode") and of the `segmented` group (default "Theme"). The `icon` and `button` variants name themselves from the current mode.
- class: string | object | array - Merged last.

Enforced requirements (a ContractError is thrown when missing):
- Throws a ContractError when no Pinia instance is active (`app.use(createPinia())`).

Rules:
- Requires an active Pinia instance.
- Call useThemeStore().init() once at app start; the toggle does not.
- Do not override aria-label; it already states the current mode and what the next click does.

Accessibility:
- `variant="switch"` is `role="switch"` named "Dark mode" with aria-checked for the resolved dark state; the sun or moon on the thumb and its position carry the state besides colour. It sets light or dark and never `system`.
- `variant="segmented"` is a `role="radiogroup"` (named "Theme") of three `role="radio"` buttons named Light, Dark and System. It is a single tab stop on the selected mode; arrow keys (swapped in RTL), Home and End select and move focus. The selected one is raised and underlined in forced colors.
- aria-label and title read "Theme: Light. Switch to dark." The name begins with the visible mode text, so `variant="button"` satisfies WCAG 2.5.3 label in name.
- It cycles through three modes, so it is a plain button, not a toggle button: aria-pressed would be wrong for three states.
- Native button; Space/Enter cycle. The icon is decorative (aria-hidden). Targets are 24px (`sm`), 36px (`md`) or 44px (`lg`) square, and at least 40px on coarse pointers.

Example: Icon
```vue
<ThemeToggle />
```

Example: Button with label, in a toolbar
```vue
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><ThemeToggle variant="button" /><ThemeToggle /></div>
```

Example: Switch
```vue
<div class="flex items-center gap-3"><ThemeToggle variant="switch" size="sm" /><ThemeToggle variant="switch" /><ThemeToggle variant="switch" size="lg" label="Use dark theme" /></div>
```

Example: Segmented
```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3"><ThemeToggle variant="segmented" size="sm" label="Theme small" /><ThemeToggle variant="segmented" label="Theme medium" /><ThemeToggle variant="segmented" size="lg" label="Theme large" /></div>
```
